title: Casual Technical Demonstrator – Location Sound Specialist
description:
Bath Spa students can access Bath Spa Careers for support with applying for opportunities. Services include support with job applications and interview techniques. For further information visit

As a Casual Technical Demonstrator (Location Sound), you will support the delivery of practical teaching and student film productions across Bath Spa University’s TV & Film courses. Working with students of varying experience levels, you will provide hands-on demonstrations and technical guidance in the use of professional location sound equipment, including microphones, field mixers, audio recorders and associated accessories.
The role involves assisting students in developing the skills and confidence required to capture high-quality audio for short films, documentaries and other media productions. You will support practical workshops, equipment inductions and production activities, as well as providing technical assistance on location during student filming projects.

Through your expertise and guidance, you will help students apply industry-standard sound recording techniques in both controlled and real-world production environments.
  • Demonstrate the safe and effective use of professional location sound equipment.
  • Support practical teaching sessions, workshops and equipment inductions.
  • Provide technical guidance to students undertaking film and documentary productions.
  • Assist students with location sound recording techniques, equipment setup and troubleshooting.
  • Support student productions on location, ensuring equipment is used appropriately and effectively.
  • Maintain high standards of health and safety when working with audio equipment and production activities.
  • Contribute to a positive and inclusive learning environment that encourages student development and confidence.
For any queries about the role, please contact Richard Wood R.Wood@bathspa.ac.uk directly

Hours of work will be around 8-16 hours per week

Due to the nature of this post regretfully we cannot accept applications that do not have the Right to Work/Live in the UK therefore your application will be rejected.

title: Specifications Analyst-PRM QP
description:
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

  • Review customer /project specifications on special processes, and identify relevant requirements, recommend alternatives, deviations, clarifications and/or exceptions to ensure practical and attainable compliance with specifications and applicable code requirements.

  • Consolidate requirements once PO is received; reconcile gaps between our quoted exceptions, technical qualification process, customer’s Purchase Order, and agreements reached in customer kickoff meeting.

  • Upon order confirmation, work with quotation team to develop sales order long text to ensure customer /project requirements are clearly communicated onto the factory sales order

  • Support calls, correspondence and/or technical meetings with customers, factory and vendors, to provide technical opinions on special process requirements to obtain alignment across all parties.

  • Write addendums to factory and /or vendors’ manufacturing procedures revolving around material testing /heat treatment /welding /painting/ NDE and other special processes, to identify specific project requirement for customer’s approval.

  • Review and interpret customer commented procedures and initiate technical clarifications with customers, factories, and sub-suppliers to fulfil project documentation approval.

  • Create special procedures or specifications where current documents are unable to fulfil project requirements. This is not restricted to corrosion testing /heat treatment /welding / painting/ NDE and other special processes.

  • Provide additional adhoc support as needed to support PMO objectives, for project related activities.

Who You Are:

You persist in accomplishing objectives despite obstacles and setbacks. You effectively communicate in various settings: one-on-one, small and large groups, or among diverse styles and position levels. You understand that different situations may call for different approaches.

For This Role, You Will Need:

  • 5 to 10 years’ of hands-on experience with special processes such as coating, welding, NDE, casting, heat treatment etc in Oil & Gas industry.

  • Has strong knowledge of ASME BPVC (Sections II, V, VIII, IX) and NORSOK M501.

  • Preferably familiar with IOGP S-563, S-705, S-715

  • Ability to learn and comprehend technical details and gain technical literacy in the above special processes.

  • Attention to detail, problem solving skills and independent judgement to deal with ambiguity.

  • Professional communication skills (reading, writing, and verbal) across different cultures and languages.

  • Ability to use MS Office applications, such as Word and Excel.

  • Being a team player is essential.

Our Culture & Commitment to You:

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that phenomenal ideas come from great teams. Our dedication to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results. We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing flexible, competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including vacation and holiday leave.

title: Supply Chain Lead
description:
About the role

As Supply Chain Lead you will be responsible for ensuring optimal inventory levels across our worldwide Supply Chain as well as costs optimization, with the goal to support the $250M Revenue target by December 2027. This role will cover all channels in which our top-seller brand sells in.

What you will do:

  • Define and execute the Inventory Planning strategy, to ensure optimum inventory levels across all sales channels and geographic locations (e.g. define inventory replenishment and reordering targets/parameters, Demand forecast review…)
  • Ensure the execution of the Inventory Planning strategy by the Inventory Analysts/Administrators team in charge (located in the Philippines, reporting indirectly to you) and the Procurement teams (US/China)
  • Monitor and report on Daily/Weekly/Monthly inventory performance to Brand Management and Supply Chain Leadership teams, anticipate and mitigate any risks linked to Out of Stock or Overstock situations
  • Manage our suppliers relationships and performance (weekly, monthly, quaterly review)
  • Lead strategic projects to optimize our Supply Chain (e.g. 3PL warehouse performance improvement, Supply Chain costs optimization incl. Suppliers negotiations, Suppliers partnership/relationship management, FBA inbound performance optimization, Packaging optimization, Inventory planning tools & processes automation, etc.)
  • Reinforce our supply chain processes especially on retail
  • As our brand is in hypergrowth (>100% YoY), you will be in a unique situation that will require out-of-the-box thinking to support the ambitious goal, while ensuring that we leverage all the platform scalable capabilities.

Who you are:

  • Master’s degree (Engineering, Business or similar field)
  • From 5 to 10 years of experience in Supply Chain (Forecasting, Supply Planning, Supplier Management , Inventory management, Logistics, etc.). E-commerce experience is a plus
  • Strong proficiency in MS Office programs (Excel, Word...) or Google Suite programs
  • Fluent written and verbal communication in English
  • Ability to analyze data, draw conclusions and make recommendations.
  • Ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced / high ambition environment
  • Ability to drive results through others
  • High level of organization, impeccable attention to detail, capacity to figure out complex problems without a lot of oversight
  • Strong business acumen and analytical skills
  • Positive attitude, reliable, transparent and enjoy working with different types of people.

We are seeking for people who:

  • Are owners.
  • Are continually raising the bar.
  • Are sincerely open-minded, and are willing to examine their strongest convictions with humility.
  • Nurture and embrace differing perspectives to make better decisions.


What's in it for you?

  • A supportive, diverse and global team with a growth mindset.
  • A scaling company with great industry professionals.
  • A flexible (hybrid) working environment.
  • Great opportunities to get involved with exciting projects.


If you are ready to join our fast-paced company, apply now!


The estimated salary range for this role is $120 - $140K per year. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, and location.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, ancestry, age, or national origin will be considered. No qualified applicants will be discriminated against on the basis of disability or protected veteran status.

title: Migrant Protection Assistant, Direct Assistance
description:
Introduction

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Applications are welcome from internal and external candidates. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, internal and internal-equivalent candidates are considered as first-tier candidates.

Organizational Context and Scope

Under the overall supervision of the Programme Manager Protection and the direct supervision of the Senior Programme Associate, Migrant Protection – Direct Assistance, the successful candidate will provide general assistance to victims of trafficking, vulnerable migrants and those migrants who are vulnerable to trafficking. The Migrant Protection Assistant is expected to carry out his/her duties in accordance with strictest moral and ethical standards and with due respect for gender and socio-cultural differences of the victims.

  1. Carry out interviews with potential victims of trafficking and vulnerable migrants for recording general information.
  2. Coordinate the assistance provided to each of the beneficiaries.
  3. Prepare case management reports for each beneficiary in regular basis.
  4. Ensure appropriate data management of beneficiaries, including entering data into IOM databases on assistance and proper filing.
  5. Prepare statistics, reports and analysis as requested.
  6. Ensure the confidentiality of all beneficiaries.
  7. Assist in organizing trainings on victims’ identification and assisted voluntary return and reintegration.
  8. Undertake other duties as assigned.
  9. Perform other duties as they might be assigned.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in a Social Science, Psychology, Business Administration, or a community
    related field work from an accredited academic institution with two years of relevant professional experience; or,
  • Secondary School certificate/degree with a minimum of four years of experience in a community related field work.

Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database.

Experience

  • Experience in working with governmental and diplomatic authorities as well as with international organizations.
  • Good knowledge of migration issues and how these may impact the vulnerability of a person.

Skills

  • Strong Communication skills is essential.
  • Strong knowledge of computer applications, especially MS Word, Outlook, Access and good typing skills in English and Arabic.
  • Experience working with Excel and databases.

Languages

All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish).

For this position, fluency in English & Arabic is required (oral and written).

Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.

Required Competencies

IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link. Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.

Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:

  • Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
  • Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
  • Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
  • Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.
  • Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.

Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 1

  • Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
  • Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
  • Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
  • Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.
  • Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.

Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2, if with direct reports

  • Leadership: Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential.
  • Empowering others: Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential.
  • Building Trust: Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty.
  • Strategic thinking and vision: Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction.
  • Humility: Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings.

Notes

Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category.

Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation.

This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months.

Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances.

IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities.

IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts.

IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application.

No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

title: Aerodynamics Student Placements
description:
At Red Bull Technology, we don't just compete, we innovate, push boundaries, and strive for performance at every level. This is an exciting opportunity to begin your engineering career in Formula One, working within our Aerodynamics department and contributing to the development of technologies that help deliver performance on track.

Are you currently in your penultimate year of studies and interested in a career within Formula One? If so, this is a fantastic opportunity for you to showcase your talent and build your experience to open the door to a future career at Red Bull Racing.

Red Bull Technology are offering a variety of 12-month student Placement positions within our Aerodynamics Department.

Aerodynamics Development
• Analysis and reporting of aerodynamics data from the wind tunnel, CFD and track
• Contribute to the aerodynamic design of the car
• Preparation and running of CFD models
• Planning and operational support of wind tunnel programs in our wind tunnel facility
• Support the documentation of Red Bull Technology design, testing and analysis techniques
• Develop problem solving and communication skills through working closely with fellow engineers

Aerodynamics Systems
• Creating new systems and techniques for the wind tunnel, CFD and track environments as well as the associated test rigs
• Working with state-of-the-art technologies to help further the understanding of Formula One racing car aerodynamics
• Offering support for in-house tools and software systems used in the Aerodynamics Department
• Develop problem solving and communication skills through working closely with aerodynamics, software, mechanical and electronics engineers

Aerodynamics Model Design
• To design accurate and structurally sound aerodynamic components appropriate for F1 wind tunnel testing.
• Contribute to the continued improvement and development of the design group – which could entail new technical approaches, materials, and practices.
• Operational support of wind tunnel test programs in the Red Bull Technology wind tunnel facility
• Develop problem solving and communication skills through working closely with design engineers, aerodynamicists, and production staff.

Aerodynamics Surface Design
• Assist in the scheming and design of aerodynamic components using CAD
• Maintain, update and develop robust aerodynamically parametrised CAD models which can be easily/consistently adapted
• Collaborate with aerodynamicists to develop innovative and legal geometries for CFD analysis and wind tunnel testing
• Develop and maintain new CAD models for understanding and checking against legality constraints
• Create geometries which demonstrate new opportunities and risks associated with regulation changes
• Flag geometries which represent a conflict over design space or a potential breach of legality

Aerodynamics Performance
• Analysis and reporting of aerodynamic and performance data from the wind tunnel, CFD and track.
• Support the Aero Performance Group at race and test events to inform decision-making and enable fast reporting of the results with relevant context.
• Utilise a strong coding ability to develop tools to support analysis and reporting of aerodynamic data across all domains (wind tunnel, CFD and track).
• Contribute to the development of aero data modelling methods and techniques.
• Develop problem solving and communication skills through working closely with fellow engineers.
• Support the documentation of Red Bull Technology testing and analysis techniques.

CFD Tools & Methods
• Further develop and maintain commercial and in-house CFD software tools.
• Work closely with CFD users, analysis and performance engineers across business units to identify current bottlenecks and future requirements.
• Be actively involved in numerical methods research and software benchmarking.
• Provide user and CFD technical support across business units.
• Develop best-practice guidelines and maintain the Wiki knowledge base.

Aerodynamics Thermal
• While Aerodynamics Development concentrates mainly on external flows, this role focuses on the aerodynamic elements which provide all aspects of cooling and temperature management
• Contribute to the aerodynamic design of the car
• Integration of the engine and its systems into the race car to enable aerodynamic development freedom
• Race-event preparation to optimise the aerodynamic performance of the cooling package
• Ownership of CFD and Wind-tunnel projects from preparation through to analysis of results
• Develop problem solving and communication skills through working closely with engineers across the company

AeroScience
• Analyse and interpret aerodynamic data from all domains (CFD, WT, track)
• Identify and quantify key variables that drive the aerodynamic performance of the race car
• Develop new methods and techniques for the department to analyse aerodynamic data
• Design experiments to compare the aerodynamic response of the race car across domains
• Work with aero development teams on linking flow field to aerodynamic performance
• Work with software teams on developing long-term capabilities for the department

Aerodynamics Experimental
• Support the day to day running of the wind tunnel
• Help derive and conduct experiments to improve the aerodynamics of the wind tunnel facility
• Assist with the development of tools and methodologies
• Work closely with the Aerodynamic Development teams providing support to wind tunnel tests
• Attend WT tests where necessary

Candidates wishing to apply for a role should demonstrate an active interest in aerodynamics and be studying towards a degree within Mechanical/ Aeronautical/ Automotive/ Motorsport/ Electrical/ Systems Engineering/ Maths/ Physics/ Computer Science etc

At Red Bull Technology, we believe that success isn’t just about speed, it’s about the team behind the victory. We trust, support, and challenge each other, always pushing for better. If you love solving complex problems, thinking fast, and making a real impact, this is the place for you. Alongside a competitive salary, you’ll enjoy:


• Bonus scheme
• Private healthcare
• A pension scheme
• On-site gym
• Free daily food allowance
• And many more!

The placement will be for 1 year, starting in the summer of 2027. To be considered for this Student Placement, please apply to this advert and submit both your CV and a one-page Cover Letter as two separate documents.

Application closing date: 23:55 (BST) Sunday 4th October 2026

title: Teamleider Klantcontact
description:
Stel je voor: een dynamische omgeving waar jij elke dag invloed hebt op hoe duizenden klanten onze service ervaren. Wij zijn het kloppend hart achter één van de grootste telecomspelers ter wereld. Klanten komen bij ons met vragen, problemen of gewoon omdat ze even iemand nodig hebben die meedenkt — en wij zorgen dat ze met een glimlach verder kunnen.

Als Teamleider ben jij de motor achter een team dat barst van potentie. Jij tilt mensen naar een hoger niveau, bouwt aan vertrouwen en creëert een sfeer waarin prestaties én plezier hand in hand gaan. Je bent coach, motivator, strateeg en sfeermaker in één.

Krijg jij energie van groei — van jezelf én van anderen? Dan ga je je hier helemaal uitleven!

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je haalt het maximale uit je team en ziet precies waar ieders kracht ligt.
  • Je stuurt op KPI’s, maar vooral op gedrag, mindset en teamflow.
  • Je zorgt dat elk klantcontact strak, warm en professioneel wordt afgehandeld.
  • Je houdt verzuim en verloop scherp in de gaten en stuurt proactief bij.
  • Je monitort prestaties en coacht medewerkers op een manier die écht binnenkomt.
  • Je voert gesprekken die ertoe doen — BILA’s, functioneringsgesprekken, evaluaties — en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen.

Wat we van jou vragen

We zoeken geen manager. We zoeken een leider. Iemand die stevig staat, die mensen begrijpt, die weet hoe je een team in beweging krijgt en die niet bang is om verantwoordelijkheid te pakken.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Ervaring met het aansturen van een team (service of sales is een dikke plus).
  • Een duidelijke visie op hoe je een team laat groeien.
  • Het vermogen om te schakelen tussen details en helicopterview.
  • Analytisch inzicht en een gezonde liefde voor cijfers.
  • Flexibiliteit in werktijden.
  • Creativiteit en lef om nieuwe ideeën te brengen.
  • Een mensgerichte leiderschapsstijl die inspireert.

Wat wij jou bieden

  • Een team dat samen knalt én samen viert.
  • Leuke incentives, awards en borrels die je niet wil missen.
  • Een bonusregeling die jouw resultaten beloont.
  • 25 vakantiedagen + 2 extra als je het hele jaar niet ziek bent geweest.
  • Pensioenregeling, reiskostenvergoeding en 8% vakantiegeld.
  • WGA-hiaatverzekering en collectiviteitskorting op aanvullende zorgverzekering.
  • Employee referral bonus.
  • Lease-a-bike optie.
  • Een kantoor midden in het centrum, perfect bereikbaar met OV.
  • Meer dan 1000 trainingen via onze Conduent University — zodat jij elke dag kunt groeien. En groeien, dat is hier standaard.

Als Teamleider ben je een sleutelspeler in onze organisatie. We investeren in jou, in je ontwikkeling en in je toekomst. Veel van onze Afdelingsmanagers, Trainers en Project Managers zijn ooit begonnen waar jij nu staat!

title: (1861) Analyst Developer (AEM) - BSTD
description:
Brief description

The purpose of the role is to develop, maintain and support IT solutions to meet the business needs within the South African Reserve Bank Group (SARB Group).

Detailed description

The successful candidate will be responsible for the following key performance areas:

  • Defining own work plan and deliverables with guidance from Team leader/senior developer.

  • Conducting analysis and design quality IT solutions according to approved business requirements and in line with governance frameworks.

  • Ensuring the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs.

  • Designing and developing of AEM solutions and providing support on AEM best practices, ensuring efficient and effective use of the platform.

  • Delivering quality IT solutions through development, integration, testing and deployment according to the approved design specification and within agreed timelines.

  • Ensuring total quality of an IT solution according to approved standards.

  • Consistently providing IT solution maintenance and support in the designated area, thereby ensuring business continuity in line with the agreed service standards.

  • Keeping abreast of developments in information and communication technology (ICT) trends and within the specialised area of technology in order to design and develop the most appropriate IT solution within the area of responsibility.

  • Actively participating and supporting the team towards the completion of goals.

  • Mentoring and coaching of team members.

  • Engaging with internal and external user communities to ensure that business benefits are realised.

  • Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs.

Job requirements

To be considered for this position, candidates must be in possession of:

  • a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Information Systems or an equivalent qualification (NQF 7);

  • five to eight years’ experience within an application development and support environment (with relevant technical knowledge);

  • three to five years’ experience in digital transformation projects, particularly with AEM Forms and/or Sites.

Technical knowledge preferred:

  • Functional Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) platform experience (AEM Forms and Sites).

  • knowledge of workflow management environments;

  • understanding of design patterns and best practices for developing high-quality, maintainable code.

  • proficiency in programming languages including Java, HTL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

  • experience working with REST, Sling and SOAP in a production environment.

  • expertise in AEM-related technologies such as Apache Felix, Apache Sling, Jackrabbit, CRXDE, and others.

  • experience with various testing methodologies, including unit, integration, functional, and performance testing.

  • familiarity with testing frameworks like JUnit and Cucumber.

  • knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Change Control, and Release Management processes.

  • familiarity with both waterfall and agile methodologies for project execution.

  • experience with DevOps tools such as JIRA, Confluence, GitLab, Jenkins, Cucumber, SonarQube, Maven, Junit, JaCoCo, Selenium and others.

  • exposure to Linux operating systems.

  • proven experience in negotiating outcomes and managing stakeholder expectations.

  • experience in facilitating workshops and collaborative sessions.

Additional requirements are as follows

  • analytical skills;

  • building trust;

  • service orientation;

  • decision making;

  • verbal and written communication;

  • time and work management;

  • problem solving and analysis;

  • contributing to team success; and

  • solid knowledge of the software development lifecycle.

In line with the SARB’s commitment to diversifying its workforce, preference will be given to suitable candidates from designated groups. People with disabilities are welcome to apply.

The SARB offers remuneration and benefits commensurate with the level of the position and in line with the market. The level at which the successful applicant will be appointed will depend on his/her competence and experience.

title: Senior Staff Engineer Development Molding
description:
#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. Join the thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers behind tomorrow’s technology. As a Senior Staff Engineer Development Molding, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life. Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


In this role, you will identify and develop new processes for products and packages, driving innovation and continuous improvement to meet quality, manufacturability, and business objectives. You will establish and implement robust process controls to ensure high-quality, reliable, and reproducible manufacturing outcomes.


  • Perform or guide Process development activities (Process parameters scouting, optimization, verification and Process Freeze) in Development projects to meet the project targets in term of timeline, quality, cost competitiveness and manufacturability
  • Responsible or support for technical handshake and knowledge transfer to Operation
  • Support prototype and development samples build
  • Generate and update relevant documents, (e.g. Process Specification, PFMEA, DFMEA, Master FMEA, OJTI, T32, PDR)
  • Provide inputs for updating of related documents and is responsible for their correct contents, (e.g. Process of Record, Assembly Design Rule, Process Roadmap, Failure catalogue, Control Plan, Maintenance checklist, Unit process roadmap, etc.) for development projects
  • Liaise with suppliers for continuous improvement and perform verification and qualification activities for new tooling, machines and materials in Development projects
  • Technical lead for task force and complex problem-solving team using Statistical and analytical tools, (e.g. SPC, APC, DOE, 8D, FMEA, DFMEA, etc.)
  • Identify and develop new Process technology (new developed unit process block) and improve Process capability to meet new requirements from Business divisions
  • Support the definition of Process technology, material, machine and tooling
  • Provide technical guidance/buddy to other engineers and project team
  • Initiating, generating and drive (P) IP ideas based on reading and research
  • Lead technical critical topic for the DEV related projects and FOK attention within sites

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


You strive to leverage strong expertise in semiconductor assembly processes, material science, and statistical analysis to drive process excellence, manufacturing quality, and continuous improvement. You demonstrate hands-on technical capability, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills, utilizing data-driven approaches and engineering tools to develop robust and reliable manufacturing solutions.

description:

Please note: This is a talent pipeline advertisement and not for a specific current vacancy. Suitable applicants may be contacted regarding future opportunities that match their skills and experience. This pipeline will remain open for approximately three months, after which it will close and a new pipeline will be advertised. Candidates not progressed during the current campaign will be welcome to reapply to future pipeline advertisements.

About the Roles

As an Administration Officer, you'll provide reception, guest services and administrative support to site leadership teams while helping ensure the smooth day-to-day operation of a remote workforce accommodation village.

Depending on business requirements, opportunities may include a variety of FIFO rosters and work schedules.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide professional reception and front-of-house services

  • Assist with site onboarding, inductions and training coordination

  • Support roster administration and workforce records management

  • Collate invoices, purchase orders and supporting documentation

  • Prepare reports and maintain accurate filing systems

  • Provide administration support to site-based leadership and operational teams

  • Promote a safe, professional and customer-focused workplace

About You

We'd love to hear from candidates who have:

  • Strong experience using site-based systems such as INX, SAMS, SAP, RMS or similar platforms

  • Minimum 1-2 years' experience in a FIFO Site Administrator, Village Administrator or similar administration role

  • Previous experience supporting rostering, timesheets and time & attendance processes

  • Excellent customer service and communication skills, with the ability to confidently work front of house and engage with a wide range of stakeholders

  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Outlook, Excel and Word

  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a broader site team

  • A hands-on approach and the ability to perform effectively under pressure

  • Current Class C Manual Driver's Licence

  • Full Australian working rights

  • Ability to pass a pre-employment medical and drug & alcohol screening

  • National Police Clearance, or willingness to obtain one

What We Offer

  • Permanent employment opportunities as vacancies become available

  • Competitive salary and roster arrangements

  • Accommodation and meals provided whilst on site

  • Access to village recreation facilities and amenities

  • Employee rewards and recognition through The Civeo Hive

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Training, development and career progression opportunities

  • Supportive team culture with a strong focus on safety

Our Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

At Civeo, we believe that our strength comes from the diversity of our people. We’re committed to creating a safe, inclusive and welcoming workplace where everyone - regardless of culture, background, gender, identity, age, ability or lived experience - feels valued, respected and able to thrive.

We celebrate different perspectives and are dedicated to ensuring equal opportunity across all stages of employment. Like leading organisations in our industry, we recognise that inclusive teams are safer, more innovative and more effective, and we actively work to remove barriers, mitigate bias and support fair outcomes for all.

We are proud to work closely with Traditional Owners and strongly encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants to apply.

About Us

Civeo Australia, a division of Civeo Corporation, provides workforce accommodation services globally. In Australia, Civeo has a national footprint of approximately 10,000 rooms across twelve villages in Queensland, New South Wales, and Western Australia. In addition, Civeo also operates approximately 16,500 rooms in client-owned properties in remote regions of Western Australia, South Australia and Queensland. With more than 40 years of experience, Civeo supports individuals who live and work away from home.

We're committed to fostering sustainable partnerships and inclusive opportunities in all the communities we operate in. By actively engaging with Traditional Owners and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Isander Peoples Businesses, we're not just operating accommodation villages, we're nurturing relationships that honour the rich cultural heritage of the land.

title: IT Graduate
description:
Do you want to work to make Power for Good?

We're the world's largest independent renewable energy company. We're guided by a simple yet powerful vision: to create a future where everyone has access to affordable, zero carbon energy.

We know that achieving our ambitions would be impossible without our people. Because we're tackling some of the world's toughest problems, we need the very best people to help us. They're our most important asset so that's why we continually invest in them.

RES is a family with a diverse workforce, and we are dedicated to the personal professional growth of our people, no matter what stage of their career they're at. We can promise you rewarding work which makes a real impact, the chance to learn from inspiring colleagues from across a growing, global network and opportunities to grow personally and professionally.

Our competitive package offers a wide range of benefits and rewards.

This is a hybrid role with 4 days per week spent in the Kings Langley office.

The position

Global Graduate Programme

The RES Global Graduate Programme is a two-year development programme designed to provide graduates with meaningful work experience, professional development and exposure to different areas of the renewable energy industry.

Over the course of the programme, graduates will complete three rotations of approximately eight months each across different areas. Each rotation is designed to build technical capability, commercial awareness and leadership potential while helping graduates develop a broad understanding of RES and the renewable energy industry.

Graduates will work on real projects, collaborate with experienced colleagues and be encouraged to take ownership of their development while making meaningful contributions to the business. Through a combination of structured learning, practical experience and professional development opportunities, graduates will build the skills and experience needed for a successful long-term career at RES.

Why Join RES?

Trusted from Day One

At RES, graduates are given meaningful work from the beginning. You will be trusted to contribute, encouraged to share your ideas and supported by leaders and colleagues who are invested in your success.

Challenge That Moves You Forward

The most significant learning happens through real work. Through exposure to different projects, teams and business challenges, you will develop the skills and experience needed to grow your career in renewable energy.

Purpose That Feels Real

You will contribute to projects that support the transition to affordable zero carbon energy. The work you do will have a visible connection to the future we are helping to create.

Inquisitive People. Real Care.

You will work alongside smart, curious and supportive colleagues who share their knowledge, invest in each other's development and create an environment where people can learn, grow and succeed together.

Rotation 1 – Data Modelling

Accountabilities

  • Design and build dimensional and semantic data models (star schemas) and Power BI semantic models over the Fabric Lakehouse.
  • Develop measures and certified metric definitions (DAX) that form part of the team's trusted, governed semantic layer.
  • Prepare and shape data within Microsoft Azure Fabric (Lakehouse, Dataflows Gen2) to the standard needed for reliable modelling, becoming self-sufficient with the data.
  • Ensure models are documented, tested and meet data-quality standards, working with the Data Governance & Quality Lead.
  • Use next Gen Technology and AI to automate and innovative with data modelling.
  • Own and deliver a defined data modelling project, under the Data Modeller / Analytics Engineer

Rotation 2- Analytics

Accountabilities

  • Deliver analysis, advanced analytics, reports and self-serve datasets that answer real business questions.
  • Use next Gen Technology and AI to automate and innovative with reporting and analytics.
  • Work directly with stakeholders across business domains (e.g. people & culture, operations) to shape requirements and deliver insight.
  • Build clear, trustworthy reports and advanced analytics and support the adoption of self-serve and AI-assisted analytics.
  • Communicate findings and data stories clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Own and deliver a defined analytics project, under the Analytics, Reporting & AI Lead.

Rotation 3 - AI

Accountabilities

  • Support machine learning and GenAI use cases, from scoping through to prototype, under the Senior AI/ML Engineer.
  • Contribute to making data AI-ready — metadata, descriptions, guardrails and evaluation — so AI tools return accurate, trustworthy answers.
  • Help deploy, monitor and evaluate models and AI/self-serve tooling, delivering value and identifying limitations.
  • Own and deliver a defined applied-AI or data-science project during the placement.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Interest in expanding your knowledge of the renewable energy industry
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team and to adapt to your different placement cycles with ease
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound attention to detail and a commitment to data quality
  • Foundational knowledge of SQL and data modelling concepts
  • Exposure to, or a keen interest in, the Microsoft analytics stack (Microsoft Fabric, Power BI)
  • Familiarity with a programming language such as Python
  • Foundational knowledge and experience in AI and data science, and their practical applications and limitations
  • Ability to manage your own time and deliver defined pieces of work with increasing autonomy
  • A proactive, self-starting attitude and willingness to learn across modelling, analytics and AI

Qualifications

Expected to achieve, or have recently completed, a bachelor’s degree in one of the following disciplines. Applicants should be able to demonstrate strong academic performance (minimum 2:1 classification) and a genuine interest in the renewable energy industry:

  • Data Science
  • Data Analytics
  • Artificial Intelligence or Machine Learning

Why RES?

  • A genuinely global data platform with real complexity and ambition behind it. A modern, cloud-first stack — Azure, Fabric, Synapse, and active investment in AI tooling.
  • Work that matters — your work will inform decisions at ExCo and Board level in a company actively fighting climate change.
  • Join a brand new, agile, global data and analytics team at the heart of AI, innovation, Next Gen technology and driving innovation for competitive advantage for RES.
  • You will have a diverse portfolio and be able to lead on many types of work, honing and developing strong skills in Artificial Intelligence to shape your future career at the forefront of the latest technologies.
  • A collaborative, cross-functional data function with architecture, AI, science, analytics, and engineering working closely together.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and commitment to your professional development.

The closing date for this role is 2nd October however we reserve the right to close this vacancy before the stated closing date should we receive a high volume of applications.

At RES we celebrate difference as we know it makes our company a great place to work. Encouraging applicants with different backgrounds, ideas and points of view, we create teams who work together to solve complex problems and design practical solutions for our clients. Our multiple perspectives come from many sources including the diverse ethnicity, culture, gender, nationality, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, marital status, parental status, education, social background and life experience of our people.

title: Developer - Filter Design
description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

We are now looking for an experienced Filter Designer with a deep interest in radio and RF filter design who wants to shape the next generations of 5G and 6G radio systems. You will work in Radio Design, responsible for research, development, and maintenance of radio units, together with global cross‑functional teams.

By joining our Team, an important part of your role will consist of developing filter products, technical solutions, and components. You will be involved in various development activities like requirement analysis and definition, design, integration, verification, and product documentation.

A large extent of our work is performed together with Ericsson’s teams from all over the world and several external suppliers. In this context, you will interface with radio design, antenna design, mechanical design, sourcing, and production. Co-operation with other design centers all over the World is our day-to-day reality and should represent an additional motivation for you to join our organization.

What you will do:

As a Filter Designer, you will be a key member of the team developing the next generation of RF filters integrated in Ericsson radio hardware. In this role, you will:

  • Design and develop high‑quality filter products, technical solutions, and components for our radio units.
  • Perform requirement analysis and definition, ensuring system and design requirements are correctly interpreted, allocated, and translated into testable verification objectives.
  • Simulate and develop new filter concepts and design solutions using industry‑standard RF tools (for example HFSS and ADS) together with Ericsson’s internal filter simulation and automation tools.
  • Review design solutions and drive continuous improvements of products, methods, and processes.
  • Perform integration, verification, and practical work with prototypes in collaboration with lab, production, and test engineering.
  • Contribute to pre‑development and technology studies, following and influencing developments in 5G and 6G radio systems.
  • Work with strategic technical leadership within the filter design domain, including mentoring less experienced colleagues and sharing best practices.
  • Support troubleshooting and customer cases within your technical area when needed.

The skills you bring:

  • At least a MSc in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Several years of experience from RF filter technologies, including design knowledge and fabrication processes.
  • Strong knowledge of radio and RF design, and a good understanding of cellular radio networks.
  • Proficiency with HFSS and ADS (or equivalent RF simulation tools).
  • Ability to interpret and apply system‑level requirements to the filter design domain, including traceability and verification planning.
  • Proven ability to work in cross‑functional, network‑oriented organizations and collaborate effectively across sites and cultures.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with external partners and suppliers.
  • Workable spoken and written English (Japanese language skills are a plus), comfortable presenting technical work and review outcomes with a passion for knowledge sharing and collaboration.
  • Experience or clear potential to take informal technical leadership, mentor others, and influence technical direction.
  • Familiarity with Lean & Agile ways of working.

Why join Ericsson?At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

What happens once you apply?Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Sr. Director, TSMC Customer Quality Head
description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.


What We Offer


Location:

Hsinchu,TWN, Kaohsiung,TWN, Taichung,TWN, Tainan,TWN

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Position Summary

Applied Materials is seeking an experienced senior leader to serve as the Global TSMC Customer Quality Head, responsible for leading worldwide customer quality engagement with TSMC and driving strategic alignment across global regions.

This role requires a highly experienced customer-facing leader with deep semiconductor industry knowledge, strong executive stakeholder management capabilities, and proven success leading global organizations. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience supporting TSMC as a strategic account, managing complex customer relationships, and driving cross-functional collaboration across international teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the Global TSMC Customer Quality Head and lead worldwide customer quality engagement for Applied Materials' strategic partnership with TSMC.
  • Build and maintain strong executive-level relationships with key TSMC stakeholders across global sites, acting as the primary customer quality representative and escalation point for critical issues.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a global organization of customer quality leaders and managers, driving alignment of strategies, priorities, best-known methods (BKMs), and operational execution across regions.
  • Ensure customer expectations, requirements, and business priorities are understood and effectively translated into actions across Engineering, Manufacturing, Service, Operations, Product Business Groups, and Quality organizations.
  • Drive the resolution of complex customer issues through cross-functional collaboration, balancing customer needs with business objectives while ensuring timely and effective outcomes.
  • Influence senior internal and external stakeholders to strengthen customer satisfaction, improve operational performance, and advance long-term strategic objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance customer quality performance, improve processes, and drive continuous improvement initiatives across the global organization.
  • Develop and execute customer quality strategies that support business growth, strengthen executive customer relationships, and reinforce Applied Materials' position as a trusted partner to TSMC.
  • Provide leadership in a highly matrixed global environment, ensuring consistent customer support and operational excellence across multiple regions and cultures.
  • Travel globally as required to support customer engagements, executive reviews, organizational leadership, and business-critical initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of semiconductor industry experience, with significant exposure to customer-facing leadership roles.
  • Proven experience supporting or managing strategic relationships with TSMC.
  • Extensive experience leading large organizations through multiple layers of management.
  • Demonstrated success managing global, cross-functional teams and complex stakeholder environments.
  • Strong executive communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to lead issue resolution involving multiple organizations, regions, and business units.
  • Experience operating in a highly matrixed global organization.

Travel Requirements

  • This is a highly global customer-facing role requiring flexibility to travel internationally as business needs dictate.
  • Frequent travel to customer locations and Applied Materials sites across Taiwan, the United States, Japan, Korea, Singapore, and other global regions is expected.​

Full time

Yes, 20% of the Time

Yes

title: Systems Engineering Student Placement (Powertrains)
description:
Red Bull Powertrains are offering a year-long placement opportunity within our Systems Engineering teams. In these hands-on roles you will be emersed into the heart of our state-of-the-art Technical and Testing facilities where we drive engineering and innovation to the limit to develop cutting-edge Formula 1 power units. Pushing boundaries is in our DNA!

We’re looking for individuals with a strong interest in areas such as internal combustion engine calibration, control systems engineering, embedded software development, plant modelling, data analysis, validation, and testing. This placement offers the opportunity to work across a broad range of disciplines including engineering, physics, mathematics, and data science while gaining hands-on experience in Power Unit engineering, product validation, durability testing and fault/failure investigation.

Your responsibilities will include:


• Contribute to all stages of the embedded control, calibration, and application process of optimising single cylinder and multi cylinder engines as well as hybrid power units - from controls strategy, embedded software validation, engine calibration and testing, to on track deployment of the 2027 Power Unit
• Work within a team of engineers to define and develop and test embedded software strategies for PU control and performance optimisation
• Applying engineering principles to understand the systems level interactions of the Power Unit to deliver on track reliability and performance
• Building and validating numerical methods for calibration and application analysis to maximise performance and reliability
• Interpreting and reporting data through technical documentation and presenting insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Collaborating closely with all the technical teams to deliver world-class engineering solutions
• Gaining direct exposure to the 2027 Formula 1 season and contributing to the future of Red Bull Powertrains

We’re looking for passionate, curious, and driven undergraduates who are eager to push the limits of engineering innovation in a fast paced, high-performance environment. If you're ready to take on real responsibility, solve real-world engineering challenges and contribute to the future of Red Bull Racing’s success on track, this is your opportunity.

Expected knowledge, experience & attributes of the successful candidates:


• Knowledge and experience from at least one year of undergraduate study on either an engineering, mathematics or physics degree course
• A solid understanding of engineering principles and the ability to apply mathematical methods to solve real-world problems
• Knowledge of Python, R, MATLAB, Simulink for system development and modelling
• Experience in programming in C or C++(preferred)
• Experience with handling and analysing data from simulations or physical tests, and confidence in preparing high-quality technical documentation
• Ability to break complex technical problems down to fundamental principles and understand the contributing physics
• Ability to demonstrate a genuine passion for engineering through involvement in extra-curricular projects, previous placements, or work experience
• Positive, can-do, attitude and willingness to learn new skills

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat monipuoliset rakennuspeltisepän työt erilaisilla kattotyömailla. Työssä pääset tekemään muun muassa pellityksiä, saumauksia sekä muita kattojen peltitöitä. Eteesi voi tulla vastaan myös julkisivupellityksiä. Kanttikoneen käyttö tulee olla sinulle tuttua ja rakennuspeltisepän perustöiden tulee sujua itsenäisesti.

Etsimme motivoitunutta ja oma-aloitteista tekijää, jolla on hyvä asenne työntekoon ja halu tehdä laadukasta jälkeä. Aikaisempi kokemus rakennuspeltisepän töistä on tehtävässä tärkeää, ja monipuolinen kokemus kattoalan töistä katsotaan eduksi.

Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian ja on aluksi määräaikainen. Hyvälle tekijälle on mahdollisuus vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Työkohteet sijaitsevat Turun alueella.

Palkka neuvotellaan kokemuksen mukaan.

Vision työntekijälupaus

Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, että työsopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!

Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

  • liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi kuluneelta viideltä vuodelta,
  • kerrot, miten aiemmissa työpaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua pärjäämään hakemassasi uudessa tehtävässä.

Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä

Jos haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, voit lähettää rekrytoinnista vastaavalle henkilölle sähköpostia otsikolla "Haettu työ" osoitteeseen Kristian Tikka / kristian.tikka(at)visiohr.fi / 0503746385. Olemme tavoitettavissa ma-pe klo 09.00-16.00.

Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

Visio — Aidosti läsnä alueellasi

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on valtakunnallisesti paikallinen. Tunnemme paikalliset työmarkkinat ja olemme aidosti läsnä alueellasi. Jos haet Varsinais-Suomessa työpaikkaa, siinä auttavat sinua Turusta käsin Jukka, Mikko, Kristian ja Marko.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Varsinais-Suomi on osa Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut -konsernia, joka on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys. Pelaamme reilua peliä ja tarjoamme töitä niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Yhdistämme työntekijät ja työnantajat niin, että molemmat löytävät juuri tarpeisiinsa sopivan ratkaisun. Yhteistyö perustuu kaikkien kolmen tahon keskinäiseen luottamukseen.

Jos haluat reilun työnantajan, joka arvostaa osaamistasi ja huomaa työpanoksesi, se on Visio.

You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems.   • Coordinate and communicate directly with customers

  • Fulfill additional duties, as assigned


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification

  • 4-7 years of work experience in semiconductor industry or other equipment support industry

  • Advanced mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, and/or thermodynamics

  • Strong knowledge of hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters

Physical Requirements:
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

Full time

Employee Type:

Assignee / Regular

Yes, 20% of the Time

Yes

This is a hybrid role with 4 days spent in the Kings Langley office.

The position

Global Graduate Programme

The RES Global Graduate Programme is a two-year development programme designed to provide graduates with meaningful work experience, professional development and exposure to different areas of the renewable energy industry.

Over the course of the programme, graduates will complete three rotations of approximately eight months each across different teams, functions or business areas. Each rotation is designed to build technical capability, commercial awareness and leadership potential while helping graduates develop a broad understanding of RES and the renewable energy industry. Graduates will work on real projects, collaborate with experienced colleagues and be encouraged to take ownership of their development while making meaningful contributions to the business. Through a combination of structured learning, practical experience and professional development opportunities, graduates will build the skills and experience needed for a successful long-term career at RES.

Why Join RES?

Trusted from Day One

At RES, graduates are given meaningful work from the beginning. You will be trusted to contribute, encouraged to share your ideas and supported by leaders and colleagues who are invested in your success.

Challenge That Moves You Forward

The most significant learning happens through real work. Through exposure to different projects, teams and business challenges, you will develop the skills and experience needed to grow your career in renewable energy.

Purpose That Feels Real

You will contribute to projects that support the transition to affordable zero carbon energy. The work you do will have a visible connection to the future we are helping to create.

Inquisitive People. Real Care.

You will work alongside smart, curious and supportive colleagues who share their knowledge, invest in each other's development and create an environment where people can learn, grow and succeed together.

Rotation 1 – UK&I Commercial

Accountabilities

During your time in UK&I Commercial, you will:

  • Support the development and maintenance of financial models for renewable energy projects, assets and business opportunities.
  • Assist with market, competitor and commercial analysis to inform business decisions and investment cases.
  • Contribute to the preparation of Investment Memorandums.
  • Support the review and negotiation of commercial agreements, contracts and route-to-market arrangements.
  • Work with Development, Construction, Operations and Asset Management teams to maximise project value and manage commercial risk.

Rotation 2 – UK&I Development

Accountabilities

During your time in UK&I Development, you will:

  • Support the development of renewable energy projects from early-stage development through to delivery.
  • Assist with project planning, financial evaluation and investment decision activities.
  • Contribute to landowner and stakeholder engagement and cross-functional project coordination.
  • Help maintain project documentation, reports and development plans.

Rotation 3 – EMEA Commercial

Accountabilities

During your time in EMEA Commercial, you will:

  • Support the development and review of financial models, valuations and investment cases across multiple countries and business units.
  • Assist with commercial, market and strategic analysis to support decision-making across the EMEA portfolio.
  • Support bids, tenders and strategic initiatives by providing analysis, reporting and commercial insight.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across EMEA to understand different markets, regulatory environments and commercial approaches.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Interest in expanding your knowledge of the renewable energy industry
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team and to adapt to your different placement cycles with ease

Qualifications

Expected to have recently completed, or be on track to complete, a bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant discipline, such as Engineering, Renewable Energy, Business, Commerce, Economics or Finance. Applicants should demonstrate strong academic performance (2:1 classification or equivalent preferred), commercial curiosity and a genuine interest in the renewable energy sector. A master’s degree is advantageous but not essential.

The closing date for this role is 2nd October however we reserve the right to close this vacancy before the stated closing date should we receive a high volume of applications.

At RES we celebrate difference as we know it makes our company a great place to work. Encouraging applicants with different backgrounds, ideas and points of view, we create teams who work together to solve complex problems and design practical solutions for our clients. Our multiple perspectives come from many sources including the diverse ethnicity, culture, gender, nationality, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, marital status, parental status, education, social background and life experience of our people.
