title: Caseworker - Integration
description:
Introduction

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Applications are welcome from internal and external candidates. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, internal and internal-equivalent candidates are considered as first-tier candidates.

Organizational Context and Scope

Established in 1951, IOM is the leading inter-governmental organization in the field of migration and works closely with governmental, intergovernmental and nongovernmental partners. IOM is dedicated to promoting humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It does so by providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

Under the overall supervision of the Chief of Mission (CoM) and Head of Unit in Dublin and direct supervision of the Senior Integration Associate, the successful candidate will be responsible for the support requirements of the project assisting Beneficiaries of Temporary Protection (BOTP’s) in Ireland.

This role will focus on facilitating the integration of BOTP’s in Ireland by promoting access to support services, language provision, and individualised assistance. The role will include other programme related responsibilities as required.

  1. Assist in the implementation and monitoring of project activities.
  2. Retrieve, compile, summarize, analyse, and present information/data on specific project topics.
  3. Support the Senior Integration Associate with the development and implementation of the integration strategy through research and additional support as required.
  4. Conduct comprehensive vulnerability assessments of BOTPs prior to intensive interventions, ensuring they receive essential information for informed decision-making. Provide individualized case support when feasible.
  5. Maintain coordination with diverse organizational units and external parties to initiate requests, obtain necessary clearances, process and follow-up on administrative actions, etc.
  6. Disseminate key and accurate information to BOTP’s. Ensure cases with vulnerabilities identified have been referred as necessary. Provide translation and interpretation services as necessary.
  7. Draft status reports, identifying shortfalls in delivery, bring them to the attention of the supervisor and suggest remedial actions.
  8. Draft correspondence on project issues; prepare and update reports, briefing notes, graphics, statistical tables, presentation and other forms of documentation.
  9. Respond to complex information requests and inquiries; set up and maintain files/records; organize meetings, workshops and training sessions;
  10. Participate in meetings and conferences; assist in coordinating implementation activities with local authorities, partners, United Nation agencies, intergovernmental and non-governmental organizations, donors and other stakeholders relevant to the project.
  11. Assist in monitoring work of implementing partners and report non-compliances to the supervisor.
  12. Provides guidance/training to new/junior staff.
  13. Perform other related duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Education

  • School diploma with five years of relevant experience; or,
  • Bachelor’s degree in Political or Social Sciences, International Relations, Development Studies, Migration Studies, Human Rights, Law or related fields from an accredited academic institution with three years of relevant professional experience.

Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database.

Experience

  • Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Good knowledge of information technology and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications especially Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Publisher.
  • Experience in working with migrants, refugees, internally displaced persons, victims of trafficking and other vulnerable groups; and,
  • Prior work experience with international humanitarian organizations, non-government or government institutions/organization in a multi-cultural setting is an advantage.

Skills

  • In depth knowledge of the broad range of migration related subject areas dealt with by the Organization; and,
  • Case management skills

Languages

All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish).

For this position, Fluency in English (both written and spoken) is required, along with fluency in Ukrainian and Russian.

Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.

Required Competencies

IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link. Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.

Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:

  • Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
  • Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
  • Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
  • Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.
  • Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.

Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 1

  • Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
  • Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
  • Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
  • Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.
  • Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.

Notes

Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category.

Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation.

This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months.

Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances.

This post is subject to local recruitment. Only those holding a valid residence and work permit for the country where this position is based will be eligible for consideration.

As the right to live and work in Ireland is required, the contract issued may be shorter that the period mentioned in the advertisement, in order to align with the expiry date of the work permit.

IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities.

IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts.

IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application.

No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

title: Senior Game Designer
description:
PLAY, GROW and WIN

To be a part of Virtuos means to be a creator.

At Virtuos, we harness the latest technologies to make games better and more immersive than ever before. That is why we pride ourselves in constantly pushing the boundaries of possibility since our founding in 2004.

Virtuosi is a team of experts – people who have come together to share their mutual passion for making and playing games. People with the same enthusiasm for exploring new ideas and the constant drive to excel in their field. People who believe in earning success through dedication.

At Virtuos, we are at the forefront of gaming, creating exciting new experiences daily. Join us to Play, Grow and Win – together.

ABOUT THE POSITION

  • Own the design of game mechanics and systems from concept through paper design, prototyping, implementation, tuning, and delivery.
  • Partner with level designers so each layout expresses its mechanic and drives player decisions.
  • Design competitive multiplayer rules, scoring, and match flow, and balance them for fairness and fun.
  • Design and tune the behavior parameters of AI-driven characters.
  • Design systems as data: define configurable parameters with clear value ranges so engineers can build them and QA can test their limits.
  • Write and maintain detailed design documentation to the client's template and standard.
    Define success metrics for each mechanic and use playtest feedback and telemetry data to tune it.
  • Review existing designs, identify gaps and risks, and propose improvements with clear reasoning.
  • Present designs to the client's design team and refine them together.
  • Work with engineers and artists to keep the implementation true to the design intent.
  • Work with QA to find, reproduce, and fix reported issues.
    Share knowledge and mentor other designers.
  • At least 5 years in a game design role.
  • Shipped at least one full-cycle title, from pre-production to launch, on console, PC, or a major mobile title in a game design role.
  • Proven ability to design within mobile constraints, shown through a shipped mobile title, a shipped mobile mode, or a strong portfolio project.
  • Strong grasp of core game systems, metagame systems, and control systems.
  • Experience designing and balancing competitive multiplayer mechanics.
  • Comfortable working in a data-driven, config-based game design pipeline.
  • Proficient in Unity.
  • Able to write clear, structured design documentation.
  • Able to build quick prototypes.
  • Proactive in taking on tasks and raising problems to the right stakeholders.
  • Able to take feedback, act on it, and give clear feedback to others.
  • Able to prioritize tasks and deliver quality work on time.
  • Mandarin Chinese, required for daily work with our client.
  • English at an adequate level, for meetings, documentation, and collaboration with English-speaking colleagues and clients. Native English fluency is not required.

Strongly preferred

  • Console or PC experience on a shipped AA or AAA title.
  • Scripting with Unity C# or Lua for prototyping and tuning.
  • Experience with designing mini games or user-generated content, professional or personal.
  • Experience shipping both single-player and multiplayer systems.

Bonus

  • Experience with other engines and scripting tools, such as Unreal Engine, Blueprints, or Godot.
  • Experience with UI/UX/HUD or monetization design.
  • Experience with level design or level integration.
  • Experience leading a game feature with a small team of designers or a cross-functional team.
  • Experience working across multiple studios in a co-development setting.
  • Experience working in an English-speaking environment.
  • Willing to travel and work at our other studios in China when a project needs it.

title: Toezichthouder
description:
Dit ben jij

Jij bent enthousiast, sociaal en alert. Je kunt goed zwemmen en grijpt direct in bij onveilige situaties in- en om het water. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt voor bezoekers en wordt blij als onze bezoekers blij zijn. Als ze een leuke dag hebben, ook omdat ons bad er tiptop bij ligt en alles loopt zoals het moet lopen. Jij zorgt voor een veilige en prettige zwemervaring voor iedereen! Je bent beschikbaar in de weekenden.

Dit ga je doen

Als toezichthouder maak je bewegen veilig. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze bezoekers met een glimlach binnenkomen én tevreden naar huis gaan. Met jouw enthousiasme, sociale houding en scherpe blik houd je toezicht tijdens zwemactiviteiten en draag je bij aan een veilige en prettige zwemervaring voor iedereen. Jij wordt blij als onze bezoekers blij zijn. Wanneer alles soepel verloopt, het bad er tiptop bij ligt en de sfeer prettig is, weet jij: missie geslaagd. Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig, houdt overzicht en grijpt direct in bij onveilige situaties. Tegelijk ben je hét aanspreekpunt voor onze bezoekers, een echte gastvrouw of gastheer. Dankzij jou is onze locatie een veilige en fijne plek om te recreëren, te zwemmen én te werken.

Wij geloven dat werk leuker is als je er plezier in hebt. Dat voel je bij ons, bij collega’s én bij onze gasten. Samen zorgen we voor een plek waar mensen komen om te sporten, te ontspannen en elkaar te ontmoeten. Jij speelt daarin een sleutelrol.

Wat breng je mee

  • Je bent minimaal 18 jaar

  • Je bent sociaal – Je bent goed in de omgang met jong en oud en spreekt bezoekers vriendelijk aan.

  • Je bent enthousiast – Jij straalt plezier uit en dat werkt aanstekelijk.

  • Je kunt goed zwemmen – Een belangrijke basis voor jouw rol als toezichthouder.

  • Je bent alert – Je kunt snel en adequaat handelen in noodsituaties.

  • Je bent leergierig – Je bent bereid de nodige diploma’s te halen, zoals reddend zwemmen (ZRZ) en EHBO.

  • Een VOG aanvragen – Je kunt zonder probleem een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag aanvragen.

Wat wij jou bieden

  • Een goed salaris – Een eerlijke beloning voor je inzet (CAO zwembaden).

  • Een baan dichtbij huis – Wij hebben in heel Nederland accommodaties.

  • Bijscholing en cursussen – Zo blijf je groeien in je vak.

  • 25 vakantiedagen – Een goede werk-privébalans.

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden – Zet stappen in jouw carrière.

  • Een gezellig team – Samen werken jullie aan een vitaal Nederland.

Interesse?

Is dit echt iets voor jou? Solliciteer dan snel via de roze button en laat je gegevens achter!

Ken je iemand die perfect bij deze functie past? Stuur deze vacature dan door – daar doe je ons én die persoon waarschijnlijk een groot plezier mee!

title: Emballeur
description:
Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze machines veilig en netjes op reis gaan. Met oog voor detail en een praktische aanpak geef je elke machine de juiste verpakking. Zo komt alles onbeschadigd aan en maak jij klanten blij met topkwaliteit, elke dag opnieuw.


Wij zijn een innovatief familiebedrijf dat wereldwijd de pluimveehouderij duurzamer en diervriendelijker wil maken - met oog voor efficiëntie en welzijn van dier en boer.

Jouw carrière

  • Een flinke dosis vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

title: Full Stack Developer (Next.js / React / TypeScript)
description:
At Mountain Warehouse we understand that technology is core to our success as a business and so we invest heavily in our in-house team. The development department is divided into product-based teams, all using variants on Kanban for project prioritisation and a focus on continuous delivery, mostly with usage of microservices.

We are a collaborative team with a strong culture of code review, occasional usage of pair programming and lots of unit tests. We're keen to write code following best practice and to continuously find ways that we can be even better. The work is a mixture of green-field and legacy projects (much like any other mature organisation) mostly using Next.js, React, TypeScript, C#, MongoDB and SQL Server, with a combination of monolithic and microservices architectures.



We are looking for a technically strong Next.js Full Stack Developer to join the Web Development team. This role is for somebody with deep commercial experience of Next.js and modern React development who enjoys solving difficult technical problems and understands how modern web applications behave in production, particularly around rendering, caching, performance, application architecture and framework evolution.

Whilst the focus of the role is our Next.js applications, we work across a broader full-stack environment and would expect successful candidates to contribute more widely over time, working with backend services, APIs, integrations and other technologies across our platform.
  • 3+ years of commercial software development experience within a full-stack environment.
  • Proven experience building and deploying production applications using React, TypeScript and Next.js (App Router).
  • Strong understanding of modern Next.js architecture, including Server Components, Client Components, routing and data-fetching approaches.
  • Good understanding of rendering, caching and performance considerations in modern Next.js applications.
  • Able to make informed implementation decisions around rendering, caching and server-side behaviour, and diagnose issues in complex web applications.
  • Experience integrating frontend applications with APIs and backend services.
  • Understands the difference between React concerns, Next.js concerns, application concerns and service concerns.
  • Experience with modern Git workflows and collaborative software development practices.
  • Effective communicator who understands project goals and can explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Pragmatic problem solver with a strong desire to create high-quality, tested code.
Whilst deep expertise in Next.js, React and TypeScript is important for this role, you'll also be working within a broader full-stack environment. Let us know what you have experience of; we can train in the rest.

  • C#
  • MongoDB and SQL Server
  • Microservices architecture
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes in Azure
  • Vercel
  • Jenkins / BitBucket Pipelines for CI/CD
  • RabbitMQ / MassTransit
  • Microfrontends
  • Test Driven Development
  • RESTful API design
  • GraphQL APIs
  • Integrations with third-party APIs and SaaS platforms


  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Hybrid working, 3 days in London based office & 2 working from home
  • Holiday allowance
  • 50% staff discount & 25% for family and friends
  • Pension scheme

title: Tuinier - specialist
description: Elke tuin is voor jou een plek waar je graag bent. Je haalt voldoening uit planten die gezond groeien, borders die er verzorgd bijliggen en een tuin die elk seizoen tot zijn recht komt. En kom je een bijzondere plant tegen? Dan wil je er graag meer over weten. Want voor jou is tuinieren niet zomaar een job, maar een vak waar je trots op bent. Mogen we je voorstellen aan de grootste botanische tuin van het land? Welkom in Plantentuin Meise. Hier groeien zomaar even 20.000 plantensoorten uit de hele wereld, verspreid over prachtige tuinen, borders, landschappen en unieke plantencollecties. Als tuinier-specialist zorg jij er samen met de vrouwen en mannen uit je team voor dat onze tuinen er elke dag op hun best uitzien. Je onderhoudt borders, plantvakken en groenaanleg, zodat bezoekers elk seizoen kunnen genieten van een verzorgde en inspirerende omgeving. Jouw job gaat verder dan het klassieke groenonderhoud. Je werkt mee aan het beheer van bijzondere wetenschappelijke en educatieve plantencollecties. Daarbij bouw je inhoudelijke kennis op over de planten die je v erzorgt: je weet welke soorten je voor je hebt, kent hun specifieke noden en verdiept je in de collectie. Je vraagt, in overleg met de wetenschappelijk beheerder, plantmateriaal of specifieke stukken op wanneer dat nodig is en draagt zo actief bij aan het behoud en de uitbouw van bijzondere wetenschappelijke en educatieve plantencollecties. Het verschil zit dus niet alleen in een netjes geschoren haag of gemaaid gras, maar ook in jouw nieuwsgierigheid en interesse voor wat er groeit. Of je nu onkruid wiedt, snoeit, aanplant of de ideale groeiomstandigheden creëert voor zeldzame planten: jouw vakmanschap maakt het verschil. Je werkt bovendien regelmatig samen met vrijwilligers en stuurt hen mee aan tijdens de dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Dankzij je sterke sociale vaardigheden communiceer je vlot met verschillende mensen en neem je hierin op een natuurlijke manier de leiding. Uiteraard werk je ook graag buiten en ben je niet bang om de handen uit de mouwen te steken. Tijdens de werkuren draag je de nodige werkkledij en persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen. Tot slot sta je ervoor open dat je vakmanschap voortdurend kan groeien en ben je bereid om opleidingen te volgen wanneer de job dat vereist. Geloof ons maar: het gras is écht groener in Plantentuin Meise. Zeker dankzij jouw goede zorgen. Lees hieronder meer over het gezochte profiel en de selectieprocedure.

title: Patient Navigator
description:
Position Purpose:

The Patient Navigator role is designed to provide comprehensive support to clients by identifying their needs and guiding them through our appropriate administrative systems and patient support services. title: Sr C# Developer
description:
This is a remote position.

Job Description: Senior C# Developer (Java to C# Migration)

Role

Senior C# Developer with deep Java background

Focus

Migrating Java microservices to C# / .NET, using AI-assisted code conversion plus hands-on rework

Level

Senior (8+ years)

Openings

TBD, initial ask is for one or more senior developers

Location

US preferred; India considered (fill in per staffing plan)

Engagement type

Contract / staff augmentation, duration tied to conversion effort

Client

Confidential. Do not disclose client name or architecture to candidates before submission

About the engagement

The client runs a set of Java microservices and wants to convert them to C# following their in-house C# patterns and conventions. The plan is to run the Java code through an AI-assisted conversion pipeline to get a first pass (they expect roughly 50 percent, not a finished product), then have senior developers review, correct, and complete the conversion so the C# services are production ready. The client will supply the target C# patterns, so the developer needs to read both languages fluently and translate idioms, not just syntax.

What you will do

• Convert Java microservices to C# / .NET, using AI-generated first drafts as a starting point and finishing them by hand to the client's coding patterns.

• Review AI-converted output for correctness, missed edge cases, hallucinated APIs, and behavior drift between the Java original and the C# result.

• Map Java constructs and libraries to their .NET equivalents (Spring to ASP.NET Core, Maven/Gradle to NuGet, JPA/Hibernate to Entity Framework, etc.).

• Preserve service contracts: REST endpoints, message formats, error handling, logging, and config behave the same after conversion.

• Write or port unit and integration tests to prove functional parity before and after migration.

• Help shape the conversion approach: prompt templates, pattern libraries, and review checklists so the process scales across many services without one-off effort.

• Work directly with client engineers, explain trade-offs plainly, and flag where a straight conversion is the wrong call.

Must have

• Deep Java: 8+ years building production Java microservices (Spring Boot or similar). Can read unfamiliar Java code and explain what it does and why.

• Strong C# / .NET: 5+ years hands-on with C# and .NET Core / .NET 6+, ASP.NET Core Web APIs, dependency injection, async patterns.

• Real migration experience: Has personally converted or re-platformed code between languages or frameworks, not just maintained the result.

• Microservices and REST: API design, service-to-service communication, containerization (Docker), CI/CD.

• Testing discipline: Comfortable proving parity with automated tests, not visual inspection.

• Communication: Works independently, translates technical detail for business stakeholders, gives direct feedback.

Nice to have

• Experience using AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) for code conversion or large refactors, and an honest view of where they fail.

• Familiarity with LLM-assisted development workflows: prompt design, output validation, agentic coding tools.

• Kubernetes, AWS or Azure, API gateways (Kong).

• Exposure to MySQL and SQL Server.

• Exposure to Python (helpful for tooling around the conversion pipeline).

title: Receptiemedewerker
description:
Dit ben jij

Je bent het visitekaartje van onze accommodatie. Je ontvangt gasten met een glimlach, beantwoordt vragen en helpt bezoekers op weg. Je werkt nauwkeurig, blijft vriendelijk bij drukte en schakelt snel tussen verschillende taken. Je bent beschikbaar in de weekenden.

Dit ga je doen

Als receptiemedewerker maak je bewegen gastvrij. Als onze gasten jou zien, voelen ze zich al welkom. Jij bent het eerste gezicht dat ze zien, en je weet wat ze zeggen over eerste indrukken. Met jouw glimlach en gastvrije houding zorg je ervoor dat elke bezoeker zich direct op z’n gemak voelt. Je ontvangt gasten, beantwoordt vragen aan de balie én aan de telefoon en helpt bezoekers op weg, zodat hun dag soepel en plezierig begint. Af en toe spring je bij in de horeca, en natuurlijk houd je jouw werkomgeving netjes en overzichtelijk. Je werkt met onze kassa’s, dus jij weet (of leert) precies hoe ze werken. Ook kun je goed overweg met computers en vind je het leuk om meerdere dingen tegelijk te regelen. Wordt het druk? Dan blijf jij vriendelijk, schakel je snel en houd je het overzicht, precies wat onze gasten nodig hebben.

Wij geloven dat werk leuker is als je er plezier in hebt. Dat voel je bij ons, bij collega’s én bij onze gasten. Samen zorgen we voor een plek waar mensen komen om te sporten, te ontspannen en elkaar te ontmoeten. Jij speelt daarin een sleutelrol.

Wat breng je mee

  • Je bent sociaal – Je houdt van mensen en maakt makkelijk contact.

  • Je bent servicegericht – Jij vindt het leuk om bezoekers te helpen en denkt in oplossingen.

  • Je communiceert sterk – Je kunt helder en vriendelijk uitleggen, aan de balie én telefonisch.

  • Je kunt overweg met kassa’s en computers – Je leert systemen snel en werkt nauwkeurig.

  • Je bent leergierig – Je bent bereid cursussen te volgen; wij investeren in jou!

  • Je bent flexibel – Je bent ook in de avonden en weekenden beschikbaar; uiteraard houden wij rekening met jouw privéleven.

  • Een VOG aanvragen – Je kunt zonder probleem een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag aanvragen.

Wat wij jou bieden

  • Een supergezellige en sportieve werkomgeving – Geen dag is hetzelfde!

  • Een goed salaris – Een fijne beloning voor je inzet (CAO zwembaden).

  • Flexibele werktijden – Perfect te combineren met studie of privéleven.

  • 25 vakantiedagen – Voor een goede werk-privébalans.

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden – Zet stappen in jouw carrière.

  • Een gezellig team – Samen zorgen jullie voor een fijne sfeer en tevreden gasten.

Interesse?

Is dit echt iets voor jou? Solliciteer dan snel via de roze button en laat je gegevens achter!

Ken je iemand die perfect bij deze functie past? Stuur deze vacature dan door – daar doe je ons én die persoon waarschijnlijk een groot plezier mee!

title: Työhön osallistuva työnjohtaja, Pääkaupunkiseutu
description:
Haemme työhön osallistuvaa työnjohtajaa asiakkaallemme pääkaupunkiseudulle.

Oletko vastuuntuntoinen ja käytännönläheinen tekijä, jolta löytyy aikaisempaa kokemusta teollisuuden työjohtotehtävistä ja kykyä organisoida päivittäistä toimintaa?

Työtehtävät:

Toimit työhön osallistuvan työnjohtajan tehtävissä vaihtelevissa teollisuuden kohteissa pääkaupunkiseudulla telakasta tehtaisiin. Organisoit päivittäistä työntekoa ja pidät huolta aikatauluissa pysymisestä. Esihenkilövastuiden lisäksi osallistut suurtehoimurointiin ja korkeapainepesuihin ja pystyt operoimaan myös imuautoa. Työ on fyysisesti raskasta, jonka vuoksi edellytämme hakijalta hyvää peruskuntoa ja reipasta otetta työntekoon.
Työajat ovat pääsääntöisesti klo 07.00–15.30, mutta työn vaihtelevan luonteen vuoksi toivomme sinulta tarvittaessa joustavuutta työajoissa.

Tarjoamme:

- Toistaiseksi voimassa olevan kokoaikaisen työsopimuksen
- Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimukseen pohjautuvan palkkauksen
- monipuoliset työtehtävät ja esihenkilövastuuta
- Työterveyden

Tuntipalkka neuvoteltavissa kokemukseen perustuen, n. 2500-3000€ kuukaudessa.

Edellytämme:

- C-ajokorttia
- Digipiirturia
- Voimassa olevia ammattipätevyyksiä
- Korkeaa työmoraalia
- Valmiutta fyysiseen työhön ja hyvää peruskuntoa
- Organisointikykyä
- Työturvallisuuskorttia
- Aikaisempaa kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä

Kolahtiko?

Kuulostaa hyvältä, mutta miksi hakisin töitä juuri Amikon kautta?

Amiko tarjoaa kaiken tasoisille ammattilaisille laajan valikoiman töitä. Olemme sinulle reilu, luotettava ja joustava työelämän kumppani. Amikolla on hyvä maine työmarkkinoilla. Pyrimme aina etsimään parhaat mahdolliset ratkaisut työllistymisesi tueksi. Amikolaisena saat:

• Vähintään TES:in mukaisen palkkauksen-palkkausjärjestelmämme on kannustava, joskus jopa suurempi kuin työllistyessä suoraan yrityksen palkkalistoille.

• Laajasti erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia- meillä on kattavat verkostot ja laaja työpaikkavalikoimaniin osa-aikaisia, kokopäiväisiä kuin sesonkitöitä monelta eri alalta. Kun sopiva työ löytyy, monille tarjoutuu myös mahdollisuus siirtyä vakituiseksi työntekijäksi asiakasyritykseen.

• Oman yhteyshenkilön ja yksilöllistä työnhakua – Amikolta saat henkilökohtaista palvelua ja oman tutun yhteyshenkilön, johon voit olla suoraan yhteydessä.

• Kattavat työterveyspalvelut, normaalin eläkekertymän ja sairausajan palkan sairauden sattuessa – Vaikka teetkin työsi asiakasyrityksessämme, olet amikolainen ja kannamme sinusta vastuun ja huolehdimme eduistasi.

• … vai kenties jotain ihan uutta urallesi? Autamme myös alanvaihdossa. Räätälöidyt uravalmennukset auttavat päivittämään osaamistasi ja löytämään uuden suunnan urallasi.

Voisiko tässä olla sinulle uusi työpaikka?

Toimimme asiakkaallemme rekrytointikumppanina, käsittelemme saapuvat työhakemukset sekä vastaamme ensimmäisen vaiheen haastatteluista. Jätäthän hakemuksesi pikimmiten ja nappaa itsellesi uusi huippuduuni!

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivien henkilön löydyttyä.

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse vastaanotettuja hakemuksia vaan jätäthän hakemuksen nettisivujemme kautta tietosuojasyistä.

Please note that we do not process applications submitted by e-mail, so please submit your application via our website for privacy and data protection reasons.

title: Care Team Specialist
description:
Location: Crocker Residential Care, Skid-Row: Downtown Los Angeles, CA

Position Purpose:

The Care Team Specialist (CTS) at Crocker Residential plays a vital role in fostering a safe, supportive, and dignified environment for our residents in a home-like RCFE setting. Grounded in a harm reduction approach and a “do whatever it takes” mindset, the CTS serves as a compassionate, observant presence, monitoring shared spaces, upholding facility rules, and ensuring compliance with licensing standards. Through proactive relationship building, trauma-informed engagement, and non-violent conflict de-escalation, the CTS helps maintain a respectful and stable community. Responsibilities include maintaining accurate sign-in/out logs, conducting safety checks of rooms and belongings, leading emergency preparedness drills, and documenting incidents with care and precision.

Program Population:

The Crocker Residential Care is a licensed Residential Care Facility for the Elderly (RCFE) that provides 24/7 non-medical care and supervision to adults aged 60 and older who live with chronic health conditions. Our program offers a home-like environment with assistance in activities of daily living (ADLs), medication reminders, and a focus on social engagement and independence.

Principal Responsibilities:

  1. Establish a positive rapport with participants, providing a safe and supportive environment.
  2. Apply harm reduction and trauma-informed care principles in all interactions.
  3. Monitor common areas and building perimeter to ensure participant safety and security.
  4. Provide crisis intervention and de-escalation support using nonviolent techniques.
  5. Consistently monitor and enforce the facility’s House Rules and ensure ongoing compliance with all licensing regulations required for Crocker’s operation as a licensed RCFE.
  6. Maintain sign-in/out logs for participants and visitors at the front desk.
  7. Conduct belongings searches and room checks as needed to uphold safety protocols.
  8. Serve as floor lead during fire drills, evacuations, and emergency situations.
  9. Complete detailed reports on incidents, participant concerns, and program operations.
  10. Assist with participant intake, engagement, and connection to supportive services.
  11. Facilitate communication between participants and care team members.
  12. Respond to participant concerns with empathy, de-escalation strategies, and problem-solving techniques.
  13. Ensure program areas remain clean, organized, and welcoming.
  14. Collaborate with emergency responders, behavioral health teams, and harm reduction specialists as needed.
  15. Maintain strict confidentiality and adhere to all organizational policies.
  16. Utilize AIDET (Acknowledge, Introduce, Duration, Explanation, and Thank You) principles in all participant and team interactions.
  17. Other duties as assigned.

Physical Demands:

  1. Stand or walk for extended periods on various surfaces (tile, concrete, carpet).
  2. Climb stairs, ramps, or ladders as needed.
  3. Kneel, squat, bend, and run if necessary.
  4. Lift or carry up to 50- 70 lbs. occasionally.
  5. Use hands, arms, and fingers for reaching, handling, and grasping objects.

Requirements:

  1. High school diploma or equivalent
  2. Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness.
  3. Strong communication skills, particularly in de-escalation and crisis intervention.
  4. Ability to work with individuals actively using substances in a nonjudgmental, harm reduction-focused manner.
  5. Ability to work in a non-traditional clinical setting (e.g., outdoor park-lets, drop-in spaces).
  6. Demonstrated knowledge of harm reduction, trauma-informed care, and housing-first principles.
  7. Proficiency in basic computer skills (email, data entry, Microsoft Word/Excel).
  8. Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends.
  9. Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.

Additional Requirements:

Applicants should be aware that Crocker Residential is a pet-friendly environment. On occasion, employees may be working around friendly pets. Applicants should have no severe allergies to or significant fear of dogs.

*All JWCH, Wesley Health Centers workforce members are recommended to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19.

Employee Benefits:

At JWCH Institute, Inc., we believe in taking care of those who take care of others. If you work 30+ hours per week, you’ll enjoy competitive pay and a robust benefits package that includes:

title: Data & AI Architect – Life Sciences
description:
About the role

We are looking for a Manager / Senior Data & AI Architect to join our Barcelona team and help us grow one of BIP Iberia’s strategic areas: the application of Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence within Life Sciences.

This is not a pure architecture role. We are looking for someone who combines strong technical depth with business understanding, client-facing skills and a pre-sales/commercial mindset. Someone who can design a robust architecture, defend it with a client, understand the business problem behind it and guide the team until the solution is successfully delivered and operational.

The role will be part of BIP's Global Data & AI team, with a strong focus on working closely with our local teams in Barcelona and across Spain, while collaborating with colleagues and specialists across Portugal, Italy and other BIP geographies.

Your mission

Act as a Data & AI reference for Life Sciences, connecting strategy, business and technology. You will be involved from early client conversations and pre-sales through architecture definition, delivery and the evolution of production solutions.

You will also help build capabilities, reusable assets, propositions and references that strengthen our position in the Life Sciences market.

What you will do

Design end-to-end Data, Analytics and AI architectures covering data platforms, lakehouse, integration, governance, advanced analytics, Machine Learning, GenAI and AI agents.

Translate Life Sciences business needs into concrete, scalable, secure and measurable technology solutions.

Act as a trusted technical advisor for CIOs, CDOs, Data & AI leaders, business stakeholders and architecture teams.

Play an active role in pre-sales: discovery, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, estimates, proposals, roadmaps, high-level architectures, demos, PoCs and executive presentations.

Work jointly with commercial leaders and Partners to identify and mature opportunities, bringing technical credibility and sector knowledge.

Provide technical leadership to multidisciplinary teams including Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, ML Engineers and AI specialists.

Define architecture standards and patterns across security, integration, observability, MLOps/LLMOps, governance and data quality.

Support solutions through production, ensuring operability, performance, security, cost control and long-term scalability.

Contribute to the growth of the Data & AI practice in Barcelona and to BIP’s international Life Sciences collaboration.

Mentor junior colleagues and raise the technical bar through design reviews, best practices and knowledge sharing.

Industry knowledge – Life Sciences

Relevant experience or strong knowledge of the Life Sciences sector is important. The successful candidate should understand key business processes, industry challenges and the regulatory context in which clients operate.

Experience in Pharma, Biotech, MedTech, Healthcare or related environments.

Understanding of Data & AI use cases across R&D, clinical, medical affairs, commercial, market access, supply chain, manufacturing, quality or patient/healthcare analytics.

Ability to work with sensitive data and regulated environments, with awareness of privacy, traceability, quality, governance and compliance principles.

Knowledge of scientific, clinical, commercial or healthcare data ecosystems will be highly valued.

Essential requirements

Strong experience, ideally 7+ years, across Data, Analytics, Cloud or AI, with increasing responsibility in architecture and/or technical leadership.

Proven experience or strong domain knowledge in Life Sciences, with an understanding of the sector's key business processes, data ecosystems, and regulatory context.

Proven experience designing modern data solutions: data lake/lakehouse, data warehouse, streaming, APIs and integration, batch and real-time processing, modelling and governance.

Deep knowledge of at least one major hyperscaler (Azure, AWS or Google Cloud) and the ability to operate in multi-cloud environments.

Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, BigQuery or equivalent technologies.

Strong SQL skills and solid Python knowledge; practical understanding of Spark and distributed architectures.

Knowledge of AI/ML and GenAI architectures, including LLMs, RAG, agents, vector search, evaluation, guardrails, observability and industrialisation patterns.

Strong client-facing experience and the ability to communicate complex decisions to both technical and executive audiences.

Hands-on experience in technical pre-sales and in preparing and defending proposals.

Professional English at a minimum C1 level. Professional Spanish. Italian or Portuguese is a plus.

Availability to work in a hybrid model based in Barcelona and to travel occasionally depending on client/project needs.

Nice to have

Previous experience in technology or strategy consulting.

Commercial or business development experience within Data & AI.

Relevant certifications across Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks, Snowflake or other leading platforms.

Experience in Data Governance, Data Mesh, catalogues, MDM, data quality and data-product-oriented architectures.

Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD, DevOps and platform automation.

Knowledge of FinOps and performance/cost optimisation.

Ability to build accelerators, assets and reusable solutions.

International experience, with a track record of working with stakeholders across different geographies and multicultural environments.

Personal capabilities

Consulting mindset and client orientation: listen, structure ambiguous problems and turn them into actionable decisions.

Technical credibility: ability to go deep when required while maintaining an end-to-end perspective.

Business orientation: understanding that architecture is a means to create impact, not an end in itself.

Communication and influencing skills: confidently present and defend proposals to technical teams, business stakeholders and senior management.

Commercial and pre-sales mindset: comfortable participating in opportunity discussions and shaping a compelling value proposition.

Leadership without hierarchy: ability to mobilise teams, make decisions and build trust.

Pragmatism, autonomy and end-to-end ownership.

Curiosity and continuous learning in a fast-moving technology environment.

What we offer

A strategic role supporting the growth of Data & AI and Life Sciences within BIP Iberia.

High client exposure and direct participation in relevant transformation initiatives.

Real opportunity to influence the development of the practice and new business opportunities.

Collaboration with international teams and specialists across multiple geographies.

Data, Analytics, AI and GenAI projects using leading technologies.

Professional development, training and support for certifications.

Hybrid working model based in Barcelona, with flexibility aligned to project needs.

Competitive compensation aligned with experience and responsibility.

Why BIP?

Growth & Learning

Access to 300+ courses on emerging technologies and business topics, personalized development programs, and continuous training initiatives to support your professional and personal growth.

Flexibility & Work-Life Integration

Hybrid working model with flexibility to balance remote and office work in agreement with your manager and project needs, plus initiatives supporting work-life balance.

Health & Benefits

Private health insurance, wellness platforms, meal vouchers, and an attractive benefits package.

Family & Parenthood

Support for new parents, including enhanced parental leave benefits and dedicated initiatives during and after parental leave.

Inclusion & Values

We promote uniqueness and equal opportunities for everyone. We are committed to creating an ethical, inclusive, and welcoming work environment.

Next Steps

Once we receive your CV, we will carefully review your profile. If there is a match with this or other open positions within the Group, we will contact you to start our mutual introduction process.

The selection process generally includes an HR interview, a technical interview with a Line Manager, and potentially a final interview with a Partner. The number and order of interviews may vary.

About Us

Founded in 2003, BIP combines the historical excellence of management consulting with innovation and digitalization. Today we are more than 6.500 professionals across 13 countries, delivering over 4,500 projects worldwide.

We support our clients in driving large-scale impact through Digital Transformation, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Industry 4.0, IoT, and disruptive technologies across all industries.

title: Ondersteunend begeleider, flexpool regio Waardenland
description:
Onze missie is om mensen met een verstandelijke beperking het gewone leven te laten ervaren. Wil je hieraan bijdragen en ben je op zoek naar een flexibele baan waarbij je invloed hebt op je eigen rooster? Maak dan kennis met ASVZ! Werken in de zorg is werken met je hoofd, hart en handen.

Werken in de flexpool van ASVZ houdt in dat je op verschillende locaties met verschillende doelgroepen kan worden ingezet. Je komt vaak in team te werken met roosterproblematiek. Dit vraagt van jou dat je gelijk de werkzaamheden ziet die er gedaan moeten worden en deze ook uitvoert. Samen met een collega van de locatie waar je gaat werken, draai je gezamenlijk de dienst. Afhankelijk van je werkplek werk je samen met een collega of alleen.

Werkplek
De ene dag sta je op een woning midden in een woonwijk met cliënten met een lichte verstandelijke beperking, de andere dag op een woning op een ASVZ terrein met cliënten met ernstig (meervoudig) verstandelijke beperking. Zo zijn je taken ook elke dag weer anders. Samen boodschappen doen en voetballen, maar ook helpen bij het douchen en voorlezen. Als begeleider zorg je ervoor dat je iedere dag weer aansluit bij de behoeftes van de cliënten.

Wanneer je komt te werken in de flexpool, houden we rekening met je expertise en voorkeur in doelgroep. Aan de hand daarvan worden jouw diensten ingedeeld.

Bijzonderheden
Eigen auto heeft de voorkeur.


Natuurlijk houden we rekening met de reisafstand en hoef je nooit verder dan een uur met het ov te reizen. De dagen en uren die je werkt worden in overleg met jou ingepland.

Werken in onze flexpool betekent afwisseling. Je kunt worden ingezet op onze locaties onder andere in Sliedrecht, Dordrecht, Hardinxveld, Gorinchem en Leerdam.

Wie zoeken we?
Je bent sensitief: je voelt aan wat de (onvervulde) behoeften achter het gedrag van bewoners is. Vanuit (zelf)vertrouwen neem je verantwoorde risico’s. Je bent sterk in zelfreflectie en neemt je verantwoordelijkheid. Als flexpoolmedewerker ben je flexibel inzetbaar in zowel de ochtenduren, avonduren, weekenden en feestdagen.

  • Je hebt ervaring in de zorg of volgt een zorg gerelateerde opleiding;

  • Je weet wat aanpakken en je kunt luisteren, observeren en handelen;

  • Je bent een teamspeler die ook zelfstandig kan werken;

  • Je kunt je vinden in de visie van ASVZ en draagt deze uit;

  • Je kunt omgaan met gedragsproblemen en structuur bieden aan bewoners;

  • Je biedt directe ondersteuning bij de persoonlijke verzorging van bewoners.

We werken volgens onze behandelmethodiek Triple-C.

Wat krijg je?

  • Je krijgt een tijdelijk contract (voor 7 maanden) met uitzicht op een vaste aanstelling;

  • Afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring verdien je bij ons een bruto maandsalaris van maximaal €3.678,- (FWG 30/35/40);

  • 8% vakantiegeld, 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering en uiteraard onregelmatigheidstoeslag (ORT);

  • ASVZ biedt veel interne en externe scholingsmogelijkheden, zoals training in Triple-C en weerbaarheidstraining;

  • Aandacht voor jouw persoonlijke groei vinden we ook belangrijk. Daarom kun je deelnemen aan allerlei activiteiten uit ons vitaliteitsprogramma zoals yoga en padel.

Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan direct!
Zie jij jezelf als medewerker flexpool bij ons aan de slag gaan? Laat het ons weten door het digitale sollicitatieformulier in te vullen!

Onderdeel van de procedure voor deze vacature is een online assessment waarmee je inzicht krijgt in de kwaliteiten die jij meebrengt.

Nog vragen?
Neem dan contact op met Barbera Wemmers, teamleider via 06-12713289.

title: Client Aide-Cecil Hotel
description:
Location: Cecil Hotel, Downtown Los Angeles (CA)

Position Purpose:

Under the supervision of the Nurse Manager and Program Director, the Client Aide has the responsibility to engage with patients and to assist in delivering personalized attention and support to patients living at the Cecil Hotel / Safe Landing Program. The Client Aide will help patients with daily living activities, mobility assistant, medication reminders, companionship, light housekeeping, safety monitoring, and promote physical, mental and emotional well-being.

Program Population:

The Cecil Hotel/Safe Landing is an Interim Housing program that aids homeless individuals in their recovery journey, helping them improve their health conditions and enhance their social and Activities of Daily Living (ADL) skills. Some of these individuals may also grapple with mental health and substance use issues, which can occasionally manifest in behaviors such as yelling, using strong language, and displaying anger outbursts. The core responsibility of each staff member at the Cecil Hotel is to support clients in overcoming obstacles and improving their coping mechanisms, thereby reducing negative behaviors.

Principal Responsibilities:

  1. Build trust and rapport with participants through respectful, patient-centered interactions.
  2. Provide support with mobility and navigation within the site, assisting participants in accessing meals, rest areas, showers, laundry, and transportation for off-site appointments.
  3. Assist with personal care tasks, such as dressing, hygiene, and grooming, in alignment with participants’ needs and preferences.
  4. Offer meal assistance when needed, ensuring participants have access to food in a dignified manner.
  5. Observe and document participants' physical and emotional well-being, noting any changes and communicating concerns to the care team.
  6. Promote participant safety and comfort, ensuring communal spaces are clean and accessible.
  7. Engage with participants without judgment, respecting their autonomy and lived experiences.
  8. Utilize harm reduction principles to support participants in making informed decisions about their health and well-being.
  9. Respond to participant needs with de-escalation techniques and nonviolent crisis intervention strategies.
  10. Maintain a safe, welcoming, and low-barrier environment where participants feel respected and supported.
  11. Accurately document participant interactions, observations, and changes in condition in compliance with program policies.
  12. Follow confidentiality protocols, ensuring participant information is shared only with authorized personnel.
  13. Adhere to program policies and procedures, including attendance, safety, and emergency response protocols.
  14. Report potential safety risks, concerns, or critical incidents to the supervisor promptly.
  15. Engage in ongoing training on harm reduction, trauma-informed care, de-escalation, and program operations.
  16. Assist in maintaining an inclusive, respectful, and collaborative team culture.
  17. Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

  1. High school diploma or equivalent required (may be substituted for experience)
  2. Experience working with people experiencing homelessness, substance use, or mental health conditions preferred.
  3. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage with participants in a patient-centered and trauma-informed manner.
  4. Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, handling situations with empathy, patience, and professionalism.
  5. Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.
  6. Basic proficiency with documentation and computer use (email, electronic records, Microsoft Word).
  7. Flexibility to work varied shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

Preferred Experience & Skills:

  1. Experience working with people experiencing homelessness or in harm reduction settings.
  2. Familiarity with mental health crisis intervention and de-escalation techniques.

*All JWCH, Wesley Health Centers workforce members are recommended to be fully vaccinated and boosted against COVID-19.

At JWCH Institute, Inc., we believe in taking care of those who take care of others. If you work 30+ hours per week, you’ll enjoy competitive pay and a robust benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Monthly employer-sponsored allowance for assistance with health premiums.

  • Paid time off (vacation, sick leave) and 13 paid holidays.
  • 401(k) Safe Harbor Profit Sharing plan.
  • Mileage reimbursement.
  • Short- and long-term disability plans (LTD/STD).
  • Life insurance policy & AD&D, and more!

Become part of a team where your work matters. Apply today and help us change lives, one patient/client at a time.

title: Revit Modelleur
description:
Werk aan uitdagende bouwkundige projecten binnen de industrie!

Wil jij jouw Revit-skills inzetten voor uitdagende bouwkundige projecten?

Als Revit Modelleur bij VIRO ben jij dé specialist die bouwkundige ontwerpen vertaalt naar hoogwaardige en nauwkeurige 3D-modellen. Jij zorgt voor kwaliteit, detail en een goede samenwerking binnen elk project.

Je werkt aan uiteenlopende projecten, variërend van industriële gebouwen en productiefaciliteiten tot utilitaire en bouwkundige constructies. Hierbij combineer je bouwkundige kennis met een multidisciplinaire aanpak, waarbij je samenwerkt met collega's uit onder andere disciplines binnen VIRO. We werken aan industriële gebouwen, kantoren en productiefaciliteiten, maar ook aan boorplatforms, grote maritieme constructies, staalconstructies, windmolens, achtbanen en wat je verder maar kunt bedenken. Geen twee projecten zijn hetzelfde.

Kom bij VIRO's wereld van technologie werken als je jezelf verder wilt ontwikkelen tot de beste op je vakgebied.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je vertaalt bouwkundige ontwerpen en tekeningen naar gedetailleerde en nauwkeurige 3D-modellen in Revit

  • Je werkt nauw samen met ontwerpers, engineers en andere disciplines om tot een kloppend, multidisciplinair model te komen

  • Je signaleert clashes en onduidelijkheden tijdig en denkt actief mee over praktische oplossingen

  • Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, consistentie en modelleerstandaarden binnen het project

  • Je levert modellen en tekeningen op die aansluiten bij de projectplanning en de wensen van de klant.

  • Een afgeronde opleiding in de richting van Bouwkunde, Civiele Techniek of vergelijkbaar

  • Ervaring met Revit; kennis van BIM-werkwijzen is een pré

  • Oog voor detail en een nauwkeurige, gestructureerde manier van werken

  • Je bent een teamplayer die goed communiceert met collega's van verschillende disciplines

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en wilt jezelf blijven ontwikkelen binnen je vakgebied

Wat bieden wij je?

  • Uiteenlopende en unieke projecten binnen de industrie, van productiefaciliteiten tot windmolens en achtbanen

  • Een multidisciplinaire werkomgeving waarin je leert van specialisten uit andere vakgebieden

  • Ruimte en begeleiding om door te groeien tot expert op jouw vakgebied

  • Regie over je eigen carrière via onze VIRO Academy

  • Prima mogelijkheden en faciliteiten om hybride te werken, inclusief thuiswerkvergoeding

  • 22 vakantiedagen en 13 ATV-dagen

  • Vergoeding voor het woon – werkverkeer of gebruik van een zakelijke NS-business card

  • Je kunt gebruik maken van een fietsleaseplan, een aantrekkelijke fitnessregeling en/of het hybride warmtepompplan

  • Profiteer van een uitstekende pensioenvoorziening bij Nationale Nederlanden en onze collectieve zorgverzekering via VGZ

  • Onze actieve personeelsvereniging zorgt voor de nodige ontspanning en voor mooie verhalen bij de koffieautomaat

Je afdeling

De afdeling Constructie & Bouwkunde werkt aan projecten binnen de industriële bouw, utiliteitsbouw en woningbouw. Klanten variëren van staalbouwers en productiebedrijven tot aannemers en architectenbureaus. De energietransitie speelt hierbij een steeds grotere rol, wat zorgt voor technisch uitdagende en actuele projecten.

Interesse?

Solliciteer direct en werk mee aan de meest uiteenlopende en uitdagende projecten binnen de industrie. Heb je nog vragen over de functie? Neem gerust contact op, we vertellen je graag meer.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
Ben jij een ervaren engineer die technische expertise graag combineert met het coördineren en begeleiden van een team? Wil jij werken aan complexe procesinstallaties voor internationale klanten? Dan is de functie van Lead Engineer bij Orangeworks in Oss iets voor jou!

Wij zijn op zoek naar een ervaren en gedreven professional die niet alleen sterk is in engineering, maar ook energie krijgt van het coördineren en begeleiden van een team.

Dit ga je doen als Lead Engineer

Als Lead Engineer ben jij de technische spil binnen onze projecten. Jij vertaalt klantwensen en ideeën naar slimme, innovatieve en maakbare technische oplossingen. Daarbij ben je betrokken bij het volledige engineeringproces: van conceptontwerp tot en met de uiteindelijke realisatie.

Je werkt nauw samen met projectmanagers, engineers, werkvoorbereiders en assemblage specialisten. Jij zorgt ervoor dat iedereen binnen het projectteam op één lijn zit. Je bewaakt de technische kwaliteit, planning, voortgang en het budget van jouw engineeringprojecten.

Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het functioneel aansturen van jouw engineeringsteam. Je stelt engineeringsplanningen op, bewaakt de benodigde capaciteit en adviseert bij het op- en afschalen van de flexibele schil.

"Als Lead Engineer bij Orangeworks werk je nauw samen met internationale klanten om hun uitdagingen om te zetten in innovatieve oplossingen. Je ziet het hele proces van concept tot oplevering en ervaart direct de impact van jouw werk in de praktijk."

Dit ben jij

Jij bent technisch sterk, houdt overzicht en durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je krijgt energie van complexe technische vraagstukken en vindt het leuk om collega's te begeleiden en samen tot het beste resultaat te komen.

Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen techniek, planning en klantcontact. Daarbij denk je vooruit, neem je initiatief en weet je mensen mee te nemen.

Dit staat op jouw cv:

  • Minimaal een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in de richting van Werktuigbouwkunde, Procestechniek of vergelijkbaar;

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als lead engineer of een vergelijkbare technische functie;

  • Ervaring in de voedingsindustrie is een pré;

  • Ervaring met het coördineren of aansturen van engineers;

  • Ervaring met Inventor en Vault of vergelijkbare CAD-pakketten;

  • Je bent communicatief sterk en kunt gemakkelijk schakelen tussen klanten, collega's en andere stakeholders.

Dit hebben wij onze nieuwe collega te bieden

Werken bij Orangeworks betekent veel zelfstandigheid, verantwoordelijkheid en afwisseling. Je krijgt de ruimte om jouw ideeën in de praktijk te brengen en daadwerkelijk invloed uit te oefenen op projecten en de verdere ontwikkeling van onze engineeringafdeling.

Je komt terecht in een betrokken en ambitieus team waarin collegialiteit, samenwerking en een no-nonsense mentaliteit centraal staan.

Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

  • Een competitief salaris en goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden;

  • Cao Metaal en Techniek, 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV dagen;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per km;

  • Een goed geregeld pensioen;

  • Een bonus bij goede prestaties en bij geen ziekmelding.


Dit zijn wij

Orangeworks is al meer dan 50 jaar gespecialiseerd in het ontwerpen en bouwen van procesinstallaties voor de internationale voedingsindustrie. In 2020 heeft Orangeworks branchegenoot Tanis Food Tec overgenomen en in mei 2024 zijn de activiteiten van B&L Chocolate, aan de organisatie toegevoegd.

De combinatie van de expertise van Orangeworks, Tanis Food Tec en B&L Chocolate geeft ons een krachtige positie in de markt. Samen bieden we onze (internationale) klanten hoogwaardige en innovatieve oplossingen en nemen we hen zoveel mogelijk werk uit handen.

We zijn de afgelopen jaren flink gegroeid en hebben de ambitie om ons verder te blijven ontwikkelen, verbeteren en groeien. En daar hebben we jou voor nodig!


Word jij onze nieuwe Lead Engineer?

Word jij enthousiast van deze functie en zie jij jezelf als de technische én verbindende kracht binnen onze engineeringprojecten? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Solliciteer eenvoudig via het sollicitatieformulier. Heb je op dit moment geen cv bij de hand? Geen probleem! Laat je telefoonnummer achter en wij nemen contact met je op.

Heb je vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met Sanne Hendriks via hrm@orangeworks.nl of 0412-782000

title: Shift Lead
description:
Position Purpose:

The Shift Lead will lead supportive housing services, oversee staff and client services during swing shifts in the absence of the Program Director/Manager. The Shift Lead will assist the Program Director/Manager in aligning with the JWCH mission to improve the health and well-being of underserved populations in Los Angeles County through healthcare, health education, and services. This position will ensure smooth daily operations, provide leadership to staff, and model trauma-informed care approaches.

Program Population:

MLK Recuperative Care Center is an Interim Housing program that assists homeless, medically compromised individuals to recover and improve their health conditions. These individuals may also suffer from mental health and substance abuse issues, sometimes causing behaviors such as yelling, cussing, and outbursts of anger. The role of each staff at MLK RCC is to assist the client in overcoming barriers and increasing coping skills to decrease negative behaviors.

Principal Responsibilities:

  1. Provide facility oversight during assigned swing shifts.
  2. Coordinate with medical staff to ensure timely and appropriate medical care and response to patient needs.
  3. Work with Case Managers to schedule and facilitate Life Skills groups and activities to support patient rehabilitation and behavioral health.
  4. Ensure accurate and consistent documentation during assigned shifts.
  5. Support ongoing quality assurance and improvement activities.
  6. Participate in and contribute to staff training to maintain high-quality program services and facility operations.
  7. Assist in assessing and improving patient satisfaction with facility services and care.
  8. Engage in professional development activities as needed.
  9. Lead and train staff on proper documentation practices as required by contract and clinical needs.
  10. Ensure the accuracy of all documentation in the electronic medical record, including assessments, ICPs, referrals, appointments, patient progress, behavioral management plans, and community transition planning.
  11. Document all relevant information clearly and thoroughly, including name, title, date, and time.
  12. Ensure all eligible staff comply with DHS and JWCH/Wesley requirements to access and utilize the electronic medical record.
  13. Lead efforts to ensure patient information is shared only with appropriate personnel involved in care.
  14. Maintain confidentiality of all documents containing patient-identifying information.
  15. Respect and uphold confidentiality regarding information about staff and colleagues.
  16. Identify and support systems for reporting potentially unsafe situations or processes, ensuring timely resolution and documentation.
  17. Support the Project Manager in organizing staff meetings as required.
  18. Facilitate or participate in safety programs, including staff assignments to emergency response teams.
  19. Measure and record vital signs including temperature, pulse, blood pressure, pulse oximetry, weight, height, and blood glucose level.
  20. Identify clients experiencing clinical and behavioral issues and report to the licensed nurse or medical provider immediate
  21. Assist care team during medical emergencies by performing assigned duties within certification and scope.
  22. Perform other duties as needed or assigned.

Requirements:

  1. High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's degree or higher in a related field preferred.
  2. Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) required.
  3. Minimum of 2 years of experience in a supervisory or lead role within a healthcare, social services, or related setting.
  4. Experience in supportive housing, case management, or working with homeless populations is preferred.
  5. Previous experience in documenting patient care and maintaining electronic medical records is preferred.
  6. Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, support, and direct staff effectively.
  7. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to interact professionally with a diverse range of individuals.
  8. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  9. Strong organizational and time management skills with attention to detail.
  10. Current CPR and First Aid certification required.
  11. Bilingual (English/Spanish) ability a plus.

Physical and Environmental Requirements:

  1. Ability to stand, walk, and sit for extended periods of time.
  2. Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds.
  3. Ability to work in various environments, including office settings and patient care areas.
  4. Must be able to respond to emergencies in a timely manner.
  5. Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.

*All JWCH, Wesley Health Centers workforce members are recommended to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19.

Employee Benefits:

At JWCH Institute, Inc., we believe in taking care of those who take care of others. If you work 30+ hours per week, you’ll enjoy competitive pay and a robust benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Monthly employer-sponsored allowance for assistance with health premiums.
  • Funded Health Savings Account (up to deductible) to assist with carrier-approved medical expenses.
  • Paid time off (vacation, sick leave) and 13 paid holidays.
  • 401(k) Safe Harbor Profit Sharing plan.
  • Mileage reimbursement.
  • Short- and long-term disability plans (LTD/STD).
  • Life insurance policy & AD&D, and more!

Become part of a team where your work matters. Apply today and help us change lives, one patient at a time.

JWCH Institute, Inc + Wesley Health Centers is an Equal Opportunity and Fair Chance Employer.

title: Systems Engineer III
description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.

What We Offer

Salary:

$120,000.00 - $165,000.00

Location:

Gloucester,MA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Systems Engineer, you’ll design, integrate, and optimize complex systems that drive the semiconductor industry forward. Your expertise in systems thinking and problem-solving is essential as you collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop advanced solutions to intricate processes and writing system specifications. You’ll be responsible for analyzing requirements, defining system architectures, conducting thorough testing, and ensuring seamless integration of subsystems. Additionally, you’ll identify and mitigate risks, confirming that our systems meet the highest quality standards and exceed customer expectations.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Complete definition and design of complex components, modules, and sub systems. Contribute to the system engineering specification both within the field of expertise and broaden into other disciplines. Ensure designs meet market requirement specifications (MRS).
  • Coordinate with project marketing and management to understand sub system requirements.
  • Lead architecture brainstorming meetings and drive the systems process to down select to a final architecture of a subsystem
  • Conduct detailed engineering analysis of sub systems using vast knowledge of design concepts and functional requirements in field of technical expertise and broaden into other disciplines.
  • Assist in creating concepts for architectural design approaches. Evaluate architectures to provide recommendation for best system solution approach
  • Build and qualify prototypes of new designs, or procure entire subsystems from outsourced suppliers and test for compliance with detailed specifications
  • Identify and troubleshoot a variety of difficult engineering problems in field of technical expertise, including serviceability and manufacturability.
  • Support System Integration during the assembly and final testing of new product designs.
  • Perform and coordinate tests against internal and industry-accepted reliability specifications. Make suitable design or operational changes as required.
  • Support system engineering projects that have a substantial mix of electrical, mechanical, physics, algorithms and software design, and understand the underlying system implications.
  • Provide remote and onsite support to field support personnel as required.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 4-7 years of experience

Additional Information

Time Type:

Full time

Employee Type:

Assignee / Regular

Travel:

Yes, 10% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:

Yes

The salary offered to a selected candidate will be based on multiple factors including location, hire grade, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and with consideration of internal equity of our current team members. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable.

For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement.

title: Director of Student Success Center
description:
The Director of the Student Success Center provides strategic and operational leadership for the Center's programs and initiatives aimed at enhancing student success, well-being, academic progression, retention, and graduation. The position develops an integrated student support framework covering academic and career guidance, early intervention, student engagement, and success initiatives, in collaboration with colleges, departments, and relevant University units

Lead and manage the operations of the Student Success Center and ensure achievement of its strategic and operational objectives.

· Develop and implement the Center's strategy and programs in alignment with the University of Kalba strategic plan.

· Develop initiatives that enhance student retention, academic progression, achievement, and timely graduation.

· Establish and oversee an early-alert and intervention system to identify students at academic risk and develop appropriate support plans.

· Oversee academic advising and student guidance services and ensure appropriate support for students with diverse academic needs.

· Collaborate with colleges and faculty members to identify student needs and develop appropriate support solutions and programs.

· Develop initiatives that promote student engagement, belonging, and participation in university life.

· Oversee orientation, transition, and student integration programs for new and continuing students.

· Develop career-related support services and connect students with relevant training and career opportunities in coordination with the appropriate University units.

· Utilize student and academic data to assess student needs and identify students at risk of academic difficulty or withdrawal.

· Prepare regular reports, statistics, and analyses related to the Center's performance and student success indicators.

· Establish and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of student success programs and services.

· Monitor student satisfaction with the Center's services and recommend continuous improvements.

· Supervise Center staff, assign responsibilities, monitor performance, and support professional development.

· Prepare and monitor the Center's operating budget and ensure effective utilization of resources.

· Develop policies and procedures related to student success services in coordination with relevant University units.

· Establish effective collaboration and partnerships with colleges, departments, centers, and relevant external organizations.
