description:
Hi there, we’re Article. 👋 We’re a North American based furniture company creating remarkably better furniture experiences one sofa at a time. And as the Office Administrator, you’ll play an important role in keeping our Vietnam office organized, welcoming, and running smoothly by providing day-to-day administrative and operational support to our team.


Why We Need You:

As part of our Vietnam team, you’ll support the day-to-day operations of our office and help create an efficient, organized, and positive workplace experience for our employees and visitors.

You’ll work to support the Senior Office Administrator to support office and facilities operations, employee administration, business travel, company events, vendors, purchasing, equipment, and general administrative needs. You’ll be someone the team can rely on to stay on top of the details, coordinate multiple priorities, and make sure things get done.

This is a hands-on role where strong organization, ownership, and a customer-service mindset will make a meaningful difference in how our office operates every day.


Why Article?

What started in 2019 as a project to strengthen our relationships with our Asian vendors has grown into a permanent operation in Ho Chi Minh City. Article currently has ≈70 employees in Vietnam, across our Sourcing, Technical Product Development, Quality, HR, Logistics, PMO and Accounting functions.

As a Particle (people of Article), you will have a high level of autonomy to solve challenging, meaningful problems the best way you can. That means you’re trusted to explore solutions you believe will work best (you’re the expert, after all). You’ll do all this while growing your skills within a company that is redefining the furniture industry.

At Article, we grow and have fun together through regular in-office training and team activities. These moments help us build connection, collaboration, and creativity across our teams all year long.


You’ll work closely with the Senior Office Administrator to support the daily operations of our Vietnam office and ensure employees have a well-organized, safe, and welcoming workplace.

Office & Facilities Administration
  • Support daily office operations, facilities, maintenance, cleaning, security, and workplace readiness.
  • Manage office supplies, pantry inventory, equipment records, and general administrative needs.
Employee & Workplace Support
  • Support employee onboarding, offboarding, visitor arrangements, and day-to-day administrative requests.
  • Assist with expatriate administration and maintain accurate, confidential records.
Travel & Events
  • Coordinate business travel, accommodation, and local transportation.
  • Support company meetings, team activities, and events, including venues, catering, and logistics.
Vendor & Purchasing Support
  • Coordinate purchase requests, deliveries, invoices, and routine vendor follow-up.
  • Maintain vendor and purchasing records and escalate issues when needed.
IT & Equipment Support
  • Track office and IT equipment and support employee equipment setup, distribution, and collection.
  • Coordinate routine IT requests with internal support teams or vendors.
Finance, Safety & General Administration
  • Prepare invoices, expense claims, payment documentation, trackers, and routine reports.
  • Support office safety, security, compliance, and administrative projects.
  • Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve office processes and employee experience.

  • 2–4 years of experience in office administration, facilities, or a related role.
  • Diploma or equivalent qualification is nice to have.
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Proactive, dependable, and able to manage multiple priorities independently.
  • Strong coordination, and customer-service skills, with a proactive nature
  • Proficient with Google Workspace and other common office software.
  • Professional and trustworthy when handling confidential information.
  • International or MNC experience is an asset.
  • Able to work 5 days per week in our Thao Dien based office and support occasional off-site administrative tasks.

Wealth, Health & Life:
  • Salary range: 18,000,000 VNĐ to 27,000,000 VNĐ Gross/Month
  • 13th-month salary
  • 15 days of vacation*
  • 11 National Holidays
  • 2 extra days (Christmas & 1 day of your choosing)
  • 6 well-being (sick) days*
  • Excellent extended health care benefits packages (dental, health check, mental health…)

Growth & Training:
  • We believe in fostering an environment of learning and growth at Article.
  • Every role has a clear growth path that you and your manager create together, so you know what development looks like for you.
  • Throughout the year, we have several in-office training sessions covering a range of topics.
  • You’ll also have access to many learning and development modules through our internal online learning platform.

Other:
  • Employee discounts on many of our products produced in Vietnam

Company & Office Space:
  • Our modern office is in Thao Dien, with first-come, first-served (limited) secure scooter parking
  • State-of-the-art laptops with the tech and tools to easily collaborate
  • Be a part of a multinational, collaborative office culture

title: Test Engineering Student Placement (Powertrains)
description:
Red Bull Powertrains are offering a year-long placement opportunity within our Validation & Test Engineering teams. In this hands-on role you will be emersed into the heart of our state-of-the-art Technical and Testing facilities where we drive engineering and innovation to the limit to develop cutting-edge Formula 1 power units. Pushing boundaries is in our DNA!

In this role, you’ll get hands-on with physical testing to prove out cutting-edge Powertrain systems from individual components to full PU. You’ll play a key part in setting up and developing our F1 Powertrain Dynos and Test Rigs, supporting a wide variety of development, verification, and sign-off tests on Power Units and components.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Play an active role in the day-to-day function of the team, assisting with the mechanical, electronic, and software-based aspects of dyno preparation and operation
  • Designing and implementing upgrade projects on our test rigs/dynos for complete powertrain: PU’s, transmission, subsystems and single components
  • Integrating equipment and instrumentation to our dyno data acquisition, monitoring, and control systems
  • Developing CAD competency using NX, to complete design of parts for manufacture. Our wide-ranging projects include electrical loom, mechanical, and PCB design.
  • Hands on physical build, implementation of projects, upgrades and designed assemblies
  • Analysing PU and Dyno Data for fault finding where necessary
  • Collaborating closely with Technical and Test teams to deliver world-class engineering solutions
  • Gaining direct exposure to the 2027 Formula 1 season and contributing to the future of Red Bull Powertrains

We’re looking for passionate, curious, and driven undergraduates who are eager to push the limits of engineering innovation in a fast paced, high-performance environment. If you're ready to take on real responsibility, solve real-world engineering challenges and contribute to the future of Red Bull Racing’s success on track, this is your opportunity.

Expected knowledge, experience & attributes of the successful candidates:

  • Knowledge and experience from at least one year of undergraduate study on an Engineering degree course
  • Ability to demonstrate a genuine passion for engineering through practical involvement in extra-curricular projects, previous placements, or work experience
  • Familiarity with CAD software for Electrical, Electronic and/or Mechanical design (training will be provided)
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working in a team environment
  • A solid background in electronic systems, ideally automotive based
  • Experience with handling and analysing data from simulations or physical tests, and confidence in preparing high-quality technical documentation
  • Ability to break complex technical problems down, and investigate issues logically and methodically
  • Positive, can-do, attitude and willingness to learn new skills
  • Ability to follow best practice and work on multiple tasks simultaneously

The placement will be for 1 year, starting in the summer of 2027. To be considered for this Student Placement, please apply to this advert and submit both your CV and a one-page Cover Letter as two separate documents.

At Red Bull Powertrains, we believe that success isn’t just about speed, it’s about the team behind the victory. We trust, support, and challenge each other, always pushing for better. If you love solving complex problems, thinking fast, and making a real impact, this is the place for you. Alongside a competitive salary, you’ll enjoy:

  • Bonus scheme
  • Private healthcare
  • A pension scheme
  • On-site gym
  • Free daily food allowance
  • And many more!

Most importantly, you’ll play a key role in powering championship-winning cars. If you're ready to be part of something extraordinary, apply now and help shape the future of F1.

title: BI and Data Analyst
description:
We are looking for an FP&A BI Analyst to join our finance team at an exciting moment in our growth as a business, to build and own the reporting and analytics that power financial decision making across the Group.

The FP&A BI Analyst will sit at the intersection of finance and data, turning information held in Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and Dynamics 365 into clear, reliable and commercially relevant insight. The role is responsible for designing and maintaining our financial reporting suite, automating manual processes, and ensuring a single trusted version of the numbers. The successful candidate will combine strong technical data skills with genuine financial understanding and the ability to translate complexity into something non-finance stakeholders can act on.
Data & Platform
  • Build, maintain and optimise financial data models and pipelines within Microsoft Fabric, ensuring accuracy, performance and scalability
  • Own the flow of financial and operational data from Dynamics 365 into the reporting environment, resolving issues at source wherever possible
  • Partner with IT and Data teams to align on architecture, governance, security and data quality standards

Reporting & Visualisation
  • Design, build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that are clear, intuitive and support business decision making
  • Automate recurring management reporting, replacing manual Excel processes with sustainable, well controlled solutions
  • Develop robust DAX measures and a well-documented semantic model that acts as a single source of truth for financial data
  • Understand the business model and value driving levers to ensure reporting reflects what genuinely matters to the business

Analysis & Decision Support
  • Support delivery of the monthly reporting pack, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and clarity
  • Develop and track KPIs to measure business performance, including revenue, cost and headcount analysis (A vs. B)
  • Support preparation of presentations for senior leadership and board reviews
  • Provide ad hoc analysis, scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis as required

Stakeholder Engagement
  • Work closely with FP&A, Financial Control and the wider business to understand reporting needs and translate them into practical, scalable solutions
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for reporting queries, building confidence in the numbers across the organisation

Governance & Compliance
  • Ensure data controls, reporting policies and change management processes are adhered to
  • Maintain clear documentation of data sources, definitions and report logic to support auditability and continuity
Required attributes:
  • Demonstrable hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Warehouse or equivalent)
  • Strong Power BI and wider Power Platform skills, including advanced DAX, Power Query and dimensional data modelling
  • Practical experience working with Dynamics 365 finance data, including its structure and reporting implications
  • Experience gained working directly within a Finance function, or in close partnership with one, is strongly preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into meaningful insight
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong Excel skills and a solid grounding in core financial concepts including P&L, balance sheet, budgeting and forecasting
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with multiple competing priorities

Desirable attributes:
  • Experience in a PE-backed or fast-growth environment advantageous
  • Part-qualified or qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent), or a finance or data related degree
  • Familiarity with SQL, Power Automate, Python or version control / deployment pipelines
Some of the benefits we include are:
  • Accidental, term life and medical insurance
  • Hybrid Work model
  • Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
  • Maternity leave
  • A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
  • Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects
The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.
To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.

Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.

title: Supply Chain Specialist Southern Africa-
description:
At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.

Supply Chain Specialist Southern Africa-

Job Purpose:

  • Responsible for supporting the Country Supply Chain Management Mission Team in tasks relating to execution of Demand and Supply Plans, and logistical product flows that will enable the Bayer to meet farmer needs in the Region for Crop Protection, Glyphosate & Row Crop solutions.
  • Ensure Supply by executing end-to-end replenishment plans & inventory management that will ensure optimal inventory at DC level, at Customers and in channel (for direct shipments) on time in full in and aligned with the respective Sales/Supply plan strategy and production campaigns.

Key Task and Responsibilities:

  • Supply Planning Responsibilities
  • Execute the Supply Plan based on Sales Forecast through alignment and coordination with the Country Group Supply Chain Operations Planner on the required commitments/deliverables to ensure secure supply.
  • Weekly reporting to relevant stakeholders on Product Availability & Arrival Timelines.
  • Facilitating product availability through stocks Replenishment and execution of Intercompany purchases/Stock Transfer orders for Finished Goods.
  • Responsible for all product flows of Stock Transfer orders for Finished Goods & Co-ordination of Finished Goods movement between plant to DC’s.Execute supply plan for spot orders and constrained supply situations with relevant PS stakeholders and attend Demand Alignment forums.
  • Follow up with TRIA / Order Management Teams and Production Site Teams in EMEA (for CP) to process Sales Orders .
  • Report on relevant Supply Chain KPI’s and coordinate performance improvement.
  • Coordinate returns and buy-backs for CP and RC from DCs to supplying plants.
  • Preparation of inputs/outputs for Sales & Operational Executional Planning (S&OE) meetings and provide relevant feedback to stakeholders
  • Execute all supply planning duties in line with the guiding SOPs/Procedures in place.
  • Complaint Management via appropriate Bayer Quality Management System and Stakeholders.
  • Stock count inputs - Prepare Count sheets for RC and CP, participate in stock counts and execute the resulting Supply Chain stock postings.
  • Support execution of Slow Mover mitigation initiatives & coordinate product write-offs in line with inventory SOPs.
  • CP Toller contract and service management for in-country manufacturing activities including supply/procurement of manufacturing materials such as a labels and packaging materials, and contract performance management.
  • Relationship management with tolling / packaging vendors and authorities via execution and follow up of purchase order and stock transfers, payment follow up and local contact management etc.
  • Creation and maintenance of material Master Data and performance management of the material master data processes.
  • Coordinate artwork & label management process with Marketing, Regulatory & Production Sites to ensure correctness, compliance & timely production of products.
  • Support implementation of Supply Chain projects.
    Perform any other duties as cocreated and assigned by SSA and Country Supply Chain Mission team.
    Import & Export Responsibilities
  • Responsible for all cross-border movements of commercial goods to Customers & DC’s.
  • Co-ordinate all aspects of air/ocean/road consignments, abiding by import & export customs regulations and international laws.
  • Process import/export permits and documents for CP, Row Crop commercial seeds and communicate with brokers on customs processing, clearance and onward forwarding of consignments to customers & desired DCs.
  • Support & coordinate order fulfillment and transportation cycle in arranging for PVOC where required, ensure timely loading, maintain scheduled departures and track goods from loading point through to delivery to the desired DCs & customers.
  • Liaise with relevant Order Management Teams on execution of direct export orders including documentation ensure smooth shipment of products from supplying plants to destination countries.
  • Provide frequent & routine updates/tracking status to Supply Chain & Customer Service Teams on import/export orders/consignments in transit.
  • Keep abreast with import & export regulations and developments and report on any new changes.
  • Liaise with government regulatory bodies to ensure import & export documentations are promptly processed including timely dispatch to relevant stakeholders (both internal & external).
  • Process Payments for government agencies, 3rd party service providers and customs Brokers liaising with Accounts Payable Team to ensure timely payment within the stipulated timelines.
  • Ensure imports & exports are done as per the relevant Standard Operating Procedures and maintain accurate Documentation (electronic and Hard copy), Goods
  • Inspection, collection and customers receipts to support ISO, internal and other external audits.
  • Update respective internal databases in SAP for imports & exports goods receipt, Logistics GRVs processing & HS codes
  • Liaise with Imports & Export Governance on: performance management of Forwarders, Clearing Agents & Inspection Agents, HS code & Tariff authenticity, new trade lanes set-up and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead risk management initiatives on route optimization & lead time reduction in our trade lanes.
  • Liaise with freight forwarders for freight forwarding quotations ensuring total transparency in selection of the most efficient and cost-effective transporter/service provider for imports and exports.
  • Maintain and provide relevant reports necessary to steer the business such Monthly cost analysis for sea & airfreight consignments, Shipping & arrival status of import/export consignments, bi-weekly IDF & import permits status, monthly Import returns to name a few.
  • Preparation & provision of inputs/outputs for Sales & Operational Executional Planning (S&OE) meetings and provide relevant feedback to stakeholders.
  • Complaint Management and Raising claims with our Insurance or relevant persons if consignments are damaged, short shipped or lost.
  • Support implementation of Supply Chain projects.
  • Perform any other duties as cocreated and assigned by SSA and Country Supply Chain Mission team.

Required Qualification:

  • Degree in Supply chain management or a Business Degree
  • 5 years experience in Supply Chain Management: Demand and Supply Planning / International Supplies Management / Warehousing & Distribution / Logistics Management.
  • Handling the Seed and Agri-input chemicals is advantage.
  • Excellent analysis, mandatory SAP knowledge & Customs Compliance
  • Problem solving skills.
  • Conflict Management
  • Risk Management
  • Good communication skills
  • People management skills.
  • Fast learner and Agility
  • Team player

title: Property Project Manager
description:

ACC is a trusted and high‑performing organisation, providing care, supporting recovery and promoting injury prevention, now and into the future.

You can find more about ACC and the work we do at

This includes new builds, office relocations, workplace refurbishments and fitouts, from initial scoping and design through to practical completion. title: Databeheerder
description:
Ben jij nauwkeurig, administratief sterk en heb je affiniteit met databeheer? Werk je graag gestructureerd en vind je het belangrijk dat gegevens correct en betrouwbaar worden vastgelegd? Dan is de functie van Databeheerder bij SHI wellicht jouw volgende stap.

Als Databeheerder ben je verantwoordelijk voor het correct verwerken, beheren en onderhouden van administratieve en logistieke gegevens binnen onze organisatie. Je werkt met diverse systemen en hebt regelmatig contact met collega's van verschillende afdelingen. In deze functie lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en uniformiteit van onze data.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Verzamelen, verwerken en invoeren van gegevens voor het aanmaken en wijzigen van artikelen, debiteuren en crediteuren;

  • Controleren van gegevens op juistheid, volledigheid en naleving van interne richtlijnen en procedures;

  • Beoordelen en vrijgeven van data conform vastgestelde kwaliteitsnormen;

  • Beheren, onderhouden en actueel houden van databases en stamgegevens;

  • Signaleren, analyseren en corrigeren van afwijkingen in data;

  • Actief bijdragen aan de verdere optimalisatie van datakwaliteit en databeheerprocessen.

Wat verwachten wij van jou?

We zoeken iemand die nauwkeurig en gestructureerd werkt en begrijpt hoe belangrijk betrouwbare data voor de organisatie is. Je hebt oog voor detail, werkt graag met gegevens en systemen en kunt zowel zelfstandig als samen met collega’s goed werken. Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • MBO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Kennis van Microsoft Office, met name Excel;

  • Ervaring met SAP en/of databeheer is een pré;

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden;

  • Een nauwkeurige en gestructureerde werkhouding;

  • Je kunt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken;

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een afwisselende functie binnen een dynamische en groeiende organisatie;

  • Mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en verdere specialisatie binnen masterdata;

  • Een marktconform salaris passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • Meer dan zes weken verlof per jaar op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (inclusief ATV-uren);

  • Reiskostenvergoeding;

  • Een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling;

  • Een moderne werkomgeving in ons bedrijfspand in Asten.

Over SHI
SHI is dé groothandel/specialist voor Home Improvement Essentials: producten en concepten die essentieel zijn voor het verfraaien of vernieuwen van woon- en werkomgevingen. SHI voorziet groothandels, retailers en e-tailers in zowel binnen- als buitenland van uitgebreide oplossingen binnen de professionele, doe-het-zelf, non-food en food sector. Ons assortiment omvat onder andere elektra, multimedia, ijzerwaren, schildersgereedschap en sanitair. We zijn in 2022 verhuisd naar ons gloednieuwe bedrijfspand in Asten, waar je kunt genieten van moderne faciliteiten. Bij ons kun je rekenen op een zelfstandige en veelzijdige functie binnen een prettige en informele werksfeer.

title: Field Service Engr I
description:
Field Service Engineer I

Selangor, Malaysia

Start your career by making an impact and real connections with some of the most meaningful challenges around. When you join Honeywell, you become a member of our performance culture comprised of diverse leaders, thinkers, innovators, dreamers, and doers who are changing the future.

Make the Best You.

Working at Honeywell is not just creating incredible things. You will collaborate with top minds, grow through continuous learning, and benefit from an inclusive environment that rewards performance and celebrate achievements.

Join Us and Make an Impact.

As Field Service Engineer I, you will be the premier technical contact for Honeywell’s customers in the Oil & Gas and process industries. You will be responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS) and knowledge of distributed control systems (DCS). The ideal candidate is a highly proactive, customer-oriented expert with a deep commitment to site safety and operational excellence, acting as the face of Honeywell at client locations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Control System : Lead the troubleshooting, maintenance, and configuration of DCS, PLC or network primarily related to Honeywell DCS.
  • Customer & Site Support: Work on-site at Oil & Gas plants and customer sites, acting as the primary technical interface to build strong rapport and deliver proactive solutions.
  • Installation & Commissioning: Site support, for installation, execute startup, testing (FAT/SAT), and commissioning of any control systems related.
  • DCS Integration: Leverage strong distributed control system (DCS), safety systems (SIS) knowledge to integrate with Distributed Control System (DCS), process controls (e.g., Experion PKS).
  • Problem Resolution: Experience in hardware/software issues under pressure to minimize plant downtime.
  • Documentation: Maintain and updates meticulous records of maintenance, configuration changes, and incident reports.
  • Safety Compliance: Strict adherence to site HSE (Health, Safety, and Environment) policies and procedures.

Key Experience & Capabilities:

  • Experience: Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in field service engineering within the Oil & Gas or heavy process industry.
  • Control System Knowledge: Deep, practical experience with control system related knowledge especially Honeywell.
  • Customer Orientation: Proven track record of managing customer interfaces, building rapport, and driving satisfaction.
  • Commitment: Highly approachable, committed to project completion, and willing to work on-site at plant locations

We Value (Preferred Qualifications)

  • DCS Related knowledge: Specific to Honeywell control system i.e. C300, Safety Manager and Network setup.
  • SIS Knowledge: Extensive experience with Honeywell Safety System.
  • IT or Cyber security: any relevant knowledge or experience.
  • Technical Degree: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field.
  • Proactive Attitude: Ability to work autonomously and take ownership of assignments.

Who We Are

The Future Is What We Make It at Honeywell. From sustainable aviation fuel and life-saving healthcare sensors to collaborating on every NASA space mission since the 1950’s, over 100 years of innovation has always been driven by an investment in our people. Learn more about Honeywell:

Discover More

Our focus at Honeywell is innovation that drives business, improves the bottom line and creates solutions for our customers and communities around the world. There’s a lot for you to discover. Our solutions, our case studies, our #Futureshapers, and so much more.

title: Director of Event - Regent Kuala Lumpur (Pre-opening)
description:
YOUR DAY TO DAY

People

  • Lead and manage the events team's day-to-day activity, ensuring the right staffing levels at all times
  • Develop the team and improve performance through coaching and feedback, setting clear performance and development goals
  • Train colleagues to ensure compliance with Regent standards, fostering a strong sense of one team across departments
  • Promote teamwork and quality service through daily communication and coordination with other departments
  • Recommend or initiate HR-related actions as needed
  • Build and maintain relationships with external contacts, including guests, vendors, and planners

Financial

  • Own the preparation of the events department's annual budget and departmental goals
  • Monitor budget and control expenses, with a focus on food, beverage, and labour costs
  • Complete forecasts, plans, and productivity reports for the department
  • Monitor spend and identify opportunities to optimise sales while minimising waste
  • Negotiate sales prices within approved booking guidelines

Guest Experience

  • Ensure every client experience is successful and memorable, acting as brand ambassador and key contact throughout the guest journey
  • Build long-term relationships with planners and hosts to increase loyalty to the Regent brand
  • Consult with meeting planners at the pre-event stage to optimise space, flow, menu, and design for every meeting, event, and wedding
  • Oversee agreed event details, including room set-ups, staging, and lighting
  • Conduct pre- and post-event meetings with clients and catering colleagues to identify opportunities for improvement
  • Meet with meeting planners daily to debrief on events, review consumption, billing, and any exceptions
  • Welcome groups and conduct event briefings ahead of each session
  • Analyse client satisfaction surveys and act on feedback to improve service
  • Conduct banquet and catering facility tours, entertaining clients to enhance their event experience

Responsible Business

  • Raise awareness and reputation of the hotel and Regent brand within the local market
  • Ensure guest safety remains a priority, with minimal interruptions or issues

title: SoC High-Speed Interface Architect
description:
Our Automotive Microcontroller R&D team is looking for an experienced SoC High-Speed Interface Architect to join the Chip-Level Architecture team and own the chip-level integration architecture for high-speed interface PHYs on our next-generation automotive microcontroller platform. This is an SoC architecture role — not an IP design role — focused on how high-speed PHYs land on the chip, meet electrical constraints, and integrate with the platform.


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


· Own the SoC-level integration architecture for high-speed interface PHYs (LPDDR, Ethernet PHY, HSPHY) — defining placement strategy, power delivery, reference clock assignment, and electrical compliance requirements.

· Define and maintain the chip-level interface specifications that high-speed PHY IP teams must comply with, including jitter budgets, termination requirements, and signal integrity constraints.

· Serve as the primary SoC architecture interface to PHY IP teams and external PHY vendors — driving integration feasibility assessments and resolving chip-level signal integrity issues.

· Perform or oversee early signal integrity simulation and parasitic analysis for high-speed interface regions of the chip.

· Review and provide architectural sign-off on PHY IP integration results, floorplan proposals, and high-speed IO region design decisions.

· Maintain technical architecture documentation in compliance with ISO 26262 requirements.

· Drive datasheet content for high-speed interface electrical parameters in collaboration with IP teams and customers.



Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.

· At least 10 years of industry experience in semiconductor development with proven experience in high-speed interface architecture or integration.

· Strong knowledge of high-speed interface PHYs — LPDDR memory PHY, Ethernet PHY, and high-speed serial interfaces (HSPHY/SerDes).

· Experience with chip-level signal integrity, jitter budgets, and eye diagram analysis for high-speed interfaces.

· Understanding of PHY placement constraints, power delivery requirements, and reference clock architecture for high-speed interfaces.

· Familiarity with IO ring architecture and ESD protection strategy at high-speed IO boundaries.

· Familiarity with ISO 26262 documentation standards.

· Pro-active collaborative attitude with strong communication skills in a global multi-cultural team.

· Fluent English required; German is a plus.


You are best equipped for this task if you have:

· Owned chip-level integration architecture for LPDDR, Ethernet PHY, or high-speed SerDes in a previous SoC program.

· Defined jitter budgets, power delivery specs, and placement constraints for high-speed PHYs at the SoC level.

· Worked with PHY IP vendors to establish interface specifications, simulation models, and integration acceptance criteria.

· Experience distinguishing SoC-level integration constraints from IP-internal design decisions — and driving the former without dictating the latter.

· Contributed to datasheet electrical parameters for high-speed interface sections.

title: Engineer/Sr. Engineer - Applications and Systems
description:
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

  • Take end-to-end ownership of project documentation from project award through final submission.
  • Actively participate in project kick-off meetings to understand customer documentation requirements.
  • Maintain document status in EDDI and Vendor Document Register Lists (VDRL).
  • Ensure timely submission, receipt, and proper storage of documents in Emerson systems such as document repository tools, Document Management Systems (DMS), or PLM platforms.
  • Prepare document cover pages and manage document transmittals between Emerson and customers.
  • Upload documents to customer portals or share via email as required.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (factories, project managers, engineering, quality teams) and customers to ensure on-time submission and approvals.
  • Review technical documents to confirm alignment with project scope and requirements before submission.
  • Manage customer feedback by preparing comment resolution sheets and coordinating with teams to address revisions.
  • Continuously follow up with internal teams and customers to expedite document submissions and approvals.
  • Provide regular documentation status updates to project stakeholders.
  • Prepare and submit Manufacturing Record Books (MRB) or final data books, ensuring alignment with approved indices and supporting milestone payment processes.
  • Promote a culture of safety by adhering to Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) policies, reporting risks, and participating in safety initiatives.

Who You Are:
You are action-oriented, taking initiative and following through commitments with a sense of urgency. You communicate effectively across global teams, adapting your style to different audiences and ensuring clarity in both written and verbal interactions. You collaborate openly, building partnerships with cross-functional stakeholders to achieve shared goals. You are customer-focused, consistently striving to meet expectations and deliver high-quality outcomes. You plan and align your work effectively, ensuring priorities are managed and processes are optimized for efficiency.

For This Role, You Will Need:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to engage confidently with global stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and similar).
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational skills with close attention to detail.
  • Technical literacy and the ability to understand and review engineering-related documents.
  • Team-oriented mindset with the ability to collaborate effectively.
  • Confidence to handle complex situations and maintain progress under pressure.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:

  • Exposure to document management systems or PLM tools (e.g., Windchill or similar platforms).
  • Experience working in global project environments or cross-cultural teams.
  • Familiarity with project documentation processes, including MRB or final documentation deliverables.
  • Understanding of engineering or manufacturing documentation standards.
  • Prior experience in customer-facing roles or coordination-intensive positions.

Our Culture and Commitment To You:
At Emerson, we prioritize a people-first culture that values inclusion, collaboration, and continuous growth. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed. You will have access to learning opportunities, global exposure, and a supportive environment that encourages innovation and ownership. We promote work-life balance, recognize contributions, and foster a culture where safety and well-being come first.

title: Salesforce Software Engineer || 5+ Yrs Exp || Offshore
description:
Intermediate Salesforce Software Engineer Job Specification Employment type: Full-time Work mode: Hybrid Location: Hybrid Experience: +5 years Role Overview Support the design, development, and configuration of Salesforce solutions that align to business objectives. Working under the guidance of senior engineers and architects, the Intermediate Salesforce Software Engineer will contribute to the delivery of CRM features, integrations, and customisations while growing their engineering and platform skills across the Salesforce ecosystem. Key Responsibilities • Contribute to end-to-end Salesforce development across design, build, and deployment phases. • Develop and maintain Salesforce solutions using: ◦ Apex (classes, triggers, batch jobs) ◦ Lightning Web Components (LWC) ◦ Visualforce (where required for legacy support) ◦ SOQL / SOSL • Configure and customise Salesforce products including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud. • Build and maintain integrations with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware tools. • Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and senior engineers to understand and implement technical requirements. • Participate in code reviews, applying and learning best practices for security, performance, and maintainability. • Troubleshoot, debug, and enhance existing Salesforce customisations, automations, and integrations. • Stay current with Salesforce platform updates and contribute to team knowledge sharing. title: Flagship Store Director
description:
The Position

Vince is seeking a dynamic, customer service driven Store Director for our Grove Flagship Location.

As the Store Director, you will be a brand ambassador, who is responsible for driving business through daily operations, leading the team to maximize sales and profits, and delivering exceptional customer service experiences. You will train and develop a team to achieve goals while ensuring the store upholds the highest standards of visual presentation and operational excellence. This role ensures the store operates in accordance with the company’s guidelines.


Salary Range

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $110,000 annually plus bonuses. Exact salary depends on several factors such as experience, skills, and budget. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a bonus program.

What You’ll Be Responsible For:

  • Drive the achievement of store’s sales plan expectations across categories
  • Oversee store operations, ensuring strong business performance, exceptional customer service, and brand environment within the store
  • Recruit, develop, train and mentor team members to achieve and exceed sales objectives while applying retail excellence
  • Lead by example through active presence on the sales floor and commitment to exceptional customer service experience
  • Set, track and evaluate store KPI’s. Identify business opportunities and implement strategic elevated service model to build client loyalty to drive positive results
  • Serve as a brand ambassador in the market, expanding the client base through creative events and strategic partnerships that cultivate strong relationships and drive business growth
  • Enhance client loyalty through proactive initiatives, effectively utilizing clienteling resources to reflect the brand’s strategy and elevate the customer experience
  • Maintain high standards of the store presentation and visual merchandising standards aligned with brand guidelines
  • Perform daily reporting, analysis, reconciliation and other operational tasks
  • Improve profitability by managing controllable expenses such as payroll, supplies and shrinkage
  • Protect store assets and inventory. Reconcile inventory and monitor stock optimization within the store
  • Implement and comply with company policies and procedures

What You’ll Bring:

  • Ownership & Accountability
  • Emotional Intelligence
  • Problem Solver
  • People Management


Qualifications/Experience We’re Looking For:

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in retail management
  • Deep knowledge of specialty retail, including business development, visual merchandising and store operations
  • Embraces an entrepreneurial spirit, who is sales focused and takes full ownership of the store’s business at all levels
  • Strong leadership, critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to delegate responsibility and empower team members
  • Demonstrate strong verbal and written communication skills allowing for communication of the company’s goals and objectives
  • Ability to create high energy and positive environment, as a mentor and leader to staff and peers.
  • Computer skills to include operation of retail point of sale system, Word, Excel and email
  • Must be able to lift, carry or otherwise move objects weighing up to 30 pounds when merchandising the sales floor and use ladders or stairs.


Vince offers a competitive benefits package designed to meet the unique needs of our team members. Some benefits are provided automatically at no cost and others require an active election. Those benefits include:

  • Robust healthcare options for medical, dental, vision, flexible spending, and health savings account with employer funding
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Generous paid time off plans for vacation, sick, and personal, as well as company holidays
  • Clothing allowance & merchandise discounts
  • $400 annual gym reimbursement
  • Mental health support tools and telehealth psychology and psychiatry
  • Family and caregiving benefits including a competitive paid parental leave program as well as supplemental infertility coverage
  • Life, accidental death & dismemberment, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
  • Supplemental hospital indemnity, specified disease, and accident coverage
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits including transit and parking
  • Discounted pet, home & auto, and legal insurance

V Opco, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant or employee because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, age, or military or veteran status or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law. V Opco, LLC also provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws.

title: Field Technical Project Manager – Security Systems
description:
Job Title: Field Technical Project Manager – Security Systems

Company: G4S Security Systems (Member of Allied Universal ®)

Reports to: ESS Operations Manager

Location: Metamorphosis, Attica, Greece (with travel to client project sites)

About Us

G4S Security Systems is a member of Allied Universal ® - the world’s leading integrated security company, specializing in delivering security and other related services to customers across six continents.Employing more than half a million people in more than 90 countries, we are an international supplier of market-leading, technology-led integrated security solutions and services to a diverse range of clients and customers across the corporate, commercial, and political landscape. Our aim is to provide expert security services that exceed customer expectations in order to enable a performance of high standard services in accordance with the best practices of the industry.

Our team is continuing to expand, so we are looking for a skilled and dynamic Technical Project Manager to join our Installations & Large Projects Team!

Position Overview

Reporting to the ESS Operations Manager, the potential candidate will be a member of the Installations & Large Projects Team. As our project manager, your job will be to coordinate people and processes to ensure that our projects are delivered on time and produce the desired results. You will be the go-to person for everything involving a project’s organization and timeline.

Please note: This is a hands-on, field-based Technical Project Management role focused on physical security installations, site engineering, and physical infrastructure. You will develop detailed project plans, ensure resource availability and allocation, oversee hands-on field operations, and deliver every project on time within budget and scope, spending necessary time directly at client sites and project facilities.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced PM professional pursuing a career in the Security Systems sector!

Job Responsibilities

Team or People Management Accountabilities

  • Proactively develop and maintain effective working relationships, ensuring Senior Client’s needs are understood, such that it enhances the company’s reputation by fostering an environment of continuous improvement to maximize our customers’ satisfaction.

  • Track the forecast and priority of works and the team capacity in order to meet business critical requirements.

  • Establish and coordinate the supply chain so that they work together effectively, maximizing their contribution to meet objectives and project deadlines.

  • Act as a role model for project management best practice; both technically and behaviorally.

  • Refine and participate in project management, CDM, H&S processes, site safety, and governance as steered by G4S and key internal Stakeholders.

  • Prepare and distribute all necessary reports and documentation in a timely and professional manner to relevant stakeholders to enable monitoring, control, and communication.

  • Review provision and supply of quotations, using best suited internal and external suppliers, verifying value for money before seeking Client approval.

Project Manager Accountabilities (Field & Site Engineering Focus)

  • Field & On-Site Project Leadership: Act as a true in-the-field Project Manager (not an IT project manager), taking direct ownership of physical construction sites, low-voltage cabling runs, hardware deployments, and technical installations.

  • Travel & Facility Visits: Conduct regular travel and site visits to client installations and project facilities across target regions to oversee physical execution, conduct site surveys, and manage field operations.

  • Establish and maintain mutually trusting relationships with key client stakeholders on site and at leadership levels.

  • Responsible for the design development and hands-on site execution/installation management of an assigned project in line with the technical design requirements.

  • Supervise, monitor, and appraise the sub-contractor's physical construction & installation performance on site, ensuring that works are completed on time and any necessary corrective actions are taken in such areas as safety, quality, planning, and scheduling.

  • Development and participation in the site QA plan, ensuring that the highest physical and engineering standards are consistently maintained by sub-contractors on site.

  • Monitoring change control, ensuring change requests are submitted and followed through in the correct and timely manner.

  • Plan, coordinate, and manage Major Project Works requested by various client stakeholders.

  • Ensure control of cost, quality, and time, therefore incorporate and emphasize good planning/programming skills.

  • Update and maintain G4S Project Tracker to ensure that all task and work-related data is maintained to an acceptable standard.

  • Manage physical resources to meet daily delivery schedules and business requirements for services within the prescribed budget, minimizing financial performance deductions.

  • Liaise with Clients and their senior team, offering technical advice and knowledge regarding Construction Works, field infrastructure, and security hardware issues while ensuring contractual obligations are met.

Send us your resume if you:

  • Have a successful track record, preferably of more than 5 years of experience as a field-based Technical Project Manager, preferably in the physical security, construction, electrical engineering, or technical installations sector in a multinational company (Note: Experience strictly limited to IT/software project management will not fulfill this field engineering focus).

  • Have an educational background in engineering and technical project management.

  • Possess a solid technical background with understanding or hands-on experience in physical security systems (CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion, Fire Alarms) and infrastructure networks.

  • Are willing and available to travel to client project sites and facilities as required by site delivery schedules.

  • Possess excellent client-facing and internal communication skills.

  • Have solid organizational skills, including attention to detail and multi-tasking skills.

  • Hold a PMP / PRINCE II certification (this is a plus).

  • Are comfortable working with MS Office and Google Workplace tools.

  • Are a team-player with a can-do attitude.

  • Have excellent organizational skills and an ability in problem-solving and negotiation.

  • Possess strong written and verbal communication skills in both Greek and English language.

  • Have good attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Like to interact with current clients and quest for new ones.

What We Offer

title: Software Platforms Development Engineer
description:
Brembo è un leader globale nell’innovazione per la mobilità e sviluppa soluzioni avanzate per veicoli e applicazioni racing. Guidata dal proprio purpose, “Shaping a Zero-Accident Future”, Brembo unisce eccellenza industriale e innovazione digitale per rendere sicurezza, prestazioni e sostenibilità parte integrante dell’esperienza di guida. Attraverso i propri brand – AP Racing, ByBre, Brembo, J.Juan, Marchesini, Öhlins e SBS Friction – il Gruppo offre un ecosistema integrato di tecnologie, che comprende sistemi frenanti, ammortizzatori, frizioni e cerchi, oltre a soluzioni software abilitate dall’intelligenza artificiale. Da oltre 50 anni, il Gruppo Brembo è protagonista nel motorsport ai massimi livelli, fornendo team nei campionati più prestigiosi e contribuendo alla conquista di oltre 1.000 titoli. Fondata nel 1961 in Italia e con sede a Bergamo, Brembo è quotata alla Borsa di Milano dal 1995. Il Gruppo conta circa 16.000 persone in 18 Paesi, con 39 siti produttivi e commerciali, 10 centri di ricerca e sviluppo e 2 Brembo Inspiration Lab. Nel 2025, i ricavi hanno raggiunto i 3,7 miliardi di euro.

Stiamo cercando una persona da inserire all’interno della Global Central Function Research & Development che sarà responsabile di:

  • Definire le specifiche software da implementare per soddisfare i requisiti di sistema e del cliente;
  • Sviluppare il software applicativo per sistemi meccatronici, sia in caso di modifiche e manutenzione del codice esistente, sia per lo sviluppo di nuove funzionalità;
  • Configurare il sistema operativo e altri moduli software di base di terze parti;
  • Effettuare il debug del software in ambiente di simulazione (SIL/HIL) o al banco e occasionalmente sul veicolo;
  • Sviluppare toolchain per supportare l’automazione della generazione del codice e delle build software;
  • Garantire che il software sia sviluppato secondo i processi aziendali (A-SPICE) e in conformità agli standard di sicurezza funzionale (ISO 26262), quando applicabile;
  • Assicurare l’analisi e la risoluzione di anomalie e richieste di modifica provenienti internamente o su richiesta del cliente.


Requisiti:

  • Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica, Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria dell'Automazione, Ingegneria Meccatronica, Ingegneria Biomedica
  • Esperienza di almeno 2 anni maturata in ruoli analoghi in contesti strutturati;
  • Buona conoscenza dello sviluppo software embedded e programmazione su microcontrollori, inclusa l’utilizzazione di strumenti di laboratorio e debugger in-circuit;
  • Conoscenza dello sviluppo di driver per dispositivi integrati connessi via SPI, configurazione delle periferiche MCU e mappatura dei pin;
  • Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.


Nice to have:

  • Pregressa nei settori automotive, aerospaziale, ferroviario, elettrodomestici, IoT o automazione industriale;
  • Esperienza nell’utilizzo dell’architettura AUTOSAR;
  • Conoscenza di strumenti per il controllo versione, tracciamento delle issue e gestione dei requisiti;
  • Conoscenza di linguaggi di scripting, preferibilmente Python;
  • Conoscenza dei motori BLDC e delle relative tecniche di controllo;
  • Conoscenza di tecniche di documentazione semi-formale (UML).

title: Consultant Psychiatrist - Adult Community Mental Health
description:
Consultant Psychiatrist – Adult Community Mental Health

Are you a Consultant Psychiatrist looking to make a meaningful impact in community mental health while enjoying an exceptional lifestyle in one of Australia's most liveable cities?

We are recruiting on behalf of a regarded public health service in metropolitan Adelaide seeking a Consultant Psychiatrist to join its expanding Adult Community Mental Health team. This is an outstanding opportunity to become part of a progressive service that is continuing to invest in mental health care, innovation and multidisciplinary collaboration.

About the Hospital

You will be joining one of South Australia's largest metropolitan public health services, providing comprehensive healthcare to a rapidly growing population of more than 400,000 people.

The network includes two major public hospitals with over 600 inpatient beds across acute and sub-acute services, delivering emergency medicine, surgery, maternity, paediatrics, oncology, rehabilitation, geriatrics, palliative care and specialised mental health services. The principal hospital is a major tertiary referral hospital, supported by a second large general hospital and multiple community health centres, allowing excellent collaboration across inpatient and community services.

About the Mental Health Service

The Adult Community Mental Health Service delivers specialist assessment, treatment and ongoing management for adults experiencing moderate to severe mental illness.

Working alongside an experienced multidisciplinary team of psychiatrists, psychiatric registrars, nurses, psychologists, occupational therapists, social workers and other allied health professionals, you will provide recovery-focused, evidence-based care that enables consumers to remain well within their community whenever possible.

The service maintains strong partnerships with inpatient mental health units, emergency departments, general practitioners and community organisations to ensure seamless continuity of care while promoting innovation, education and continuous service improvement.

The Role

As a Consultant Psychiatrist, you will:

  • Provide specialist psychiatric assessment, diagnosis and treatment for adult community mental health patients.
  • Lead multidisciplinary case conferences and contribute to complex care planning.
  • Provide clinical leadership, supervision and mentoring to junior medical staff and multidisciplinary clinicians.
  • Participate in clinical governance, quality improvement and service development initiatives.
  • Work collaboratively with inpatient units, primary care providers and community support services.
  • Deliver high-quality, recovery-oriented and trauma-informed psychiatric care.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary package
  • Salary packaging benefits to maximise your take-home pay.
  • Relocation assistance available for eligible interstate and international candidates.
  • Permanent ongoing position offering long-term career stability.
  • Opportunities for teaching, mentoring and professional leadership.
  • Work within a well-established multidisciplinary team.
  • Modern facilities with continued investment in mental health services.
  • Flexible working arrangements may be available.
  • Excellent opportunities for career progression within one of South Australia's largest public health services.
  • Supportive workplace culture focused on collaboration, innovation and staff wellbeing.

Requirements

To be considered you will have:

  • Fellowship of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Psychiatrists (FRANZCP), or
  • Eligibility for Specialist Registration with AHPRA through an approved comparable specialist pathway.
  • Medical degree (MBBS or equivalent).
  • Current or eligible Specialist Registration with the Medical Board of Australia.
  • Experience working in Adult Community Psychiatry, General Adult Psychiatry or Community Mental Health Services.
  • Excellent communication, leadership and multidisciplinary collaboration skills.
  • Commitment to recovery-oriented, patient-centred psychiatric practice.

International Psychiatrists Welcome

We welcome applications from overseas-trained Consultant Psychiatrists.

Candidates who hold the MRCPsych together with a Certificate of Completion of Training (CCT) from the United Kingdom may be eligible for Australia's Expedited Specialist Pathway, allowing a significantly faster route to specialist registration without requiring a specialist college assessment.

Why Adelaide?

Adelaide offers an outstanding quality of life, combining all the advantages of a capital city with a relaxed, affordable lifestyle. Residents enjoy beautiful beaches, renowned wineries, scenic hiking trails and more than 300 days of sunshine each year, all within easy reach of the city centre. Housing is significantly more affordable than Sydney or Melbourne, making it an ideal place to settle with a family while enjoying shorter commute times. Adelaide is also celebrated for its world-class food and wine, vibrant arts scene, international festivals and major sporting events throughout the year. With excellent schools, modern healthcare facilities and a welcoming multicultural community, it is one of Australia's most desirable places to live and work.

For more information please reach out to Anna - ania@mediix.com.au

title: Production Planner / Scheduler II
description:
Production Planner

About Vitesse: How we communicate, capture, and share information has not changed significantly in our lifetime—it has changed significantly in the last decade, even in the last year. From a vacationer checking email as they fly across the world to a U.S. military service member sharing critical observations across the battlefield, the ability to capture and transfer data over different platforms is an important part both of our everyday lives and the security of our country. Whether on a geostationary satellite, a naval vessel, or a military jet, the mission-critical solutions that we design and manufacture at Vitesse make our country and our world safer.

Through extensive technical expertise, Vitesse Systems is optimizing the functionality of antenna and thermal management systems for the advancement of next-generation Radar, Electronic Warfare, and C4I (Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Intelligence) systems.

Vitesse Systems prides itself on the solutions we provide to our customers, as well as the incredible team of dedicated people we employ.


SUMMARY: The Senior Production Planner III is responsible for leading advanced production planning and scheduling activities to ensure optimal material flow, on-time delivery, and efficient use of manufacturing resources. This role develops and executes production plans aligned with customer demand, capacity constraints, and inventory targets while driving continuous improvement across planning processes.

The Senior Production Planner III collaborates cross-functionally with operations, supply chain, procurement, engineering, quality, and finance to balance demand and supply, mitigate risks, and resolve complex planning challenges. This position serves as a subject matter expert in ERP/MRP systems (prefer Epicor E10), capacity planning, forecasting, and inventory management, and may mentor junior planners.

Key responsibilities include developing master production schedules, analyzing capacity and material constraints, managing work order priorities, driving inventory optimization initiatives, supporting S&OP processes, and ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements. The role requires strong analytical skills, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels of the organization. Commitment to and support of the Company Core Values are key to success in this position.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop, maintain, and execute the Master Production Schedule (MPS) to meet customer demand and on-time delivery targets.
  • Translate forecasts and customer orders into detailed production and work order plans.
  • Balance demand and supply while considering capacity, labor, tooling, and material constraints.
  • Monitor schedule adherence and adjust plans to address changes in demand, shortages, or production issues.
  • Prioritize and release work orders in alignment with business objectives.
  • Lead planning activities for new product launches from development through production ramp-up.
  • Partner with Engineering, Program Management, Supply Chain, and Operations to ensure material readiness, capacity availability, and schedule alignment for NPI programs.
  • Validate BOMs, routings, lead times, and planning parameters prior to production release.
  • Develop ramp-up plans and transition strategies from prototype to full-rate production.
  • Identify supply chain and production risks during NPI and implement mitigation plans.
  • Support first article builds, pilot runs, and customer milestone schedules.
  • Ensure ERP/MRP system setup is accurate and aligned with program timelines.
  • Perform capacity planning and load analysis to ensure efficient utilization of equipment and labor.
  • Identify bottlenecks and recommend corrective actions to mitigate risks.
  • Coordinate with manufacturing leadership to align production schedules with available resources.
  • Partner with procurement and supply chain to ensure material availability and resolve shortages.
  • Analyze inventory levels and drive initiatives to optimize inventory turns while preventing stockouts.
  • Review MRP outputs and validate planning parameters for accuracy.
  • Work closely with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Finance, Sales, and Program Management to support production and customer commitments.
  • Participate in Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and demand planning meetings.
  • Communicate risks, schedule impacts, and mitigation strategies to stakeholders.
  • Track and report KPIs such as on-time delivery (OTD), schedule attainment, inventory turns, NPI milestone adherence, and forecast accuracy.
  • Analyze variances between planned and actual production performance.
  • Provide data-driven recommendations to improve planning effectiveness.
  • Lead and support process improvement initiatives related to planning, scheduling, NPI execution, and system optimization.
  • Improve ERP/MRP data integrity including BOMs, routings, lead times, and safety stock parameters.
  • Develop and document standard work procedures for planning processes.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in production planning and ERP/MRP systems.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior planners.
  • Support training efforts and promote best practices within the planning team.
  • Identify supply chain and production risks and develop contingency plans.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory standards, and customer requirements.
  • Support audits and reporting requirements as needed.



SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: This position has no supervisory responsibilities.


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation(s) may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Successful accomplishment of duties and responsibilities may require the following:


  • APICS-CPIM 3 of 5 modules completed
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong knowledge of purchasing and planning principles and procedures.
  • Experience with ERP/MRP systems. Epicor a plus.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Able to work independently and collaboratively with a team.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).


EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in business, supply chain management or related field which can be substituted with commensurate experience.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in material, demand, and production planning preferred.



LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to speak and understand basic safety and manufacturing instructions.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS: Ability to add and subtract two-digit numbers. Ability to multiply and divide with 10’s and 100’s.

REASONING ABILITY: Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed but uninvolved written or oral instructions. Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS: Authorization to work in the United States. To conform to U.S. export control regulations, you should be eligible for any required authorizations from the U.S. Government.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation(s) may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to stand, walk, and hear. The Team Member frequently is required to use hands and fingers; handle, feel, and reach with hands and arms. The Team Member is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and smell. The Team Member must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environments characteristics described here are representative of those a Team Member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. NOTE: This job description identifies the general nature and scope of work to be performed.
