title: Platform Engineer (SAP BW and Data Platforms)
description: Do you want to build a career that is truly worthwhile? Working at the World Bank Group provides a unique opportunity for you to help our clients solve their greatest development challenges. The World Bank Group is one of the largest sources of funding and knowledge for developing countries; a unique global partnership of five institutions dedicated to ending extreme poverty, increasing shared prosperity and promoting sustainable development. With 189 member countries and more than 130 offices worldwide, we work with public and private sector partners, investing in groundbreaking projects and using data, research, and technology to develop solutions to the most urgent global challenges. For more information, visit www.worldbank.org ITS Vice Presidency Context The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9 v=VTFGffa1Y7w Unit Context The ITS Financial Technology (ITSFT) unit enables critical Finance and Accounting functions through enterprise platforms supporting financial management, accounting, budgeting, reporting, analytics, external reporting, trust fund management, lending operations, and institutional performance management. The unit manages and modernizes enterprise data and analytics platforms including SAP BW, SAP Business Objects, Azure-based data platforms, and reporting solutions while supporting strategic initiatives related to data modernization, cloud adoption, operational reporting, compliance, and financial transparency. Duties and Accountabilities Role Purpose The Platform Engineer (SAP BW Data Platform) is responsible for the engineering, administration, modernization, and operational excellence of the World Bank Group's enterprise analytics and data platforms. The role supports SAP BW on HANA, Business Objects, SAP data integration technologies, Azure-based data platforms, and enterprise reporting solutions. The Platform Engineer collaborates with product owners, architects, data engineers, business stakeholders, and infrastructure teams to ensure platform reliability, performance, scalability, security, governance, and continuous improvement. The position contributes to the evolution of enterprise analytics capabilities through automation, modernization initiatives, cloud adoption, DevOps practices, observability, and platform engineering principles, enabling trusted and timely business insights across financial and operational domains. Key Responsibilities SAP BW Platform Engineering • Administer, maintain, and optimize SAP BW on HANA environments. • Manage platform upgrades, patches, transport, performance tuning, and capacity planning. • Support business-critical financial and operational reporting processes. • Ensure platform availability, resiliency, scalability, and operational stability. • Support BW upgrade, modernization and migration initiatives, including cloud and next-generation analytics platforms. • Perform professional-level analysis and platform engineering activities across data and analytics platforms. • Solve moderately complex platforms, integration, performance, and operational challenges. • Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to define solutions and drive continuous improvement. • Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing within the platform engineering and analytics delivery teams. • Apply practical expertise across data platforms, analytics architecture, cloud technologies, integration, security, and operational support. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Project description

Join our Development Center in Bucharest, and become a member of our open-minded, progressive and professional team. In this role you will be working on projects for one our world famous clients. You will have a chance to grow your technical and soft skills, and build a thorough expertise of the industry of our client. On top of attractive salary and benefits package, Luxoft will invest into your professional training, and allow you to grow your professional career.

Responsibilities

  • We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design and deliver scalable data pipelines and high performance analytical solutions using SQL/BigQuery, Spark/PySpark, and Python on Google Cloud. This role focuses on building reliable, cloud native data products that enable advanced reporting, analytics, and decision making across the organization. Key Responsabilities:
  • Build scalable data pipelines: Design and deliver batch and real-time ETL/ELT pipelines across cloud environments to support analytics and reporting.
  • Develop SQL and BigQuery solutions: Write and optimize advanced SQL transformations and build performant, cost‑efficient BigQuery data models.
  • Develop Python workflows: Implement scalable data processing solutions using Python and PySpark, ensuring maintainable and high‑quality code.
  • Design data models and ensure quality: Build robust data models and apply validation practices to maintain accuracy and reliability.
  • Build cloud‑native data solutions: Use GCP services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Composer, Pub/Sub, and GCS to build and operate modern data platforms.
  • Optimize performance and reliability: Troubleshoot complex pipeline issues and continuously improve compute, storage, and processing performance.
  • Collaborate using strong engineering practices: Work with engineering, analytics, and business teams while contributing to CI/CD, code reviews, and testing standards.

SKILLS

Must have

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building scalable data pipelines and working with cloud-based data ecosystems.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and hands‑on experience building performant datasets in BigQuery (or similar cloud data warehouses).
  • Proven experience with Python and PySpark for scalable data processing in distributed environments.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, ELT/ETL patterns, and data quality best practices.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Composer, GCS, or equivalent cloud data services.
  • Hands‑on experience building scalable data pipelines (batch and near real‑time) in a cloud‑native environment.
  • Proficiency with version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and optimize performance across compute, storage, and processing layers.

Nice to have

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, Chef). • Knowledge of shell scripting. • Experience in financial services or regulated environments

title: Electric Wiring Harness (EWH) Engineer - Data Librarian
description:
Cableteque comprises an international team with expertise in wire interconnects, CAD deployments, data exchange protocols, and AI. Our team is located worldwide, including the US, India, & Europe. This allows us to assemble diverse perspectives, comprehensive knowledge, and specialized know-how to deliver the best software products and services to our clients.


We are looking for an Electrical Wire Harness (EWH) Engineer to create, build, and maintain a highly detailed electrical/interconnect parts database, including all available technical parameters. The selected candidate will be part of a high-performance team immersed in the high-intensity development of engineering software tools.

About

Position name: Data Librarian

Category: Electric Wiring Harness (EWH) Engineering

Minimum education: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or related technical discipline, or 2 years of experience in either engineering/or supply-chain for wire harness and electronics components instead of a degree.

Engagement terms: Temp to hire

Location: Remote

Qualifications

  • Extensive understanding of the development of electrical wiring harness (EWH) designs
  • Extensive use and selection of the electrical industry components' data sheets

  • Understanding IPC/WHMA-A-620 and Mil-Aerospace standards such as MIL-DTL-3899, MIL-C-38999, MIL-C-24308, MIL-83513, and MIL-STD-1553 is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of any ECAD/CAD for wire harnesses is a plus.


Responsibilities

  • Identify designated parts and research specification details by scouring potential sources such as parts catalogs, standard specifications, industry/military standards, commercial and public databases (MRP outputs), and replacement and cross-reference tables.
  • Document EWH Detail/Assembly data into the company's electrical parts CAD database portal, using manual, automatic, and semi-automatic tools (OCR or APIs) to scrape data from sources referred above.
  • Work with the development team to identify, design, test, and implement methods and tools to scale up data entry and data integrity throughout the parts lifecycle.
  • Document process used once optimized.
  • Work independently and eventually lead a team, providing direction and technical mentoring to direct reports.


Soft skills

  • Excellent technical, verbal, and written communication skills: English
  • Familiar with Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience leading skilled technical teams.
  • Self-motivated/ability to produce results unsupervised.
  • Proactive/self-learner (onboarding training will be provided)
  • Professional, honest, and ethical conduct is always expected.
  • Please ensure clear, consistent communication with internal and external customers.
  • Availability to work remotely in a productive environment.

title: Senior OSP Program Manager - Long Haul Deployment
description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

The Senior Program Manager, Long Haul OSP Deployment is responsible for the strategic leadership and successful delivery of Zayo's long haul fiber deployment portfolio through direct oversight of turnkey engineering and construction partners, cross-functional leadership, and governance of multiple concurrent, large-scale infrastructure programs. This role provides both strategic direction and operational execution across complex, multi-million-dollar network expansion initiatives.

The Senior Program Manager owns program governance, capital planning, contractor strategy, executive stakeholder alignment, risk management, and portfolio performance while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with Zayo quality standards.

Serving as the primary operational and contractual interface between Zayo, engineering and construction partners, customers, and executive leadership, this position drives organizational alignment across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, Regulatory, GIS, and Network Planning to deliver critical network infrastructure at scale.

This role also leads continuous improvement initiatives, establishes deployment best practices, mentors program managers, and influences long-term deployment strategy across the Long Haul organization.

The Senior Program Manager reports to the Director, Long Haul OSP Deployment.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Program Leadership

  • Own a portfolio of large-scale long haul deployment programs supporting strategic network expansion initiatives.

  • Develop portfolio delivery strategies aligned with company growth objectives and capital investment priorities.

  • Lead cross-functional planning from business case development through engineering, permitting, construction, testing, customer acceptance, and operational turnover.

  • Establish program governance, delivery standards, performance metrics, and executive reporting across multiple concurrent initiatives.

  • Balance competing priorities, resources, and funding across multiple programs to optimize delivery performance.

  • Identify portfolio-level risks and dependencies and proactively implement mitigation and recovery strategies.

  • Provide recommendations to senior leadership regarding delivery strategy, capital allocation, contractor utilization, and execution priorities.

Executive Stakeholder Leadership

  • Serve as the executive operational lead for assigned deployment programs.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive leadership, customers, regulatory agencies, and strategic construction partners.

  • Lead executive steering committees, program reviews, and customer governance meetings.

  • Influence cross-functional decision making across Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, and Network Planning.

  • Drive alignment between business objectives and deployment execution across multiple organizations.

Contractor Strategy & Vendor Performance

  • Develop long-term strategic relationships with turnkey engineering and construction partners.

  • Lead commercial negotiations for engineering and construction agreements, amendments, and complex change orders.

  • Establish contractor performance scorecards, KPIs, governance processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Evaluate contractor capacity, financial performance, safety metrics, production trends, and quality performance.

  • Drive executive-level performance reviews and corrective action plans when contractor performance falls below expectations.

  • Partner with Procurement and Legal to optimize sourcing strategies and improve contractor performance across the deployment portfolio.

Portfolio Financial Management

  • Own portfolio-level capital planning, forecasting, and financial performance.

  • Manage multi-million-dollar capital budgets across numerous concurrent deployment programs.

  • Lead financial forecasting, variance analysis, accrual management, and executive reporting.

  • Evaluate commercial impacts of scope changes, schedule adjustments, and risk events.

  • Partner with Finance to improve forecasting accuracy and optimize capital deployment.

  • Identify opportunities for cost savings, operational efficiencies, and improved return on investment.

Engineering, Regulatory & Deployment Governance

  • Provide strategic oversight of engineering, permitting, regulatory compliance, and construction execution.

  • Partner with Engineering leadership to improve constructability, deployment standards, and network design efficiency.

  • Oversee compliance with federal, state, and local regulatory requirements including NTIA, NEPA, Section 106, Tribal coordination, Davis-Bacon, BABA, and environmental obligations.

  • Ensure governance processes support quality, safety, regulatory compliance, and customer commitments across all assigned programs.

Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

  • Lead initiatives to improve deployment processes, governance, reporting, and execution methodologies.

  • Develop standardized program management tools, dashboards, KPIs, and best practices.

  • Identify systemic risks and implement scalable operational improvements.

  • Leverage program data and performance metrics to improve forecasting accuracy, contractor productivity, and deployment efficiency.

  • Drive lessons learned across the organization to continuously improve delivery performance.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Mentor and develop Program Managers, Project Managers, and deployment personnel.

  • Provide guidance on complex delivery challenges, contractor management, financial controls, and executive communication.

  • Lead cross-functional teams through influence rather than direct authority.

  • Support organizational planning, succession development, and capability building within the Long Haul Deployment organization.

Qualifications

Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Telecommunications, Business, or related field preferred.

  • Equivalent industry experience may be substituted for formal education.

  • At least ten (10) years of telecommunications, fiber deployment, infrastructure, or OSP program management experience.

  • At least eight (8) years leading complex outside plant construction programs and contractor organizations.

  • Demonstrated success leading portfolios of multimillion-dollar infrastructure deployments.

  • Experience managing EPC, engineering, and construction contracts.

  • Experience managing federally funded broadband programs and associated regulatory compliance.

  • Experience leading cross-functional organizations through complex delivery challenges.

  • Experience presenting to executive leadership and customer stakeholders.

  • Previous experience mentoring project managers or leading program management teams preferred.

  • PMP certification or equivalent program management certification preferred.

Technical Knowledge

  • Advanced knowledge of long haul fiber architecture, OSP engineering, and construction practices.

  • Expert understanding of capital project controls, forecasting, earned value principles, and financial reporting.

  • Strong knowledge of permitting, environmental compliance, and federal broadband funding requirements.

  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling, dashboards, pivot tables, Power Query, and executive reporting.

  • Working knowledge of GIS platforms, network inventory systems, Salesforce, Sitetracker, and project portfolio management tools.

  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, fiber testing documentation, route designs, and construction packages.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with the ability to balance long-term objectives and near-term execution.

  • Executive presence and communication skills.

  • Strong influence without formal authority.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management.

  • Portfolio and program governance.

  • Financial and commercial acumen.

  • Contract negotiation and supplier management.

  • Operational excellence and continuous improvement mindset.

  • Data-driven decision making.

  • Excellent judgment in ambiguous and fast-changing environments.

  • Ability to lead multiple complex programs simultaneously.

Estimated base salary range: $95,100 - $146,300 USD/annually.

The base pay range shown is a guideline and reasonable estimate for this role. It takes into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Non- sales roles may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive plan. Sales roles may be eligible to participate in a sales incentive plan.


Additionally, this position may be eligible for certain benefits, such as health insurance, life insurance, disability retirement plans, paid time off.


The posting will be active for a minimum of 3 days. The active posting will continue to extend by 3 days until the position is filled.

title: Assistant Headteacher & DSL
description:
The Assistant Headteacher will support the Headteacher and Deputy Headteacher in:

• Communicating the school’s vision compellingly and supporting the headteacher’s strategic leadership
• The day-to-day management of the school
• Formulating the aims and objectives of the school
• Establishing policies for achieving these aims and objectives
• Managing staff and resources to that end
• Monitoring progress towards meeting the school’s aims and objectives

The Assistant Headteacher will also have a timetabled teaching commitment, complying with the Teachers’ Standards and modelling best practice for others. They may also be required to undertake any of the duties delegated by the Headteacher.
School culture and behaviour

• Create a culture where pupils experience a positive and enriching school life
• Uphold educational standards in order to prepare pupils from all backgrounds for their next phase of education and life
• Ensure a culture of staff professionalism
• Encourage high standards of behaviour from pupils, built on rules and routines that are understood by staff and pupils and clearly demonstrated by all adults in school
• Use consistent and fair approaches to managing behaviour, in line with the school’s behaviour policy
• Encourage high levels of pupil attendance and help to uphold a school culture of safety, enjoyment, and engagement with learning to support attendance

Teaching, curriculum and assessment

• Establish and sustain high-quality teaching across subjects and phases, based on evidence
• Ensure the teaching of a broad, structured and coherent curriculum
Establish curriculum leadership, including subject leaders with relevant expertise and access to professional networks and communities
• Use valid, reliable and proportionate approaches to assessing pupils’ knowledge and understanding of the curriculum
• Ensure the use of evidence-informed approaches to reading so all pupils are taught to read.

Additional and special educational needs and disabilities (SEND)

• Promote a culture and practices that allow all pupils to access the curriculum
• Have ambitious expectations for all pupils with SEND
• Make sure the school works effectively with parents, carers and professionals to identify additional needs, and provide support and adaptation where appropriate
• Make sure the school fulfils statutory duties regarding the SEND Code of Practice.

Organisational management and school improvement

• Establish and oversee systems, processes and policies so the school can operate effectively and efficiently
• Ensure staff and pupils’ safety and welfare through effective approaches to safeguarding, as part of duty of care
• Ensure rigorous approaches to identifying, managing and mitigating risk
• Ensure effective use of budgets and resources
• Identify problems and barriers to school effectiveness, and develop strategies for school improvement that are realistic, timely and suited to the school’s context
• Make sure school improvement strategies are effectively implemented

Staff management and professional development
• Performance-manage designated staff, including carrying out appraisals and holding staff to account for their performance
• Manage staff well, with due attention to workload
• Ensure staff have access to appropriate, high-quality professional development opportunities
• Keep up to date with developments in education
• Seek training and continuing professional development to meet their own needs

Governance, accountability and working in partnership
• Work with the governing board as appropriate
  • Make sure the school effectively and efficiently operates within the required regulatory frameworks and meets all statutory duties
• Work successfully with other schools and organisations
Maintain working relationships with fellow professionals and colleagues to improve educational outcomes for all pupils.

Other areas of responsibility:

Assistant headteachers may be required to lead on a particular area of school leadership, as outlined below. This list is not exhaustive and may be subject to change:

Designated Safeguarding Lead

The assistant headteacher will:

• Maintain and review annually the Child Protection and Safeguarding Policy for the school.
• Be the key advisor to staff regarding safeguarding, including online safety, supporting in recognising and acting on concerns.
• Keep detailed, confidential records of all concerns, decisions, actions and referrals.
• Monitor patterns in safeguarding referrals and risk indicators. Where required report trends and compliance to the School SLT, the Education Director and Governors.
• Lead safeguarding audits and school self-evaluation, feeding into the school’s action plan.
• Manage safeguarding referrals appropriately to external stakeholders including: Children’s Social Care, PREVENT and the Police.
• Build and maintain effective working relationships with key staff from Children’s Social Care, the Police, CAMH’s and the Local Authority Designated Officer (LADO).
• Deliver, record and monitor annual safeguarding training for all school staff, including updates to key pieces of legislation such as Keeping Children Safe in Education.
• Actively participate in Safeguarding strategy meetings and Child Protection conferences, which are held locally and nationally.
• Promote a school-wide trauma-informed, emotionally safe environment, especially tailored to SEMH learners.
• Advise on behaviour interventions and attendance strategies.

Special Educational Needs Co-ordinator (SENCO)
Pastoral
Lead on the whole-school assessment strategy

• Degree

• DSL and Safeguarding Level 3 trained and updated safeguarding training at least every two years [essential for those undertaking DSL responsibilities]

Experience:

• Senior leadership experience or equivalent, ideally with a background in safeguarding, social work, education leadership, or SEMH contexts.
• Experience managing inclusion, behaviour, or attendance in special education contexts.
• Experience of working with or preparing for Ofsted or other inspection frameworks.

• Line management experience
• Demonstrable experience of successful line management and staff development

Skills & Knowledge:

• Understanding of high-quality teaching, and the ability to model this for others and support others to improve
• Understanding of school finances
• Thorough knowledge of statutory frameworks such as Keeping Children Safe in Education.
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills
• Ability to communicate a vision and inspire others
  • A competitive salary between £51,807 and £54,417, reviewed annually
  • Enrolment into the Esland education pension scheme, which is double matched up to 20%, meaning at total pension contribution of up to 30%

  • Comprehensive, paid induction training and ongoing training within the role
  • Fantastic opportunities for career development, we promoted over 100 colleagues last year

title: Senior Full Stack Developer | Elixir, Phoenix, LiveView | Remote
description:
If you are a passionate Full Stack Developer with expertise in Elixir, Phoenix and LiveView, and you're excited about revolutionizing the investment industry by crafting solutions for operational challenges and turning best practices into scalable, valuable products, Allocator One could be the perfect destination for your skills.

Come join our team where you'll play a crucial role in automating fund management and regulatory tasks, offering a transformative approach to the future of venture capital funds. You'll be working on all aspects of the application, from coding up user interfaces and components to building new endpoints or integrations. Our team has a good sense of humor and enjoys having fun. If you want to be part of this journey, keep reading!

We're on the lookout for individuals who've mastered either Elixir or React.js at a senior level, with at least a junior-level grasp of the other technology. If you're a senior pro in Ruby or Python and have a thirst for diving into Elixir, we're all ears and highly encourage you to apply.

As a member of our core team, you will work very closely with our founders, key stakeholders, and other experts. You will have the opportunity to learn from and contribute to the team's collective knowledge and expertise, and to participate in all aspects of the Allocator One value chain. The role will report into a Founding Partner.

Note: Allocator One is headquartered in Vienna, Austria. We offer the flexibility for this job to be performed remotely.

Allocator One

At Allocator One, we operate a distinctive fund model designed to invest in the most promising first-time fund managers worldwide while optimizing fees. With an eye on the highly favorable prospects for the 2023/2024 fund vintages, our team has accelerated its efforts to seize this unique opportunity. We pride ourselves on being the anchor investor of choice for exceptional first-time fund managers, offering them unparalleled access, expertise, and operational support.

Our focus on first-time fund managers

Allocator One's focus on first-time fund managers is driven by a simple yet compelling fact: historically, top-performing funds with assets under $50 million, led by emerging managers, have delivered returns that are more than 3 times higher over a 10-year horizon compared to their peers of larger fund sizes. Furthermore, the fund vintages of 2023/2024 in our pipeline are poised to enjoy an additional boost in returns. Venture capital funds that originate during economic recessions have consistently achieved returns that are 15%-30% higher compared to those raised in the preceding years, across various performance percentiles.

Optimizing fees and building Partnerships

We believe in optimizing fees while nurturing partnerships with first-time fund managers from the very beginning. Our aim is to enhance investment terms by actively contributing to the success of these funds. Allocator One has already established itself as a global brand in the realm of emerging managers, thanks to our extensive international investor network. In just two months since our launch, we've received over 300 applications, a testament to our commitment to supporting emerging talent. Our team goes beyond traditional investing; we offer to act as "co-builders," incorporating emerging managers into our unique Allocator One program, often likened to a "Y Combinator for Capital Allocators." We provide vital support in areas such as regulation, administration, and structure.

Our founding partners:

Our founders bring a wealth of experience and expertise to Allocator One:

  • Felix Staeritz: As the builder of category-leading corporate venture builder FoundersLane, Felix has an impressive track record of founding and exiting successful ventures. He is an active VC/PE investor and serves on the boards and advisory boards of esteemed organizations like the World Economic Forum (WEF), Fraunhofer, and various public and private companies.
  • Michael Ströck: Michael is a seasoned open source developer and entrepreneur with multiple successful exits to his name. He is an alumnus of Y Combinator and has transitioned from a CTO role to a successful investor. Michael has played a pivotal role in establishing three VC funds and is part of a family business now in its third generation.

Tasks

General responsibilities:

  • Implement new features on our web application
  • Solve complex programming challenges using functional programming languages (Elixir, in our case)
  • Develop new user-facing features using Elixir, Phoenix and LiveView
  • Build reusable components and front-end libraries for future use as specified by the UX team
  • Translate designs and wireframes into high-quality code integrated with the backend
  • Optimize components for maximum performance across a vast array of web-capable devices and browsers
  • Collaborate with the development team to develop a strategy that enables a great user experience
  • Continuously research new and best coding practices
  • Perform regular code reviews/PR reviews for your colleagues
  • Maintain existing code and fix bugs
  • Write unit, integration, and E2E tests

Requirements

Your skills and qualifications:

  • 5+ years of real-world experience in software development
  • Strong understanding of Elixir, Phoenix and LivewView in a production environment
  • Strong understanding of Elixir and LiveView
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Good understanding of modern front-end build pipelines and tools
  • Experience with common front-end development tools such as Babel, Webpack, NPM, etc.
  • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical requirements
  • Strong experience with HTML, CSS (we use Tailwind CSS ), and JavaScript
  • A strong desire to build beautiful end-user experiences that exceed expectation

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary
  • Potential for bonuses and equity
  • “No assholes allowed” company culture
  • Learn from and grow with experienced colleagues who are eager to share their knowledge

Hiring process:

Initial screen: This initial screen via video-call with a member of our team will be an opportunity for you to discuss your background and experience, and to ensure that you meet the minimum qualifications for the role and the job aligns with your expectations.

Interview with founding partners: If you are a strong candidate, you will be invited to participate in an interview with our founding partners. This will be an opportunity for you to learn more about the company's strategy and culture, and for the partners to get to know you better.

Case study and/or technical assessment during an work trial day: To get to know each other even better, we invite you to a work trial day, remotely. To assess your skills and knowledge, we may ask you to complete a case study or technical assessment.

After the final round interview, the team will review all of the candidates and make a decision on who to offer the position to. The hiring process can take several weeks, so please be patient as we review all of the applications and make a decision. If you are not selected for the role, we will notify you as soon as possible.

Sounds interesting? Then we look forward to receiving your application.

title: Staff Engineer Analog Mixed signal verification
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated AMS Verification Engineer with 5+ years of experience in System Verilog Real Number Modeling (SV RNM), WREAL modeling, Mixed-Signal Verification, and DMS-based SoC verification. The candidate will be responsible for developing and validating behavioral models of analog IPs, creating verification environments, implementing SV Assertions, and driving AMS verification for power management and mixed-signal designs.


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Develop and maintain SV RNM and WREAL models for analog and mixed-signal IPs.
    Verify and correlate RNM/WREAL models against transistor-level schematics and analog simulation results.
  • Develop automated checkers and reusable verification components.
  • Create and deploy System Verilog Assertions (SVA) to verify protocol, functionality, timing, and design correctness.
  • Perform SoC-level analog vector verification using DMS verification flows involving UVM testbenches and RNM models.
  • Verify AMS IPs such as:
    ADCs
    LDOs
    Buck/Boost Controllers
    Multi-phase Controllers
    Power Switches
  • Analyze simulation results, debug failures, and ensure comprehensive functional coverage.
  • Collaborate with analog design teams to establish model-to-schematic correlation.
  • Develop automation frameworks and regression infrastructure using scripting languages.
  • Contribute to AMS verification methodology enhancements and simulator adoption.

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


  • 5+ years of experience in AMS/Mixed-Signal Verification.
  • Strong expertise in:
    SystemVerilog RNM (Real Number Modeling)
    WREAL Modeling
    UVM Methodology
    Digital Mixed Signal (DMS) Verification
    System Verilog Assertions (SVA)
  • Hands-on experience in developing behavioral models for analog IPs and validating them against schematic-level simulations.
  • Experience in SoC-level AMS verification involving RNM models and UVM environments.
  • Strong understanding of analog and mixed-signal concepts including:
    Data Converters (ADC)
    Voltage Regulators (LDO)
    Power Management ICs
    Buck/Boost Converters
    Multi-phase Controllers
    Power Switches
    Good understanding of EDA tools and simulators:
    Cadence Virtuoso Schematic Editor
    Cadence Xcelium
    APS (Accelerated Parallel Simulator)

title: ESaaS - SFDC -  Commerce Development
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud Developer to join our engineering team for an upcoming enterprise B2B e-commerce implementation. In this role, you will lead the technical design, configuration, and customization of our B2B storefronts—architecting scalable solutions on Salesforce Experience Cloud using LWR/LWC, Apex, and seamlessly integrating with core enterprise systems (ERP, PIM, WMS, and Payment Gateways).

Key Responsibilities

  • Storefront Architecture & Customization: Design and build custom, high-performance B2B storefront features using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Lightning Web Runtime (LWR) on Experience Cloud.
  • Backend Apex Development: Develop robust Apex classes, controllers, custom APIs, triggers, and async processes to support complex business logic and transactional flows.
  • B2B Core Configuration: Configure B2B Commerce constructs including Account hierarchies, Buyer Groups, Entitlements, Custom Price Books, Contract Pricing, Order Management, and custom Checkout flows.
  • System Integrations: Build secure REST/SOAP integrations connecting SFDC B2B Commerce with external ERPs (SAP/Oracle), PIM systems, tax/payment gateways, and middleware platforms.
  • Code Quality & CI/CD: Drive technical code reviews, implement unit tests (Apex & Jest), maintain version control standards via SFDX/Git, and manage automated deployment pipelines (CI/CD).
  • Technical Leadership: Partner with solution architects and business stakeholders to translate complex B2B commerce requirements into scalable technical designs; mentor mid-level developers.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 8+ years in Salesforce development, with at least 3–4+ years dedicated hands-on experience in Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud (Experience Cloud/LWR or CloudCraze legacy).
  • Core Tech Stack: High proficiency in LWC, Apex, SOQL/SOSL, JavaScript (ES6+), and Salesforce Event-Driven Architecture (Platform Events).
  • Integration Expertise: Strong background in building and consuming RESTful/SOAP Web Services, Webhooks, and handling complex batch processing.
  • B2B Commerce Domain: Deep knowledge of B2B patterns—quick order/bulk upload, punchout catalogs, tier pricing, payment terms (P.O. processing), and multi-tier account permissions.
  • DevOps & Tools: Experience with SFDX, Git version control, GitHub Actions/Jenkins, and Jira.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications: Salesforce Certified B2B Commerce Developer, Salesforce Certified Administrator, or Platform Developer II (PD2).
  • Experience with Headless Architecture, storefront performance optimization, or Salesforce Order Management (SOM).
  • Prior experience in life sciences, biotech, or high-volume scientific e-commerce supply chains.

title: Java Developer
description:
We're on the lookout for a Java Developer to become part of our team. A great fit for this role brings solid, practical expertise in Java backend engineering, along with familiarity in Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, and relational database systems. We need someone comfortable working with minimal supervision, capable of getting up to speed on existing systems fast, weighing in on technical choices, and teaming up smoothly with a diverse engineering group.

Responsibilities

  • Build, engineer, and sustain backend services written in Java
  • Craft and improve REST APIs that power mobile app functionality and connect with outside systems
  • Handle MySQL-related tasks such as structuring data models, writing and refining queries, and diagnosing issues
  • Play a part in shaping and evolving backend and microservices architecture built for scale and long-term maintainability
  • Write dependable, secure, thoroughly-tested code that adheres to sound engineering principles
  • Track down and fix bugs, performance bottlenecks, and issues arising in live environments
  • Take part in reviewing peers' code, joining technical conversations, providing estimates, and shaping solution designs
  • Team up with mobile engineers, product-side stakeholders, quality assurance staff, and fellow backend developers to bring complete features to life
  • Support efforts around automated testing, monitoring, logging practices, and general application dependability
  • Make use of AI-powered development tools when useful to boost efficiency, elevate code standards, and streamline testing and troubleshooting

Requirements

  • At least 2 years of practical experience working with Java and object-oriented programming concepts
  • Solid grasp of how to design REST APIs along with knowledge of sound API development practices
  • Background in building or working alongside microservices and systems spread across multiple nodes
  • Working knowledge of MySQL, SQL syntax, structuring relational data, and tuning queries for performance
  • Familiarity with core design principles, widely-used design patterns, and writing clean, maintainable code
  • Exposure to writing unit and integration tests, plus comfort using contemporary testing frameworks
  • Awareness of key security concepts including authentication, authorization, and building APIs securely
  • Comfort with Git-driven workflows, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, and current delivery methodologies
  • Skilled at diagnosing issues in live systems by interpreting logs, metrics, and other monitoring data
  • Sharp analytical thinking and problem-solving capability, coupled with a sense of ownership over assigned work
  • Solid interpersonal skills and the capacity to work well within a spread-out, multi-disciplinary team
  • Strong English language command, at B2 level or above

Nice to have

  • Background operating within cloud platforms to handle deployment, scaling, and upkeep of backend systems
  • Comfort using AI-assisted tools to support tasks related to writing code, testing, and resolving technical problems

Benefits

  • International projects with top brands
  • Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers
  • Healthcare benefits
  • Employee financial programs
  • Paid time off and sick leave
  • Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses
  • Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses
  • Global career opportunities
  • Volunteer and community involvement opportunities
  • EPAM Employee Groups

title: Engineering Technician - R&D
description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.

What We Offer

Salary:

$29.00 - $39.60

Location:

Gloucester,MA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Key Responsibilities

Performs complex electro-mechanical technical functions and activities such as design, test, checkout, fabrication, modification, troubleshooting and assembly of electronics and electro-mechanical systems, experimental design circuitry, prototype models, specialized test equipment, tools and test fixtures.

Tests and troubleshoots system level and component level problems in electrical and mechanical systems and sub-systems with minimal supervision. Assignments require solution of difficult problems by application of technical knowledge. May perform more complicated or complex new system and NPI installations and field upgrades.

May work from limited or no documentation. Investigates, compiles data, documents and recommends changes using applicable reporting process to enhance product performance.

Compiles logbooks and test procedures documentation utilizing good writing skills. Assists in revising, developing and implementing documented procedures. Writes complex technical reports and test procedures.

Performs mechanical, electrical, pneumatic & vacuum and process testing on AMAT platforms to Engineering and Manufacturing documentation and specifications.

Observes all safety standards. Maintains a secure, safe, clean and healthy work environment. Attends required health and safety training and follows safety and security policies, procedures and practices. Promptly reports accidents, injuries, safety hazards, or emergencies to supervisor or Safety dept. Follows operating instructions, uses protective equipment when required, and uses equipment and materials properly. Actively strives to prevent accidents and injuries.

Requires full understanding of the company's manufacturing and/or engineering processes, as well as excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively interface across departmental/functional lines. Provides management with technical input in order to correct problems both at the system level and in the manufacturing process.

Provides training to lower level Engineering Technicians. Recognized as technical resource for a particular platform or product. Highly proficient at troubleshooting and resolving issues. Effective at providing standard work and workmanship skills training. Works closely with Engineering in the development of procedures and documentation for NPI. May serve as a "Quality Lead".

Other Requirements: This is a physically demanding position that often requires standing for extended periods of time, walking, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting, the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, the use of hand and power tools, and driving or operating heavy machinery including forklifts.

Additionally, because this position may involve working in a clean room, the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields may be required.

Functional Knowledge

  • Has developed advanced specialized expertise within a analytical/scientific area to perform the most complex work

Business Expertise

  • Has a good understanding of how related teams coordinate their efforts and resources to achieve objectives

Leadership

  • May act as a lead for the team, may allocate work and provide subject matter guidance to more junior team members

Problem Solving

  • Exercises judgment, based on previous experience, practices and precedents, to identify and solve problems that arise with little or no precedent

Impact

  • Impacts the effectiveness of own team and closely related teams

Interpersonal Skills

  • Exchanges ideas and information effectively; uses tact and diplomacy when dealing with others

Additional Information

Time Type:

Full time

Employee Type:

Assignee / Regular

Travel:

Yes, 10% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:

No

In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable.

title: Trainee Solicitor Opportunities
description:
A number of trainee solicitor opportunities are available across our September 2027 and February 2028 intakes.

Assessment Centres will be held on Thursday 11th and Friday 12th March 2027.

Deadline for applications: Friday 20th November 2026.

Judge & Priestley LLP is a Legal 200 leading regional law firm, serving a wide range of commercial and private clients across South East London and the surrounding counties. From our Head Office in Bromley and additional offices in Beckenham, Blackheath, Sidcup and London, we provide expert legal services across a broad range of practice areas.

Established in 1889, we've evolved into a modern, progressive firm with a strong reputation for developing talent, promoting from within and creating an inclusive workplace where people can thrive. Our commitment to a People First culture means that the wellbeing, development and success of our people sit at the heart of everything we do. This dedication was recognised nationally when we received the LexisNexis Wellbeing Award, celebrating the firm's ongoing commitment to supporting employee wellbeing and fostering a positive working environment.

We are always looking for bright and enthusiastic individuals who share our values. In return, we will invest in your development, provide excellent learning opportunities, and support you in achieving your full potential. Our teams specialise in key areas of law, including Housing Management, Private Client, Debt Recovery, Family, Residential Conveyancing, Property Litigation, Property Development and Commercial Property, delivering forward-thinking legal solutions to a loyal and growing client base.

At J&P, you won't be just another trainee. You'll be part of a supportive and collaborative team where your contribution is valued from day one. We pride ourselves on providing meaningful responsibility, genuine career progression opportunities and a culture built on integrity, respect, wellbeing and community
Your training

You will be working with solicitors and partners to support their activities and your training will be split between at least two of the following departments: Family, Property Development, Commercial Litigation, Residential Conveyancing, Commercial Property, Property Litigation and Housing Litigation (unless you are undertaking a specialised seat). From an early stage, you will be encouraged, under supervision, to take on direct client contact and work on live matters as part of your training and progression. Successful candidates at J&P have, in the past, progressed their careers within the business up to partner level.

During your training you will be involved in intellectually challenging work and be provided with the support needed to flourish into an outstanding solicitor. You will be expected to put in lots of hard work and plenty of commitment to achieve the best results for the firm and for our clients. You will be expected to behave in a way that is representative and in line with our values and demonstrate these values on a daily basis.

Your attributes

You are a bright enthusiastic candidate with proven academic abilities and have a genuine desire and talent for a career in law. As an able and committed team player you enjoy legal research and are committed to taking the lead in enhancing your knowledge to ensure that you have a strong understanding of the law. You also have a practical problem-solving approach and the ability to think creatively whilst working efficiently in a fast-paced environment. You will be committed to developing the “soft skills” that our profession requires in order to develop and further good relationships with colleagues, our clients and fellow professionals.
Two-year Training Contract leading to qualification under the LPC route.

You have;
  • A minimum 2:1 degree classification in Law or a relevant subject. We will also consider candidates with a 2:2 who can demonstrate strong potential and provide context regarding their academic results.
  • If you do not hold a qualifying law degree, you must have achieved at least a 2:1 in your degree and a Commendation or above in the GDL. Applications from candidates with a 2:2 degree may be considered where supporting information is provided.
  • Successful completion of the Legal Practice Course with distinction or commendation or are in the process of completing your Legal Practice Course at present with predicted grades of a distinction or commendation
SQE Training Contract (24 months)
  • A minimum 2:1 degree classification in Law or a relevant subject. We will also consider candidates with a 2:2 who can demonstrate strong potential and provide context regarding their academic results.
  • If you do not hold a qualifying law degree, you must have achieved at least a 2:1 in your degree and a Commendation or above in the GDL. Applications from candidates with a 2:2 degree may be considered where supporting information is provided. At least 6 months experience as a paralegal or a legal assistant gained in a legal organisation, preferably in private practice.
  • This will be partially funded by Judge & Priestley
SQE1 Preparation Course | Courses | BPP
SQE2 Preparation Course | Courses | BPP

Salary and Benefits

We offer an attractive salary and benefits.

The successful candidate will be paid £31,875 per annum in their first year and £32,875 per annum in their second year of training.

At J&P, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Alongside 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, you'll benefit from a market-leading package including a profit share bonus, Medicash plan with virtual GP access, birthday leave, paid volunteering days, long service awards, employer pension contributions, death in service cover, cycle to work scheme, and support with legal fees. As a firm that genuinely invests in its people, we are proud to offer clear progression opportunities, award-winning wellbeing initiatives and a supportive culture that helps our colleagues succeed.

How to apply

If you feel your attributes, experience and skillset match our requirements, we would be interested in hearing from you.

Please apply with your CV and a covering letter (limited to one A4-sized page). Your covering letter should succinctly set out:

title: Director of Clinical Services - Mental Health Regional Service | Far North WA
description:
Director of Clinical Services – Mental Health Regional Public Health Service | Kimberley Region, Western Australia Total remuneration package AUD $592,536 – $704,991 p.a.

We are partnering with a large regional public health service delivering acute, community and specialist mental health services across one of Australia's most iconic and geographically vast regions. The Mental Health and Alcohol & Other Drug (AOD) service spans an acute inpatient psychiatric unit at the region's principal hospital, a network of community-based mental health and AOD teams, and consultation-liaison psychiatry into smaller regional and remote hospitals. The service is delivered in close partnership with Aboriginal community-controlled health organisations, primary care, and non-government providers, with a genuine commitment to culturally safe, community-embedded care.

Your role

  • Provide clinical governance and senior clinical leadership across the region's Mental Health and AOD services
  • Partner with the Regional Manager of Mental Health and AOD to shape service strategy, clinical practice, and workforce development
  • Lead the delivery of psychiatric services across the acute inpatient unit and community teams, including consultation-liaison into regional hospitals
  • Maintain a clinical caseload delivering comprehensive assessment, diagnosis and evidence-based psychiatric care
  • Provide RANZCP-aligned supervision, mentorship, and professional support to psychiatry trainees and the broader medical workforce
  • Ensure clinical practice aligns with the WA Mental Health Act (2014), national mental health standards, and Commonwealth and State strategic priorities
  • Influence the design and delivery of mental health services across a genuinely diverse and geographically dispersed regional environment

What's on offer

  • Total remuneration package AUD $592,536 – $704,991 p.a., dependent on experience and package composition
  • Employer superannuation contributions
  • Professional development leave and allowance
  • Generous annual and personal leave provisions
  • WA Health salary packaging with full FBT concessions, including options for novated leasing, meal and entertainment benefits
  • District Allowance and Remote Area Housing entitlements aligned to regional/remote WA classification
  • Attractive relocation support package for the right candidate
  • Visa sponsorship available for eligible international candidates, including 482, 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional), and DAMA pathways where applicable — with genuine regional pathways to permanent residency
  • Flexibility around clinical, leadership, education and service development components of the role

Requirements

  • Unconditional Specialist registration with the Medical Board of Australia as a Psychiatrist
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Psychiatrists (FRANZCP)
  • Senior clinical and/or medical leadership experience, with demonstrated ability to provide effective clinical governance and lead multidisciplinary teams
  • Strong generalist psychiatric skills, with experience across mental health and alcohol & other drug services
  • Genuine commitment to medical education, workforce development, and culturally safe practice, particularly with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities
  • Ability to work collaboratively with clinical, operational and community stakeholders across a geographically dispersed service environment
  • SIMGs already on an approved RANZCP specialist pathway are welcome to apply
  • Australian working rights, or eligibility for employer-sponsored visa
  • National Police Check and compliance with WA Health immunisation and pre-employment screening requirements

Life in the Kimberley

The Kimberley is one of Australia's true frontier lifestyle regions — a vast, breathtaking landscape of red desert gorges, tropical coastline, ancient rock art, cattle country, and pristine islands, home to some of the oldest continuous living cultures on earth. Life here is genuinely different: warm year-round, unhurried, deeply community-oriented, with a small-town social fabric and a spectacular natural playground on your doorstep — think fishing, boating, camping, four-wheel-driving, and access to landscapes most Australians only ever see on postcards. For clinicians and their families, the region offers a rare combination of professional impact, cultural richness, and a lifestyle that simply isn't available in metropolitan Australia. It is also one of the strongest regions in the country for accessing enhanced regional allowances, subsidised housing, and genuine long-term residency pathways for international candidates.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
The job

As a Cloud Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, deploying and operating the cloud infrastructure that supports Milence's digital products, charging operations and customer-facing services. You will ensure that our cloud platforms are secure, reliable and scalable while enabling engineering teams to deliver solutions efficiently across development, acceptance and production environments.

Reporting to the Head of Software Engineering, you will work closely with Software Engineering, Data, IoT and Product teams to build and maintain the cloud foundations that power Milence's technology landscape. In addition, you will drive automation, improve operational excellence and contribute to the continuous evolution of our cloud and platform engineering practices.

What you will do

  • You will design, deploy and maintain Azure-based cloud infrastructure, ensuring cloud environments are scalable, secure, cost-aware and aligned with business and engineering requirements.

  • You will establish and manage development, acceptance and production environments in collaboration with engineering teams, promoting DevOps practices that improve deployment reliability, performance and operational efficiency.

  • You will implement and maintain monitoring, logging and alerting capabilities across hybrid software and hardware environments, proactively identifying and resolving performance, availability and reliability issues.

  • You will automate repeatable infrastructure and operational processes, contributing to Infrastructure as Code practices and continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, consistency and reliability.

  • You will troubleshoot and resolve cloud, network and infrastructure issues, working independently on complex challenges and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams when broader technical input is required.

  • You will support secure cloud operations through identity and access management, network configuration, VPNs, firewalls and other infrastructure controls, enabling reliable integration between cloud platforms, corporate networks and hybrid or IoT environments.

Who are we looking for

You have 5-8+ years of relevant experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, systems engineering or DevOps-related roles.

You hold a bachelor's or master's degree, or equivalent working and thinking level, in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Cloud Engineering or a related discipline.

You have proven experience designing, deploying and managing Azure cloud infrastructure, including landing zones, cloud resource provisioning, identity and access management and scalability considerations.

You have experience operating cloud platforms in business-critical or distributed environments.

You have experience with containerised applications, service orchestration technologies and modern cloud operations practices.

You possess strong knowledge of monitoring, logging, observability and platform reliability tooling.

You have experience implementing automation solutions and Infrastructure as Code practices.

You have knowledge of networking concepts, cloud connectivity, VPNs, firewalls and infrastructure security controls.

You are familiar with hybrid technology environments and understand how cloud services integrate with enterprise networks, operational technology and IoT platforms.

You bring strong troubleshooting and analytical skills and can effectively identify root causes and develop practical solutions to complex infrastructure challenges.

You actively seek opportunities to automate manual processes and improve operational efficiency, consistency and reliability.

You collaborate effectively with software, data, infrastructure and IoT teams and can translate technical requirements into practical cloud and platform solutions.

You take ownership of assigned environments and operational responsibilities and consistently deliver high-quality, reliable outcomes.

You learn new technologies quickly and adapt comfortably in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

You have strong communication and stakeholder management skills and can work effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

You are quality- and security-minded while remaining pragmatic and focused on continuous improvement and delivery.

You are comfortable working independently, managing complexity and contributing visibly to the evolution of Milence's digital infrastructure and engineering practices.

What we offer

You'll be joining us at an exciting stage of growth where you can make a visible impact, work alongside passionate experts, and help solve some of the most complex challenges in the energy transition.

In return, we offer:

  • The opportunity to work on technology that contributes directly to a more sustainable future.

  • A high-impact role with significant ownership, autonomy and visibility across the business.

  • A collaborative, international and purpose-driven culture where innovation and continuous learning are encouraged.

  • The chance to work with leading industry partners, manufacturers and technology providers shaping the future of transport e-mobility.

  • Company annual incentive bonus plan.

  • Unlimited holiday policy.

  • Company pension plan.

  • A one-time home office allowance to create a comfortable and productive workspace.

  • Monthly phone allowance.

  • A 12-month fixed-term employment contract.

Ready to Charge the Future?

At Milence, we believe diverse perspectives drive better innovation and stronger outcomes. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, nationalities, identities and ways of thinking.

If you're excited about helping shape the future of charging technology and accelerating the transition to sustainable transport, we'd love to hear from you.

Come charge the future with us. Apply now and please submit your CV in English.

title: (1850) Business Architect − Security - GSMD
description:
Brief description

The main purpose of this position is to develop a security landscape aligned with the Group Security Management Department’s (GSMD) strategic projects and initiatives, and to support the successful implementation of physical security infrastructure, solutions and technologies within GSMD.

Detailed description

The successful candidate will be responsible for the following key performance areas:

  • Develop and maintain GSMD’s business architecture landscape, including a security taxonomy and related security reference model (SRM).

  • Direct the implementation of the business architecture consisting of the capabilities, products and business services in support of the business strategy.

  • Develop and implement the business capabilities in terms of key processes and information requirements.

  • Develop and implement the GSMD roadmaps to achieve target business/security architectures.

  • Develop foundation, reference- and strategic-level architectures for the department, incorporating a strong security framework perspective that includes threat identification, trust and domain frameworks.

  • Develop GSMD’s portfolio architecture and implementation roadmap to guide programme delivery.

  • Define the target architecture to enable the Group Security Policy and Group Security Strategy by documenting the current landscape and conducting a gap analysis between the current and future state (as-is baseline and to-be target).

  • Govern the implementation of the roadmaps.

  • Contribute to formulating, translating, advocating, supporting and executing the business strategy to achieve the organisation’s targeted business outcomes.

  • Develop diagnostic and actionable deliverables that help the business guide investment decisions in support of executing the business strategy.

  • Ensure alignment between business architecture, enterprise architecture, solution architecture, architecture principles and information and communications technology (ICT) standards to ensure standardisation and reduce risk.

  • Make recommendations on key architecture decisions.

  • Participate in the South African Reserve Bank (SARB) Group’s business architecture and enterprise architecture governance structures.

  • Ensure compliance with SARB policies, procedures and other legislative requirements, and ensure that risks within the function are identified, assessed and mitigated.

  • Take a proactive approach in identifying integration needs across the SARB Group and work towards target architecture regarding business integration.

  • Lead the analysis of business and operating models, market trends and the technology industry to determine their potential impact on the enterprise’s business strategy, direction and architecture.

  • Consult infrastructure, project and product teams to ensure alignment with the business architecture and identify when updates are required.

Job requirements

To be considered for this position, candidates must be in possession of:

  • an Honours’ degree in BCom Informatics, BSc Computer Science, BSc Engineering or a related field, supplemented by industry-specific certifications or an equivalent qualification;

  • certification in Sherwood Applied Business Security Architecture (SABSA);

  • certification in The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF); and

  • 8−10 years’ relevant experience in Business Architecture and/or Domain Architecture, with at least 5 years in a Security Business Architecture environment.

Additional requirements include

  • demonstrate knowledge and experience in:

  • business modelling and capability mapping;

  • business attribute profiling;

  • business service design and management;

  • threat and risk analysis methodologies;

  • architecture principles, including the development of architecture designs, views and viewpoints;

  • building block design and architecture building blocks;

  • solution modelling and architecture design;

  • benefits analysis and value-realisation assessment;

  • the application of enterprise and security architecture frameworks and methodologies, including SABSA;

  • security frameworks, standards and best practices, including ISO 27000 series, NIST and related industry standards;

  • architecture modelling tools and notations such as ArchiMate, UML and BPMN;

  • establishing, maintaining and populating architecture repositories; and

  • systems integration and the management of complex, parallel-processing environments.

In line with the SARB’s commitment to diversifying its workforce, preference will be given to suitable candidates from designated groups. People with disabilities are welcome to apply.

The SARB offers remuneration and benefits commensurate with the level of the position and in line with the market. The level at which the successful applicant will be appointed will depend on his/her competence and experience.

title: Forensic Psychiatrist
description:
Consultant Forensic Psychiatrist Staff Specialist / Senior Staff Specialist Regional Tertiary Public Health Service | North Queensland Total remuneration up to AUD $534,040 p.a. FTE (inclusive of incentives)

We are hiring on behalf of a leading North Queensland public Hospital and Health Service to recruit a Consultant Forensic Psychiatrist into a genuinely rare combined role spanning adult and adolescent forensic mental health, custodial consultation, and specialist services within a well-established regional Mental Health Service Group.

About the service

Our client is a large regional tertiary Hospital and Health Service delivering the full spectrum of public mental health care across a vast North Queensland catchment, with strong academic links to a leading North Queensland university. The forensic psychiatrist appointment sits within the Alcohol, Tobacco and Other Drug Service (ATODS) and Specialist Services stream, working in close partnership with the region's adolescent forensic mental health service and the broader Child, Adolescent and Young Adult mental health division.

The service delivers forensic mental health input across:

  • Adult community forensic mental health consultation and liaison
  • The regional adolescent forensic mental health service — a rare opportunity to work across both adult and adolescent forensic populations within one appointment
  • Consultation and liaison into the region's adult correctional centre and youth detention centre
  • Court liaison, specialist forensic risk assessment, and expert reporting
  • Outreach to remote and Indigenous communities, including a significant Palm Island component

Your opportunity

  • Deliver expert forensic psychiatric assessment, treatment, and consultation across adult and adolescent forensic populations
  • Provide specialist forensic input into custodial and youth detention settings
  • Contribute to clinical governance, service development, and multidisciplinary team leadership across the forensic and specialist services stream
  • Provide RANZCP-aligned supervision, mentorship, and teaching to psychiatry trainees and the broader medical workforce
  • Contribute to the delivery of culturally safe forensic mental health care with a substantive Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander community focus
  • Position available at Staff Specialist and Senior Staff Specialist level (L18–L27), dependent on experience

What's on offer

  • Total remuneration package up to AUD $534,040 p.a. FTE (inclusive of incentives)
  • Permanent full-time or part-time — hours genuinely negotiable
  • Employer superannuation contributions
  • Professional development allowance and leave
  • On-call and after-hours allowances
  • Attraction and retention incentives available for hard-to-fill specialty roles
  • Generous annual and personal leave provisions
  • Queensland Health salary packaging with full FBT concessions (including novated leasing, meal and entertainment benefits, and remote area benefits where applicable)
  • Regional workforce incentives aligned to North Queensland classification
  • Attractive relocation support package for the right candidate
  • 482 and 494 visa sponsorship available for eligible international candidates
  • DAMA pathway applicable to this location — offering age concessions to 55, expanded occupation eligibility, and enhanced pathways to permanent residency

Requirements

  • Fellowship of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Psychiatrists (FRANZCP) with Certificate of Advanced Training in Forensic Psychiatry (or equivalent recognised training)
  • Specialist registration, or eligibility for specialist registration, with the Medical Board of Australia
  • SIMGs with a "Substantially Comparable" RANZCP outcome are strongly encouraged to apply — our client is genuinely open to overseas-trained forensic specialists and has a strong track record of supporting international clinicians through the specialist pathway
  • Current Class C driver's licence (the role involves travel to correctional facilities, youth detention, and Palm Island outreach)
  • Ability to meet Queensland Health credentialling and Scope of Clinical Practice requirements
  • Ability to obtain Queensland Corrective Services security clearance
  • Compliance with the service's Vaccine Preventable Disease screening and pre-employment check policies
  • Genuine interest in working within a regional, culturally diverse service environment, including with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities

Life in North Queensland

North Queensland offers a lifestyle proposition that is increasingly rare in metropolitan Australia — a vibrant coastal city set on a subtropical shoreline, framed by an offshore island and the Great Barrier Reef beyond. Cost of living and property are dramatically more affordable than Brisbane, Sydney, or Melbourne, and the city offers excellent public and private schooling, family-friendly communities, a growing café and dining scene, and one of the state's most highly regarded urban beaches. For clinicians with an interest in the outdoors, the region gives you the reef, tropical rainforest, and the Queensland outback all within easy reach — and Brisbane, Cairns, and Asia-Pacific destinations are all a short direct flight away. For international clinicians, the DAMA pathway makes this one of the strongest regions in Australia for genuine long-term residency planning.

For a confidential discussion please reach out to ania@mediix.com.au
