title: Calypso QA Analyst / Calypso Test Engineer
description:
Project description

Work on quality assurance and testing of the Calypso trading platform (v16+) across Rates, Credit, Fixed Income, Derivatives, and Backoffice. The role involves end-to-end functional, regression, UAT, and batch/EOD testing covering trade lifecycle, pricing, market data, settlements, accounting, reporting, and reconciliation. The position will collaborate with BA, development, environment, and operations teams throughout release cycles.

Responsibilities

  • Design, execute, and maintain functional, regression, and UAT test cases for Calypso.
  • Test trade capture, pricing, lifecycle events, settlements, confirmations, accounting, and backoffice processing.
  • Validate EOD and scheduled batch processing, including scheduled tasks, engines, jobs, logs, and task status.
  • Test market data setup and consumption, including curves, quotes, feeds, and valuation inputs, and validate their impact on pricing, P&L, and reports.
  • Test Fixed Income products such as bonds and repos, including related reporting and reconciliation flows.
  • Test Rates/Credit Derivatives covering trade lifecycle and valuations.
  • Perform trade, position, cash, and report reconciliation between Calypso and downstream/related systems.
  • Analyse release-to-release and environment-to-environment differences across trades, reports, extracts, CSV/XML files, and other outputs.
  • Raise clear, evidence-based defects and support defect triage through closure.
  • Execute and monitor Jenkins jobs for regression packs, batch runs, test environments, and file comparisons.
  • Use SQL to validate trade attributes, static data, market data, and post-batch results.
  • Use Linux for log analysis, file handling, job monitoring, and basic environment troubleshooting.
  • Support test planning, change-request coverage, regression execution, and test summary/sign-off activities.
  • Work closely with BA, development, environment, and operations teams during releases.

SKILLS

Must have

  • 4–12 years of overall experience in software testing/QA.
  • Mandatory hands-on Calypso testing experience on Calypso v16 or higher.
  • Strong understanding of Calypso trade lifecycle, static data, and relevant Calypso modules.
  • Hands-on experience with Calypso EOD/batch processing and scheduled tasks/jobs.
  • Experience in functional and regression testing of trading/markets applications.
  • Strong understanding of at least relevant areas across Fixed Income, Rates/Credit Derivatives, and Backoffice.
  • Experience validating trade, position, cash, reports, extracts, and reconciliation results.
  • Ability to analyse test failures and reconciliation breaks and identify business/technical root causes.
  • Strong test-case design, execution, defect management, and release testing experience.
  • Ability to work effectively within tight, release-driven regression cycles.

Nice to have

• SQL for trade, position, market data, and batch-result validation. • Linux/Unix skills for logs, files, processes, and job troubleshooting. • Jenkins experience for CI/CD, regression, and batch job execution/monitoring. • Market data knowledge covering curves, FX, bonds, credit spreads, and feeds. • Domain knowledge of Fixed Income, Derivatives, Backoffice, pricing, P&L, CSA/collateral, and trade reconciliation. • Experience with regression comparison tools, CSV/file-diff utilities, or Calypso QA automation. • Exposure to related platforms/interfaces such as Murex, MarkitWire, Bloomberg, or schedulers such as Control-M. • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Play.tv Content Publisher
description:

Je werkt nauw samen met programmatie en technologie en bent vaak de eerste die kansen ziet om processen of tools verder te verbeteren. Zo help je mee bouwen aan de kijkervaring van duizenden gebruikers, elke dag opnieuw.

Heb je een passie voor streaming, ben je sterk georganiseerd en krijg je voldoening van een platform waarop alles tot in de puntjes klopt? Dan ben jij misschien wel de collega die we zoeken.

Jouw rol

Als Play.tv Content Publisher zorg je ervoor dat alles wat onze kijkers op Play.tv zien ook effectief klaarstaat om bekeken te worden. Van nieuwe afleveringen en films tot live events: jij zorgt ervoor dat content correct verwerkt, ingepland en gepubliceerd wordt.

Daarnaast denk je actief mee over hoe processen, tools en workflows slimmer en efficiënter kunnen worden ingericht.

title: Design Engineering Student Placement (Powertrains)
description:
Red Bull Powertrains are offering multiple year-long placement opportunities within our Design Engineering teams. In these hands-on roles you will be emersed into the heart of our state-of-the-art Technical and Manufacturing facilities where we drive engineering and innovation to the limit to develop cutting-edge Formula 1 power units. Pushing boundaries is in our DNA!

As a placement student, you’ll work directly on the design and development of critical systems within the Internal Combustion Engine (ICE) & Energy Recovery System (ERS) including the battery, electronics, motor-generator unit (MGU-K), turbo and chassis integration. You’ll be part of a team that creates high-performance mechanical components, including advanced cooling systems, all designed to operate within the tight packaging constraints of an F1 car.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Contribute to all stages of the engineering process from conceptual design, through manufacturing reviews, to live testing on our in-house dyno facilities
  • Applying engineering design principles using tools such as CAD and rapid manufacturing techniques to develop real Power Unit components
  • Developing fixtures, jigs, and assemblies to support testing, with hands-on involvement in builds, upgrades, and component installations
  • Designing and executing measurement tests, performing failure mode analysis, and using results to propose improvements and validate new designs
  • Developing and applying precision instrumentation to capture and analyse the Power Unit's operating environment at microsecond-level resolution
  • Building and validating numerical simulations to maximise performance and reliability
  • Interpreting and reporting data through technical documentation and presenting insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Collaborating closely with all the Technical and Manufacturing teams to deliver world-class engineering solutions
  • Gaining direct exposure to the 2027 Formula 1 season and contributing to the future of Red Bull Powertrains

We’re looking for passionate, curious and driven undergraduates who are eager to push the limits of engineering innovation in a fast paced, high-performance environment. If you're ready to take on real responsibility, solve real-world engineering challenges and contribute to the future of Red Bull Racing’s success on track, this is your opportunity.

Expected knowledge, experience & attributes of the successful candidates:

  • Knowledge and experience from at least one year of undergraduate study on either an engineering, mathematics or physics degree course
  • A solid understanding of engineering principles and the ability to apply mathematical methods to solve real-world problems
  • Familiarity with engineering software such as CAD, FEA, CFD, or system modelling (training will be provided)
  • Experience with handling and analysing data from simulations or physical tests, and confidence in preparing high-quality technical documentation
  • Ability to break complex technical problems down to fundamental principles and understand the contributing physics
  • Ability to demonstrate a genuine passion for engineering through involvement in extra-curricular projects, previous placements, or work experience
  • Positive, can-do, attitude and willingness to learn new skills
  • Ability to follow best practice and work on multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working in a team environment

The placement will be for 1 year, starting July 2027. To be considered for this Student Placement, please apply to this advert and submit both your CV and a one-page Cover Letter as two separate documents.

At Red Bull Powertrains, we believe that success isn’t just about speed, it’s about the team behind the victory. We trust, support, and challenge each other, always pushing for better. If you love solving complex problems, thinking fast, and making a real impact, this is the place for you. Alongside a competitive salary, you’ll enjoy:

  • Bonus scheme
  • Private healthcare
  • A pension scheme
  • On-site gym
  • Free daily food allowance
  • And many more!

Most importantly, you’ll play a key role in powering championship-winning cars. If you're ready to be part of something extraordinary, apply now and help shape the future of F1.

title: (1863) Business Analyst - BSTD
description:
Brief description

The main purpose of this position is to provide end-to-end business analysis services to the South African Reserve Bank (SARB) departments to identify business problems and needs, and to determine solutions and enable improvement in organisational processes.

Detailed description

The successful candidate will be responsible for the following key performance areas:

  • Take responsibility for driving business analysis initiatives, from initiation to implementation, on projects of low/medium risk with a cycle of up to 12 months.

  • Facilitate workshops independently and consult with business owners and stakeholders in respect of problem definitions and the identification of business requirements/needs.

  • Review business processes and procedures, analyse business needs and associated data, identify and assess possible solutions, and define the associated requirements.

  • Elaborate on the scope and feasibility of solutions and develop the supporting business case.

  • Manage change requirements and supporting specifications.

  • Investigate problems and propose solutions by interacting with users, developers and other stakeholders.

  • Develop manuals and plans, and present training courses in support of implementation.

  • Stay abreast of changes to analytical tools and methodologies, and identify opportunities to improve and standardise work processes, and apply these in the course of own work.

Job requirements

To be considered for this position, candidates must be in possession of:

  • an Honour’s degree in Information Technology (IT);

  • a relevant Business Analysis certificate; and

  • five to eight years’ experience within a business analysis environment.

Additional requirements include:

  • industry, business and organisational awareness knowledge and skill;

  • continued learning and/or professional development knowledge and skill;

  • quality assurance knowledge and skill;

  • continuous improvement knowledge and skill;

  • business transformation and optimisation knowledge and skill;

  • elicitation techniques knowledge and skill;

  • business analysis practices, methodology and tools knowledge and skill;

  • realisation and testing practices knowledge and skill; and

  • IT domain management knowledge and skill.

In line with the SARB’s commitment to diversifying its workforce, preference will be given to suitable candidates from designated groups. People with disabilities are welcome to apply.

The SARB offers remuneration and benefits commensurate with the level of the position and in line with the market. The level at which the successful applicant will be appointed will depend on his/her competence and experience.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
The job

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, building and evolving the software platform that powers Milence’s heavy-duty transport charging network. You will develop cloud-native, event-driven systems that connect charging infrastructure, customers, operations and business processes.

Reporting to the Head of Software Engineering you will work closely with Product and Engineering teams to deliver scalable and reliable software solutions that enhance the customer experience and support Milence's continued growth across Europe. In addition, you will contribute to architectural decisions, drive engineering excellence and support the continuous improvement of our platform and engineering practices.

What you will do

  • You will design, develop and enhance event-driven services, APIs and distributed applications using TypeScript, and cloud-native technologies.

  • You will contribute to solution architecture, software design and technical decision-making, translating business and platform requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.

  • You will design databases, optimise data models and data flows, and ensure applications meet security, performance and reliability requirements throughout the software lifecycle.

  • You will support the development of technical solutions that improve the customer experience and help Milence maintain its position as a market leader in heavy-duty charging infrastructure.

  • You will investigate complex software and platform issues, perform root-cause analysis and implement structural improvements that strengthen system resilience and reduce operational risk.

  • You will collaborate with Product, Data, Cloud, IoT and business teams to deliver integrated solutions while contributing to engineering standards, technical roadmaps, code quality practices and continuous improvement initiatives.

Who are we looking for

You have 6+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, backend engineering or platform development roles.

You hold a bachelor's or master's degree, or equivalent working and thinking level, in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field.

You have proven experience designing and implementing large-scale cloud-native and event-driven applications.

You have expert-level proficiency in TypeScript and and strong experience with API development, microservices and distributed systems.

You bring experience contributing to software architecture decisions and leading complex technical implementations.

You have experience working with Azure, AWS or GCP cloud platforms, as well as Docker, Kubernetes and containerised deployments.

You possess strong knowledge of database design, query optimisation, security principles and operational resilience.

You have experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring and Infrastructure as Code.

You have working knowledge of React or comparable front-end technologies.

You demonstrate strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills and can effectively identify root causes and develop sustainable solutions.

You are comfortable providing technical leadership, mentoring colleagues and influencing technical decisions without formal people management responsibility.

You have excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills and can communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

You balance delivery priorities with software quality, system reliability and long-term maintainability.

You have a strong product mindset and apply technical decisions through the lens of customer value and business impact.

You are comfortable working independently in a fast-paced scale-up environment and take ownership and accountability for technical outcomes.

What we offer

You'll be joining us at an exciting stage of growth where you can make a visible impact, work alongside passionate experts, and help solve some of the most complex challenges in the energy transition.

In return, we offer:

  • The opportunity to work on technology that contributes directly to a more sustainable future.

  • A high-impact role with significant ownership, autonomy and visibility across the business.

  • A collaborative, international and purpose-driven culture where innovation and continuous learning are encouraged.

  • The chance to work with leading industry partners, manufacturers and technology providers shaping the future of transport e-mobility.

  • Company annual incentive bonus plan.

  • Unlimited holiday policy.

  • Company pension plan.

  • A one-time home office allowance to create a comfortable and productive workspace.

  • Monthly phone allowance.

  • A 12-month fixed-term employment contract.

Ready to Charge the Future?

At Milence, we believe diverse perspectives drive better innovation and stronger outcomes. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, nationalities, identities and ways of thinking.

If you're excited about helping shape the future of charging technology and accelerating the transition to sustainable transport, we'd love to hear from you.

Come charge the future with us. Apply now and please submit your CV in English.

title: Supplier Engineer III
description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.


What We Offer


Salary:

$110,500.00 - $152,000.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Position Overview

Applied Materials is seeking an experienced Supplier Engineer (E3) to lead supplier quality, technical development, and operational excellence initiatives across our machining and contract manufacturing supply base. This role provides an opportunity to influence strategic suppliers supporting semiconductor capital equipment manufacturing while driving improvements in quality, delivery, cost, capacity, and risk management.

As a senior member of the Supplier Engineering & Quality organization, you will work closely with Engineering, Global Supply Chain, Manufacturing Operations, and Supplier Leadership teams to develop supplier capabilities, resolve complex technical issues, and ensure supply chain readiness for new and existing products. This role requires strong technical expertise, project leadership, and the ability to drive results through cross-functional collaboration and supplier engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead supplier quality improvement initiatives and develop supplier performance plans to improve quality, delivery, capacity, and operational excellence.
  • Serve as the primary technical interface for assigned machining and contract manufacturing suppliers, building strong relationships and driving accountability for performance improvements.
  • Lead supplier problem-solving activities utilizing structured methodologies such as 8D, DMAIC, and Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) to resolve factory and customer impacting issues.
  • Conduct supplier assessments, technical audits, and manufacturing process evaluations to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Evaluate supplier manufacturing capabilities, process controls, PFMEAs, Control Plans,
  • First Article Inspections, and quality systems to ensure compliance with Applied Materials requirements.
  • Lead cross-functional projects involving Engineering, Global Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality organizations to improve supplier performance and support business objectives.
  • Support new product introductions by assessing supplier readiness, qualification plans, manufacturing processes, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Analyze supplier performance metrics and develop executive-level summaries, dashboards, and presentations to communicate supplier performance, risks, and improvement plans.
  • Develop and implement project plans for supplier improvement initiatives, capacity expansions, risk reduction activities, and operational excellence programs.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership on supplier quality and manufacturing initiatives.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or Materials Science, Quality Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 7+ years of experience in Supplier Engineering, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, or a related discipline.
  • Knowledge of SEM, EDS, XRD, and advanced material characterization techniques.
  • ASQ, AWS, or NDT certifications.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting machining, fabrication, precision manufacturing, or contract manufacturing suppliers.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes including CNC machining, assemblies, welding, fabrication, and precision component manufacturing.
  • Experience reviewing engineering drawings, specifications, GD&T requirements, and manufacturing process documentation.
  • Proven ability to lead supplier corrective actions, root cause investigations, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Experience leading cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and managing project schedules, risks, and deliverables.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, including interaction with supplier and Applied Materials leadership teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Semiconductor capital equipment, aerospace, medical device, or other high-tech manufacturing experience.
  • Experience with Contract Manufacturers (CMs), Build-to-Print suppliers, and global supply chains.
  • Knowledge of PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA, APQP, PPAP, and Quality Management Systems.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent continuous improvement certification.
  • PMP certification or demonstrated project management experience.
  • Experience conducting supplier audits and driving closure of corrective actions.

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 30% domestic and international travel required.
  • Travel will include supplier audits, technical assessments, process qualifications, business reviews, problem-solving events, and support of critical supplier escalations.
  • Ability to travel on short notice to support factory, supplier, or customer-impacting quality issues.

Additional Information

Full time

Employee Type:

Assignee / Regular

Travel:

Yes, 25% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:

Yes

title: LCSW- Recuperative Care Program
description:
Position Purpose:

The Licensed Clinical Social Worker provides behavioral health services at a Recuperative Care Center in a manner that upholds the JWCH mission to improve the health status and well-being of under-served segments of the population of the Los Angeles area through the direct provision of health care, health education, residential services, and research. This includes adherence to all behavioral health contract requirements (staffing, scope of work, and documentation), utilization of funding, staff productivity, and patient satisfaction.

Population/Needs:

Experience working with chronic disease treatment compliance issues, knowledgeable of chronic diseases and dealing with high rates of depression, anxiety, and other major mental disorders, with a predominantly homeless population. Clinical Social Worker must be familiar with the geographic area to better collaborate with other agencies.

Principal Responsibilities:

  1. Ensure that the patient’s clinical treatment goals and behavioral management needs are met by attending case conferences, chronic disease management meetings, staff consultation, and individual meetings with staff to ensure quality of care.
  2. Conduct functional and strength-based bio psychosocial assessments including comprehensive diagnosis for mental health, substance abuse, trauma, and psychosocial needs.
  3. Develop patient care plans that are coordinated and integrated with a comprehensive range of medical and psychosocial services to address social, emotional, and practical needs.
  4. Conduct groups for clients in a therapeutic setting.
  5. Provide psychotherapy, counseling, medical case management and psychoeducation utilizing individual, family, and group modalities. Employ Evidenced Based brief oriented therapies for patients and their significant others that include social, emotional, and practical life skills to facilitate safe coping, distress tolerance, stress reduction, mindfulness, and relaxation as well as access to necessary resources with the goal of improved functioning and positive health outcomes.
  6. Utilize both short-term and intensive longer-term interventions, as approved by funding source that target trauma, mental health symptoms, increase psychosocial functioning and reduction of substance use. Interventions are client centered; strength based and identified based on a comprehensive treatment plan that is developed, after completing a thorough biopsychosocial assessment.
  7. Consult with primary care providers to enhance understanding of the patient, provide support for treatment approaches that incorporate behavioral health needs, and assist with implementation of bio-psychosocial treatment and care plans.
  8. Participate in Multi-Disciplinary Team meetings that are held weekly.
  9. Provide consultation to and coordinate care for patients needing specialty mental health and/or substance use disorder services
  10. Advocate for patient within organization and community to ensure access to appropriate care
  11. Be available to primary medical care staff during working hours for crisis intervention in the event of a psychiatric emergency and assist staff in the event of any other kind of emergency.
  12. Be available for urgent consultation and clinical sessions with patients who have urgent needs and provide consultation to providers who may have urgent needs and consultation and to clients who present with immediate psychosocial needs.
  13. Be available as assigned to provide after-hours emergency psychiatric assistance.
  14. Provide phone consultation as needed
  15. Complete all charting as required by funding sources, including assessments, progress notes, care plans, and billing documentation
  16. Productivity goal is to average 8-10 patient per day.
  17. Participate in structured and “as-needed” case conferences
  18. Assist with provider/staff education for integrated behavioral and primary care services
  19. Participate in behavioral health quality assurance/improvement activities to maintain and strengthen standards of care, in accordance with the organization CQI Plan
  20. Participate in professional development activities
  21. Support client involvement in planning, implementing, and evaluating services
  22. Complete data collection forms and prepare reports as required by the program.
  23. Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

  1. Master’s degree in social work, social welfare, psychology, marriage, family and child counseling, and or marriage and family therapy from an accredited college or university.
  2. LCSW with current California BBS license
  3. Experience /knowledge in human, social, and/or behavioral health services, especially for homeless and/or low-income underserved individuals
  4. Experience working on an Interdisciplinary Team
  5. Demonstrated understanding of the impact of trauma on behavioral and medical conditions
  6. Knowledgeable of evidence-based treatments (DBT, CBT, Seeking Safety, Motivational Interviewing)
  7. Knowledge of principles, procedures, methods and techniques of mental health emergency procedures such as: 5150, CPS reporting, APS reporting, and Tarasoff,
  8. Experience working with substance abuse disorders, preferred
  9. Experience working in a medical setting preferred
  10. Bilingual (English/Spanish) ability needed.

*All JWCH, Wesley Health Centers workforce members are recommended to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19.

Employee Benefits:

At JWCH Institute, Inc., we believe in taking care of those who take care of others. If you work 30+ hours per week, you’ll enjoy competitive pay and a robust benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Monthly employer-sponsored allowance for assistance with health premiums.
  • Funded Health Savings Account (up to deductible) to assist with carrier-approved medical expenses.
  • Paid time off (vacation, sick leave) and 13 paid holidays.
  • 401(k) Safe Harbor Profit Sharing plan.
  • Mileage reimbursement.
  • Short- and long-term disability plans (LTD/STD).
  • Life insurance policy & AD&D, and more!

Become part of a team where your work matters. Apply today and help us change lives, one patient at a time.

JWCH Institute, Inc + Wesley Health Centers is an Equal Opportunity and Fair Chance Employer.

title: Lead Data Architect
description:

Nice to have

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
description:
The Senior Salesforce Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day configuration, administration, security, and continuous optimisation of DeterTech's Salesforce platform, ensuring it efficiently supports the organisation's commercial, operational, and customer objectives.

Serving as a senior subject matter expert for Salesforce, the role leads complex technical configuration, drives best practices in system setup, and works closely with business stakeholders to design scalable, user-friendly solutions.

The role balances advanced hands-on technical configuration with cross-functional business analysis, ensuring Salesforce maintains high standards of data quality, security, user adoption, and system stability as the business grows.

This is a remote role, although we value regular face-to-face collaboration. We would ideally like someone who can attend our Telford office around once a week if based locally, with a minimum expectation of a couple of office visits per month for those based further afield.
Platform Administration & Operations

  • Act as the senior administrator for the Salesforce environment, ensuring platform stability, optimal performance, and operational alignment with business needs.
  • Support the execution of the Salesforce roadmap, identifying practical opportunities to enhance functionality, automation, and user experience.
  • Promote best practices in system administration, environment management (sandboxes), and user governance across the organisation.
  • Evaluate tri-annual Salesforce releases and new features, recommending relevant enhancements to internal stakeholders.

Configuration & Solution Design

  • Develop advanced platform configuration and customisation, including custom objects, fields, record types, complex Flows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards.
  • Translate business and user requirements into scalable technical solutions that streamline workflows and enhance user productivity.
  • Proactively identify process bottlenecks and automate manual business activities using Salesforce Flow and standard platform tools.
  • Assist with third-party app integrations (AppExchange) and data management between Salesforce and connected business systems.

Business Partnership & Requirements Gathering

  • Collaborate closely with teams across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and IT to understand operational challenges.
  • Serve as a key technical contact for Salesforce enhancements, change requests, and optimisation projects.
  • Facilitate requirements-gathering discussions to turn business requests into clear functional and technical specifications.
  • Provide constructive guidance to ensure proposed requests align with Salesforce best practices rather than over-customisation.

Data Governance, Security & Compliance

  • Maintain high standards of data hygiene, accuracy, and structural integrity across all Salesforce objects.
  • Manage user access, profiles, roles, permission sets, sharing rules, and security policies in alignment with company data protection standards.
  • Establish and execute routine audit procedures for data quality, permissions, and system maintenance.
  • Monitor overall system health, governor limits, and storage, proactively resolving issues or risks.

Reporting, Dashboards & Analytics
  • Design, build, and maintain robust reporting structures and executive dashboards to deliver operational and commercial visibility.
  • Support department leads with custom reports, data extracts, and analytical views to drive data-informed decision-making
  • Train users and managers on self-service reporting capabilities to increase data engagement.
User Support, Escalation & Capability Building

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex tier-2 and tier-3 Salesforce support queries and technical issues.
  • Design and deliver user training sessions and super-user enablement programs across business departments.
  • Create and maintain up-to-date system documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and end-user guides.
  • Champion platform adoption by actively gathering user feedback and resolving usability friction.

System Optimisation & Continuous Improvement

  • Regularly audit existing workflows, legacy configurations, and technical debt to simplify and streamline the platform.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives by contributing technical insights and executing hands-on build work.
  • Stay updated with emerging Salesforce technologies, certifications, and industry trends to continuously bring value to the organisation.
  • Proven hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator in a commercial or corporate environment (typically 3–5+ years).
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM-201) is required.
  • Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator (ADM-211) or Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder is highly desirable.
  • Additional certifications (e.g., Sales Cloud or Service Cloud Consultant) are an advantage.

Technical & Functional Skills

  • Deep hands-on expertise with Salesforce Flow Builder, Process Automation, Object Manager, and Security/Sharing Models.
  • Strong proficiency with data manipulation tools (Data Loader, DemandTools, or Workbench) and data governance techniques.
  • Proven track record of gathering requirements, writing clear documentation, and building declarative solutions without custom code where possible.
  • Experience managing sandboxes, deployment environments (Change Sets, DevOps Centre, or third-party deployment tools), and release management processes.
Behaviours & Key Attributes

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
User-focused mindset with a passionate approach to driving system adoption and user satisfaction.
Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
Proactive, collaborative team player who takes ownership of technical issues through to resolution.

Key Measures of Success
  • Platform Performance: Salesforce operates reliably, securely, and effectively to support business operations.
  • Business Adoption: High levels of user engagement, capability, and adoption across the organisation.
  • Continuous Improvement: Successful delivery of platform enhancements that improve efficiency and user experience.
  • Data Quality: High levels of data integrity, governance, and reporting accuracy.
  • Stakeholder Satisfaction: Positive feedback from business stakeholders and effective delivery of platform requirements.
  • Strategic Contribution: Salesforce capability evolves in line with organisational objectives and supports commercial and operational growth.

title: Servicemedewerker Medische Hulpmiddelen
description:
Ben jij graag onderweg en haal je voldoening uit het helpen van anderen? Zoek je een baan waarin je niet alleen bezorgt, maar ook een glimlach, geruststelling en vertrouwen brengt? Dan is de functie van Servicemedewerker misschien precies wat je zoekt.

Je bent niet alleen degene die het hulpmiddel brengt. Je neemt de tijd voor een duidelijke uitleg, luistert naar vragen en zorgt ervoor dat mensen zich gezien en geholpen voelen. Juist die persoonlijke aandacht maakt jouw werk zo waardevol!

Wat ga je doen:

Als Servicemedewerker kom je dagelijks bij mensen thuis en in zorginstellingen zoals verpleeghuizen en ziekenhuizen. Je levert en installeert medische hulpmiddelen, die voor veel klanten onmisbaar zijn in het dagelijks leven. Denk hierbij aan een hoog-laagbed, een rolstoel of een tillift. Voor jou misschien een gewoon hulpmiddelen, voor de klant vaak het verschil tussen afhankelijk zijn en zelfstandig kunnen leven.

Je werkzaamheden zijn:

  • Het bezorgen, ophalen en installeren van medische hulpmiddelen bij onze klanten;

  • Cliënten, mantelzorgers en zorgprofessionals op een rustige en duidelijke manier uitleg geven over het gebruik van de hulpmiddelen;

  • Kleine controles en reparaties uitvoeren;

  • Je route zelfstandig afhandelen en verwerken in onze werk-app;

  • Je servicevoertuig netjes, veilig en goed bevoorraad houden.

Elke dag ontmoet je nieuwe mensen. Soms stap je binnen bij iemand die net uit het ziekenhuis komt, soms help je een oudere om langer zelfstandig thuis te kunnen wonen. Met jouw aandacht, vriendelijkheid en zorg maak je hun dag nét een stukje makkelijker.

Wat vragen we van jou:

Je vindt het fijn om mensen te helpen en begrijpt dat je vaak bij klanten komt in een persoonlijke of kwetsbare situatie. Je bent geduldig, respectvol en voelt goed aan wat iemand nodig heeft. Een vriendelijk gesprek, een duidelijke uitleg of nét even wat extra aandacht; voor jou is dat vanzelfsprekend.

Daarnaast:

  • Heb je minimaal MBO-3 werk- en denkniveau;

  • Ben je in het bezit van rijbewijs B;

  • Ben je bereid een VOG aan te vragen;

  • Heb je een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal;

  • Ben je flexibel inzetbaar (in ieder geval een dag in het weekend en om de 2 à 3 weken ook in de avonden);

  • Heb je een praktische instelling en technisch inzicht.

Wat krijg je van ons:

  • Een salaris tussen €2.600-€2.650 bruto per maand

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer (max. €165,- per maand)

  • Een goede pensioenregeling (50/50)

  • 28 vakantiedagen per jaar; genoeg tijd om weer op te laden

  • Korting op een fitness abonnement; zo zorg je ervoor dat je fysiek in topconditie blijft

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling; maak je ambities kenbaar en wij kijken graag met je mee naar de mogelijkheden

  • Een informele en warme bedrijfscultuur; je komt in een gezellig team van leuke collega’s terecht

  • Een langdurige samenwerking

Heb je interesse?

Solliciteer via onderstaande button en ik neem zo snel mogelijk contact met je op!

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Er zal dan ook geen reactie komen op verzonden e-mails.

description:
